title: WISP: Composable Representations for Wrist-Worn Activity Recognition
comment: Code and saved results are available at https://huggingface.co/Zipeng365/WISP, and the benchmark data at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Zipeng365/WristHARBench
summary: Smartwatches and fitness bands are among the most common wearable devices, and large national health studies record movement at the wrist. Yet existing human activity recognition benchmarks mix sensors worn on different parts of the body, so they do not show how well activities can be recognised from the wrist alone. We introduce WristHARBench, a benchmark that standardises participant-disjoint evaluation across nine wrist-acceleration datasets and two additional multichannel inertial datasets. We hypothesise that different human activities leave complementary patterns in wrist motion, such as local shape, rhythm, temporal order and cross-axis relationships, and propose WISP (Wrist-Informed Space of Predictive Representations), a composable representation space that combines representations of these patterns with compatible classifiers. Across the nine primary datasets, WISP with random search achieves 70.20% mean Macro-F1, compared with 59.62% for the strongest of 18 external baselines. Controlled ablations and baseline comparisons indicate that recognition improves mainly when a representation adds motion patterns that the others lack, rather than when it represents the same pattern in a different way.

AI.tldr: 论文提出面向腕部活动识别的标准化基准与可组合表示方法；实验表明，融合互补的腕部运动特征能显著提升识别效果。
AI.motivation: 智能手表和健身手环广泛普及，许多大型健康研究也只在手腕处采集运动数据。然而，现有活动识别基准混合了佩戴于身体不同部位的传感器，难以衡量仅凭腕部信号识别活动的能力，也缺乏统一、公平的评估方式。
AI.method: 研究建立腕部活动识别基准，统一九个腕部加速度数据集及另外两个多通道惯性数据集的评估，并采用参与者互斥的划分方式，避免同一参与者的数据同时进入训练集和测试集。研究还提出可组合的腕部感知表示空间，将局部运动形态、节律、时间顺序及多轴关联等特征表示与兼容分类器结合，并通过随机搜索选择组合。
AI.result: 在九个主要数据集上，所提方法结合随机搜索取得百分之七十点二零的平均宏平均值，而十八种外部基线中最强者为百分之五十九点六二。消融实验和基线对比显示，提升主要来自表示之间补充了彼此缺少的运动模式，而非以不同方式重复表示相同模式。
AI.conclusion: 研究为仅依赖腕部信号的人体活动识别提供了更标准化的比较基准，并证明组合互补运动特征是提升识别性能的关键。该结果支持开发面向智能手表等腕戴设备的活动识别方法，同时也凸显了统一评估和参与者独立测试的重要性。

title: Measuring and Teaching Language Model Agents to Act on Delayed Consequences
summary: Language model agents are increasingly asked to run ongoing multi-day operations rather than finish isolated single-turn tasks. In daily operations, today's choices reshape later observations and cash constraints because empty shelves hide lost walk-in demand, short-shipped customers quietly shrink future orders weeks later, and emergency buying drains working capital. We introduce SMB Bench, a calibrated 90-day wholesale simulator with 18 causally paired tasks and an 859-run frontier trace dataset, to ask what experience and learning signal make an agent better at noticing, attributing, and acting on the delayed consequences of its own decisions in unseen businesses. Across 16 frontier models, only 3 outperform a fixed buying rule; models often record a relevant diagnosis in their notes without changing later purchases in time, showing that diagnosing a problem, changing behavior, and improving a business are separate achievements. To study how experience improves those failures in an open model (Qwen3.8-27B), we used training-business records to identify operational rules and archived frontier quarters as starting states to continue from rather than transcripts to copy. On an unseen test business under identical evaluation instructions, the trained policy followed customer-protection commitments more consistently and reduced severe-loss quarters, while the additional profit benefit remained uncertain. Carrying those commitments through the quarter exposed the cost of fulfilling them, as early-quarter stocking habits left the buyer relying on emergency supply and a deteriorating supplier. The results separate recognizing a delayed effect, acting on it consistently, and coordinating surrounding decisions so that the response improves profit. SMB Bench connects these observations to a learning method by turning archived decisions and their consequences into reusable training experience.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个九十天批发经营模拟基准，研究智能体能否识别并妥善应对自身决策造成的延迟后果。实验表明，发现问题、及时改变行为与提升利润是彼此不同的能力；基于经营经验训练可改善客户保护和严重亏损表现，但利润收益尚不确定。
AI.motivation: 现有评测多关注孤立任务，而真实经营需要智能体在多日决策中处理延迟影响：缺货会掩盖未实现的需求，供货不足会逐渐削弱客户订单，紧急采购则会耗尽营运资金。研究旨在 выяс明何种经验与学习信号能帮助智能体在陌生企业中识别、归因并应对这些后果。
AI.method: 研究者构建中小企业基准，包含经过校准的九十天批发模拟、十八组因果配对任务，以及八百五十九次前沿模型运行轨迹。评估十六种前沿模型，并进一步使用一个开放模型开展训练：从训练企业记录中提炼经营规则，将已归档的前沿模型经营季度作为继续决策的起始状态，而非供模型照抄的对话记录；随后在评测指令相同、但未见过的企业上测试。
AI.result: 十六种前沿模型中仅三种表现优于固定采购规则。模型有时能在记录中指出相关问题，却未能及时调整后续采购，说明诊断问题不等于改变行为，更不等于改善经营结果。训练后的策略更稳定地履行客户保护承诺，并减少了严重亏损季度，但额外利润收益仍不确定。持续履行承诺也暴露出配套决策不足：季度初的备货习惯使采购者依赖紧急供货，并受制于状况恶化的供应商。
AI.conclusion: 研究将延迟后果下的经营能力拆分为识别、持续采取行动，以及协调相关决策以改善利润三个层次。把历史决策及其后果转化为可复用训练经验，有望改善智能体的经营行为；但要稳定提升利润，还需让客户承诺、备货、供应商选择与资金管理相互协调。

title: RefineKV: Query-Adaptive KV Cache Compression via Attention-Error Bounds
summary: Repeatedly accessing the full key--value (KV) cache is a major bottleneck in long-context language model decoding. We find that small query-specific subsets can accurately approximate full attention, yet their union covers nearly the entire cache, motivating query-adaptive access for the KV cache. A natural approach is to split the KV cache into clusters, using compact representatives for clusters that incur negligible error while expanding the rest to their original KV entries. We derive a selection criterion from an upper bound on attention-output error, which reveals two complementary factors governing the error: importance measures the impact of a cluster, while distortion measures how faithfully the cluster can be represented. Based on this criterion, we propose RefineKV, a decoding-time query-adaptive KV compression method. Experiments on two models and three benchmarks demonstrate that RefineKV retains near-full-attention quality while achieving up to 7.6x speedup in the attention phase and 1.66x faster decoding, establishing a new quality-latency Pareto frontier.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种按查询自适应压缩键值缓存的方法，在保持接近完整注意力质量的同时，显著加快长上下文解码。
AI.motivation: 长上下文解码反复访问完整键值缓存，成为主要性能瓶颈。虽然每个查询只需少量缓存条目就能近似完整注意力，但不同查询所需条目的并集几乎覆盖整个缓存，因此需要根据当前查询动态选择访问内容。
AI.method: 将键值缓存划分为多个簇，并用紧凑代表项近似其中误差可忽略的簇；对其余簇则展开并访问原始缓存条目。论文从注意力输出误差的上界推导选择准则，结合簇的重要性（其对输出的影响）与失真度（代表项近似簇的准确程度），决定哪些簇需要展开。
AI.result: 在两个模型和三个基准测试上的实验显示，该方法能够保持接近完整注意力的效果；注意力阶段最高提速七点六倍，整体解码最高提速一点六六倍，并取得新的质量与延迟权衡前沿。
AI.conclusion: 查询自适应地决定缓存簇的压缩或展开，可减少解码时对完整键值缓存的访问。实验结果表明，依据重要性和失真度进行选择，能够兼顾生成质量与推理速度。

title: A world model for longitudinal health-trajectory prediction in older adults across multinational cohorts
summary: Aging is characterized by continuously evolving health states, yet most existing prediction models focus on static health risk at isolated time points rather than explicitly modelling how health trajectories unfold over time. We developed a health world model based on the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture to represent evolving health states and simulate future trajectories under specified actions. The model combines a state encoder, an action- and context-conditioned predictor, a stop-gradient target encoder, and clinical outcome heads. We trained the model on the US Health and Retirement Study (HRS) and evaluated it without refitting in the English Longitudinal Study of Ageing (ELSA) and the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS). Open-loop evaluation assessed discrimination and calibration for mortality and worsening of activities of daily living (ADL) and instrumental activities of daily living (IADL). In the held-out HRS test set, the areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROCs) for mortality, ADL worsening, and IADL worsening were 0.89, 0.93, and 0.93 at the first horizon and 0.84, 0.84, and 0.85 at the fifth horizon, respectively. Predicted risks stratified subsequent outcomes across horizons. Across the evaluated horizons, mortality AUROC ranged from 0.867 to 0.881 in ELSA and from 0.796 to 0.801 in CHARLS. Simulated trajectories preserved the expected risk ordering across predefined action regimes. In counterfactual simulations, changes in lifestyle actions shifted predicted risks in directions consistent with observed associations. The model provides a framework for longitudinal risk prediction and action-conditioned simulation in older adults.

AI.tldr: 研究构建了可根据健康状态、背景信息和指定行动模拟老年人未来健康变化的模型，并在美国、英国和中国的纵向数据中评估其风险预测表现。
AI.motivation: 衰老过程中的健康状态会随时间持续变化，但多数现有模型只预测某个时间点的静态风险，难以描述健康轨迹如何发展，也难以模拟不同干预行动下的未来变化。研究旨在建立兼顾长期预测与行动条件模拟的健康模型。
AI.method: 研究基于联合嵌入预测架构构建健康世界模型，包含健康状态编码器、受行动与背景信息条件化的预测器、采用停止梯度机制的目标编码器，以及临床结局预测头。模型使用美国健康与退休研究数据训练，并不经重新拟合，直接在英国老龄化纵向研究和中国健康与养老追踪调查数据上评估。开放式预测评估了死亡以及日常生活活动能力和工具性日常生活活动能力恶化的区分度与校准度；另通过不同预设行动方案和反事实模拟考察行动条件下的预测轨迹与风险变化。
AI.result: 在美国留出测试集上，预测第一时间跨度内死亡、日常生活活动能力恶化和工具性日常生活活动能力恶化的受试者工作特征曲线下面积分别为0.89、0.93和0.93；第五时间跨度分别为0.84、0.84和0.85。风险分层能够在多个时间跨度上区分后续结局。跨国评估中，死亡预测曲线下面积在英国为0.867至0.881，在中国为0.796至0.801。模拟轨迹保持了预设行动方案之间预期的风险排序；反事实模拟中，生活方式行动变化所对应的预测风险方向与观察到的关联一致。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为老年人纵向健康风险预测及行动条件下的健康轨迹模拟提供了可行框架，并显示出一定的跨国家数据迁移能力。不过，行动模拟结果与观察性关联一致，并不等同于证明行动具有因果效果；其干预解释仍需更严格的因果验证。

title: Feedback Shortcut: Speculative Decoding for Latent Feedback Transformers
summary: Feeding each position's top-layer hidden state back into the next position's input improves Transformer performance. However, this feedback breaks speculative decoding, since verifying a drafted token requires the top-layer state from its preceding position, which forces the draft to rely on an approximate stand-in. Training the model to adapt to this stand-in can lower the exact-decoding performance ceiling, while using it at inference time further introduces approximation error. We propose Feedback Shortcut to address both bottlenecks. First, state alignment trains a lightweight projection from multi-token prediction head states to stand-ins, leaving base model training untouched. Second, pipelined correction re-evaluates each draft using its predecessor's newly computed state, a much closer proxy to true feedback. Running this correction inside the verification pass of subsequent drafts improves accuracy with zero extra calls. Across 135M and 780M scales, Feedback Shortcut stays within $10^{-4}$ bits per byte of the exact-decoding ceiling on Paloma and accelerates decoding by 2.4-2.8x with about 2% more training compute than the latent feedback Transformer. At large batch sizes, skipping correction still preserves Transformer speed and over 80% of latent feedback's gains.

AI.tldr: 反馈捷径通过状态对齐与流水线校正，兼顾隐状态反馈带来的性能提升和推测解码效率，在几乎不损失精确解码性能的情况下实现显著加速。
AI.motivation: 将每个位置的顶层隐状态反馈到下一位置的输入，能够提升变换器性能，但会妨碍推测解码：验证草拟词元需要前一位置的顶层状态，而该状态当时尚不可得，只能用近似值替代。若训练模型适应这种替代状态，可能降低精确解码的性能上限；若仅在推理时使用近似值，也会引入误差。
AI.method: 提出反馈捷径，包含两个环节。其一是状态对齐：训练一个轻量投影，将多词元预测头的状态映射为所需的替代状态，不改动基础模型训练。其二是流水线校正：利用前一草拟位置新计算出的状态重新评估当前草拟词元，使反馈更接近真实状态。校正嵌入后续草拟词元的验证过程，无需额外调用。
AI.result: 在一亿三千五百万和七亿八千万参数规模的实验中，该方法在帕洛玛基准上的每字节比特损失距精确解码上限不足万分之一；解码速度提升二点四至二点八倍，相较潜在反馈变换器，训练计算量仅增加约百分之二。大批量场景下，即使跳过校正，仍保持变换器级速度，并保留潜在反馈方法超过百分之八十的收益。
AI.conclusion: 反馈捷径针对推测解码中的状态依赖问题，减少近似反馈造成的训练与推理损失，同时保留隐状态反馈的性能优势。其校正机制无需增加调用次数，因而为兼顾生成质量与解码速度提供了有效方案。

title: Learning the Projection onto the Data Support: Distribution Learning that Avoids Memorization
summary: We introduce a framework for learning distributions supported on manifolds based on estimating the nearest-point projection onto the data support. Specifically, we define an objective functional over a class of functions whose minimizer recovers this projection. The proposed framework automatically adapts to the intrinsic dimension and allows for data supported on unions of manifolds with varying dimensions. The resulting objective can be optimized using standard neural network architectures. We present population-level results establishing recovery of the manifold projection and prove finite-sample Wasserstein generalization bounds. Furthermore, we validate the approach empirically across a range of settings. In contrast to widely used generative models such as diffusion models, whose objectives can be minimized by memorizing training samples, our formulation excludes such behavior. We also introduce a direct memorization metric to verify that the learned projection generates new samples rather than reproducing the training set.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种通过学习数据支撑集上的最近点投影来建模流形分布的方法，并证明其能够恢复投影、具有有限样本泛化保证，且可避免简单记忆训练样本。
AI.motivation: 许多生成模型的训练目标可能通过记忆训练样本而被最小化，因此生成结果未必真正反映数据分布的结构。针对数据分布支撑在低维流形上、且可能由不同维数的流形组成这一情形，论文希望建立一种能够适应内在维数并减少样本记忆的学习框架。
AI.method: 在一类函数上定义目标泛函，使其最小化解能够恢复到数据支撑集的最近点投影。该目标可用标准神经网络架构优化，并能适应未知的内在维数以及由不同维数流形构成的支撑集。论文还提出直接的记忆度量，用于检验学习到的投影是否生成新样本，而非复现训练数据。
AI.result: 理论上，论文给出总体层面的结果，确立该方法对流形最近点投影的恢复能力，并证明有限样本条件下的瓦瑟斯坦距离泛化界。实验方面，作者在多种设置中验证了方法的效果，并通过记忆度量检查其生成样本与训练样本的区别。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将流形分布学习转化为最近点投影估计，在理论上兼顾投影恢复与有限样本泛化，并针对训练样本记忆问题提供了方法层面的约束及直接检验手段。

title: The Cross-Context Threshold Test: Detecting Discrimination Under Environmental Shifts
summary: We study how threshold tests for detecting discrimination under environmental shifts, focusing on the Veil-of-Darkness (VoD) setting where visibility changes between daylight and darkness. We show that standard threshold tests, when applied separately to daylight and darkness data, violate key assumptions: risk distributions drift across contexts and thresholds fluctuate arbitrarily. We propose a cross-context threshold test that enforces distributional invariance and monotonic threshold decay. Using New York City stop-and-frisk data and synthetic experiments, we demonstrate that this model yields more reliable thresholds, improves bias detection, and aligns with the counterfactual logic of the VoD test. Our framework generalizes to fairness auditing whenever environmental context influences decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文针对环境变化下的歧视检测，提出跨情境阈值检验，以提升暗夜遮蔽检验的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 在暗夜遮蔽检验中，研究者通常分别分析白天与黑夜的数据，但不同情境下风险分布可能发生漂移，估计出的阈值也可能任意波动，从而违背检验所需的关键假设，导致歧视判断不可靠。
AI.method: 提出跨情境阈值检验，要求不同情境间的风险分布保持不变，并约束阈值随环境变化单调下降。该方法以反事实逻辑为基础，并通过纽约市拦截搜查数据和合成实验进行检验。
AI.result: 实验表明，该模型能够得到更可靠的阈值、提升偏见检测能力，并使分析结果更符合暗夜遮蔽检验的反事实逻辑。
AI.conclusion: 跨情境建模可缓解环境变化对阈值检验的干扰，使歧视审计更加稳健。该框架也可推广至其他环境情境会影响决策的公平性审计任务。

title: FoGConcept: Identifying Interpretable Movement Concepts for Freezing-of-Gait Detection from Multi-Scale IMU Signals
summary: Freezing of gait (FoG) is a disabling motor symptom of Parkinson's disease, characterized by an episodic inability to initiate or sustain effective stepping. Current inertial measurement unit (IMU)-based models can detect FoG accurately, but they fail to explain their predictions in terms of human-understandable movement concepts. A major contribution of this work is to identify nine human-understandable movement concepts encoded by a multi-scale FoG model, including gait initiation, rhythmic bilateral gait, trembling in place, shuffling steps, and pivot turns. These concepts recur across subjects, are functionally linked to the model's FoG decisions, and exhibit emergent specialization across short and long temporal contexts. Repeating the concept-discovery procedure on a new FoG dataset, wider temporal contexts, and a deeper backbone recovers the same comparatively stable set of movement concepts. Accordingly, we propose FoGConcept, a mechanism-based interpretability framework for learning movement concepts from multi-scale IMU signals. Domain experts independently recognize 88.9% of the identified concepts, while the proposed model achieves an F1 score of 94.2% for FoG detection. Our findings show that accurate FoG detection can be understood through human-recognizable movement patterns, providing new insight into what a detection model learns to distinguish FoG from non-FoG movement.

AI.tldr: 研究提出一种可解释框架，从多尺度惯性测量信号中学习人类可理解的运动概念，在保持较高冻结步态检测性能的同时揭示模型依据。
AI.motivation: 现有基于惯性测量单元的冻结步态检测模型虽准确，却难以用人类能够理解的运动模式解释预测。研究旨在揭示模型区分冻结步态与非冻结步态时所依据的动作特征。
AI.method: 提出基于机制的可解释框架“冻结步态概念”，从多尺度惯性测量信号中发现并学习运动概念。研究考察这些概念在不同受试者、数据集、时间范围和模型深度下的稳定性，并由领域专家独立评估其可识别性。
AI.result: 模型识别出九种可理解的运动概念，包括步态启动、双侧节律步行、原地颤抖、碎步和转身等。这些概念在不同受试者间重复出现，与模型的冻结步态判断相关，并在短、长时间尺度上呈现不同专长。更换数据集、扩大时间范围或加深模型后，仍能发现相对稳定的概念集合。专家对概念的识别率为百分之八十八点九，冻结步态检测的调和平均值为百分之九十四点二。
AI.conclusion: 冻结步态检测模型学习到的判别依据，可以概括为人类可辨认的运动模式。该框架兼顾检测准确性与可解释性，为理解模型如何区分冻结步态和其他运动提供了新途径。

title: Failure Modes and Data-Efficient Remedies for Transformer-Based Prediction of Viscoplastic Flows
summary: Fast and accurate prediction of viscoplastic flows remains a challenge in computational rheology due to yield surfaces, discontinuous gradients, and strongly nonlinear transitions between yielded and unyielded regions. Transformer-based neural operators such as RheOFormer have recently shown strong potential for surrogate modeling of non-Newtonian flows. However, their applicability to viscoplastic systems and their efficacy in recovering realistic flows remain poorly understood. In this work, we present the first systematic investigation of RheOFormer applied to steady Bingham channel flow. By isolating the problem to a simple geometry and constitutive model, we examine how dataset structure, numerical value range, and input representation govern the model's ability to interpolate and extrapolate within the parameter space. The data regimes in which RheOFormer remains accurate and those in which errors emerge are identified, particularly for plug-dominated flows and for conditions outside the velocity scales or flow structures represented during training. Upon identifying these failure modes, targeted enhancements to the input representation and loss formulation are introduced to better predict low-gradient plug regions. Logarithmic velocity representations and gradient-aware loss formulations substantially improve accuracy in challenging regimes where the baseline formulation fails. In addition, extrapolation errors are reduced by augmenting the training set with only a few strategically selected cases spanning the missing physical regimes. Finally, a single partially developed snapshot suffices for an accurate steady-state prediction, and the model outperforms simply copying its input throughout flow development. These results highlight the importance of appropriate field representation and parameter-space coverage for data-efficient neural-operator prediction of viscoplastic flows.

AI.tldr: 研究系统评估了变换器神经算子在稳态宾汉姆通道流预测中的表现，并通过改进输入表示、损失函数和训练数据覆盖范围，提升了困难流态下的预测精度。
AI.motivation: 黏塑性流动存在屈服面、梯度不连续，以及已屈服区与未屈服区之间的强非线性转变，因此快速、准确地预测此类流动仍具挑战。尽管变换器神经算子在非牛顿流动代理建模方面前景良好，其对黏塑性系统的适用性及还原真实流动的能力尚未得到充分研究。
AI.method: 以稳态宾汉姆通道流为研究对象，系统考察数据集结构、数值范围和输入表示对模型参数空间内插与外推能力的影响，并识别模型在塞状流占主导、训练数据未覆盖速度尺度或流动结构时的失效情形。针对这些问题，研究引入对数速度表示、梯度感知损失函数，以及少量覆盖缺失物理状态的训练样本；同时测试仅使用一帧部分发展流场预测稳态结果的能力。
AI.result: 基线模型在塞状区域及训练覆盖范围之外容易产生误差。对数速度表示和梯度感知损失显著改善了低梯度塞状区域的预测；加入少量针对性样本则降低了外推误差。此外，单个部分发展状态已足以较准确地预测稳态流场，且模型表现优于直接将输入流场复制为预测结果。
AI.conclusion: 黏塑性流动的神经算子预测效果高度依赖场变量表示、损失设计和参数空间覆盖。通过针对低梯度区域改进表示与训练目标，并以少量代表性样本补足物理状态覆盖，可以提升困难流态下的预测能力，为数据高效的黏塑性流动预测提供了依据。

title: SONATI: Spatio-temporal ocean neighbourhood asymmetric transformer for imputation of sparse, tabular data with uncertainty
summary: Missing value imputation is often a prerequisite for downstream analyses. In oceanography, observational data are frequently structured in a tabular manner, highly sparse and exhibit spatio-temporal structures that classical imputers such as k-nearest neighbours or MissForest are not suited to exploit. We present the Spatio-temporal Ocean Neighbourhood Asymmetric Transformer for Imputation (SONATI), a masked, factorised time-space transformer operating on pre-computed, local time and space neighbourhoods, which reduces computational complexity compared to global attention. SONATI is designed to work with tabular data and is thus in principle able to work on both gridded and unstructured data, though evaluation here was performed on gridded North Atlantic data only. It provides aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties through a negative log-likelihood loss and multiple forward passes with Monte Carlo dropout. Systematic ablations on attention type and masking strategies guided the final architecture design. The results showed that SONATI outperformed classical and transformer-based methods by at least 12.5% in terms of root mean squared error (RMSE) on a large observational oceanographic dataset with key biogeochemical and physical parameters in the North Atlantic (potential temperature, salinity, oxygen, nitrate, silicate and phosphate). Attention type and masking strategy strongly affected imputation accuracy and smoothness of the produced oceanographic fields. Best results were achieved by factorised time-space attention and combined geographic and per-sample masking. The combined masking strategy reduced the imputation error by 14.3% compared to per-sample masking only. Uncertainties were moderately well calibrated (miscalibration area at observed locations $0.074\pm0.012$) and moderately correlated with the imputation error.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种面向海洋观测表格数据的时空邻域变换器，用于缺失值填补；在北大西洋数据上，其误差优于多种基线方法，并能提供不确定性估计。
AI.motivation: 海洋观测数据通常稀疏，且同时具有时间和空间结构。传统缺失值填补方法难以利用这些结构，而全局注意力计算开销较大，因此需要一种兼顾时空信息利用、计算效率并适用于表格数据的方法。
AI.method: 提出时空海洋邻域非对称变换器，在预先计算的局部时间与空间邻域上进行掩码式、因子化时空注意力，以降低相较于全局注意力的计算复杂度。模型通过负对数似然损失估计偶然不确定性，并利用多次蒙特卡洛丢弃前向传播估计认知不确定性。研究还系统比较了注意力类型和掩码策略。
AI.result: 在包含潜在温度、盐度、氧气、硝酸盐、硅酸盐和磷酸盐的北大西洋大型观测数据集上，该方法的均方根误差至少比经典方法和基于变换器的方法低百分之十二点五。因子化时空注意力与地理位置结合逐样本掩码的效果最佳；组合掩码相较于仅逐样本掩码使填补误差降低百分之十四点三。不确定性校准表现中等，并与填补误差呈中等相关。
AI.conclusion: 局部邻域上的因子化时空注意力及恰当的组合掩码，有助于提升海洋数据缺失值填补的准确性与结果平滑性，同时降低计算负担。该方法原则上可用于规则网格和非规则数据，但本文仅在规则网格北大西洋数据上进行了评估，其跨数据类型的适用性仍需进一步验证。

title: What Do Differentiable Rule Learners Need? FLARE: Fuzzy Rules with Additive Evidence
summary: Rule learners are used where transparency and accountability are required, because they give practitioners patterns they can read. Learning rules is a discrete problem, so neurosymbolic pipelines that use rules as explanations rely on relaxations such as the straight-through estimator. However, these differentiable rule learners often lag behind both classical rule learners and black-box classifiers in terms of performance. We study which parts of a rule-based classifier affect performance, and how well gradient-based training learns each of them. We found that most of the performance comes from how the rules are weighted: random rules with learned weights are already more accurate than every published differentiable rule learner we tested. Based on our results, we propose FLARE (Fuzzy Learned-Antecedent Rule Evidence), a differentiable rule learner that learns simple rules that combine to make the final decision. We also propose a learned encoding for variables with thousands of categories. We test FLARE on tabular data, using 42 datasets of OpenML-CC18 and the 38 classification tasks of TabArena. On CC18, FLARE exceeds the compared rule learners by 7.69 to 12.38 macro-F1 points and performs comparably to random forests, while remaining 1.00 to 1.11 points below tuned gradient-boosted trees. On TabArena it ranks at the same level as random forests and ahead of the other rule learners. As the concept-to-label head of a concept bottleneck model, FLARE is the best rule-based head in five of six settings. On graphs, it is competitive on PubMed and EMOGI but falls behind graph neural networks on Cora and Citeseer. Our code is available at https://github.com/Fuminides/FLARE

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种可微分规则学习方法，通过学习规则权重与简单规则组合提升分类性能，并在多项表格任务中优于其他可微分规则学习器。
AI.motivation: 规则模型具有可读性，适用于重视透明度与问责的场景，但规则学习属于离散问题，现有可微分方法依赖近似梯度等技术，性能往往不及传统规则学习器或黑盒分类器。论文旨在分析规则分类器各组成部分对性能的影响，并考察梯度训练能否有效学到这些部分。
AI.method: 研究发现，规则的权重对分类性能贡献显著：即使规则随机生成，只要学习其权重，效果也能超过所测试的所有已发表可微分规则学习器。基于此，作者提出“模糊学习前件规则证据”方法，学习简单规则并组合其证据以作出最终决策；同时设计了适用于类别数达数千的变量的可学习编码。
AI.result: 在包含42个数据集的基准测试中，该方法的宏平均F1比对比规则学习器高7.69至12.38个百分点，表现接近随机森林，但比经过调优的梯度提升树低1.00至1.11个百分点。在另一组38项分类任务中，其整体排名与随机森林相当，并领先其他规则学习器。作为概念瓶颈模型的概念到标签分类头时，它在六种设置中的五种优于其他规则型分类头。在图任务上，它在部分数据集上有竞争力，但在另外两个数据集上落后于图神经网络。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，规则加权是规则分类器性能的重要来源，学习规则权重甚至可使随机规则取得较强表现。所提出的方法兼顾可解释性与竞争力，尤其适用于表格数据，但在图数据上的优势并不稳定，且与调优后的梯度提升树相比仍有差距。

title: Scalable Beckmann Maps Improve One-step Generation
comment: 40 pages, 15 figures, 12 tables. Code and checkpoints: https://tullebulle.github.io/projects/sbm/
summary: Beckmann Transport Models (BTM) learn one-step generative maps end-to-end from data, without a teacher, a distillation stage, or pretrained features. We introduce Scalable Beckmann Maps (SBM), which bring to BTM the two ingredients behind the quality of modern multistep generators: classifier-free guidance (CFG) and a training recipe that scales, while keeping sampling at a single network evaluation. CFG combines conditional and unconditional velocity or score predictions, which a Beckmann map does not have. Our guidance rests on one observation: the BTM current is a positive multiple of an autonomous denoising field, to which CFG applies as it does to a velocity. With exact denoisers this gives guided BTM. In practice we substitute the map's own conditional and null predictions for the denoisers, which requires no additional network and introduces a bias that we characterize. We show that the guided update is consistent with a guided conservation equation, and that guidance can move the boundaries between basins, sending more noise to the modes a condition favors. Trained from scratch in the latent of a representation autoencoder, SBM reaches a one-step FID of 1.6 on ImageNet 256x256 without a teacher or a feature loss, outperforming the Improved-MeanFlow baseline with 3.2x fewer FLOPs. In text-to-image generation it reaches a GenEval score of 0.86 with one network evaluation. As a world model, where we train without guidance, the recipe alone outperforms DriftWorld on all five metrics of two robot-manipulation benchmarks, with 1.9-2.8x less training compute and no pretrained auxiliary feature encoder.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可扩展贝克曼映射，在保持单次网络评估生成的同时引入条件引导与可扩展训练方案，并在图像生成、文本生成图像和机器人操作世界模型任务中取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 贝克曼传输模型能够端到端学习一步生成映射，无需教师模型、蒸馏或预训练特征，但缺少现代多步生成模型常用的无分类器引导，训练方案的可扩展性也有待提升。论文旨在增强生成质量与训练效率，同时保留单步采样的优势。
AI.method: 提出可扩展贝克曼映射，结合无分类器引导和可扩展训练方案。其关键观察是，贝克曼映射中的传输流是自主去噪场的正比例缩放，因此可对去噪场应用条件引导。实际操作时，以映射自身的条件预测和空条件预测替代去噪器预测，无需增加网络；论文分析了这种替代带来的偏差，并证明引导更新与相应的引导守恒方程一致。引导还能够移动不同吸引域的边界，使更多噪声流向条件偏好的模态。用于世界模型时则不采用引导。
AI.result: 从头开始在表示自编码器的潜空间中训练后，该方法在二百五十六乘二百五十六的图像生成任务上取得一点六的单步生成弗雷歇特距离，优于改进均值流基线，且浮点运算量减少至其约三成。在文本生成图像任务中，单次网络评估取得零点八六的生成评估分数。作为世界模型，该训练方案在两个机器人操作基准的全部五项指标上均优于漂移世界模型，训练计算量减少约一点九至二点八倍，且不需要预训练的辅助特征编码器。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，贝克曼映射可以通过适配其传输流的条件引导机制，在不增加采样网络调用次数的前提下提升条件生成能力；配合可扩展训练方案，单步生成模型也能在图像生成和世界建模任务中兼顾质量与效率。

title: Benchmarking EEG feature families for ADHD research in children and adolescents: performance and explainability across attention tasks
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures. Benchmark software and aggregate results (v1.0.0): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23884319. Curated EEG dataset (v1.0.0): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21982978
summary: Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder varies in presentation. Diagnosis requires clinical and developmental assessment. Reproducible electroencephalography measures may complement clinical and behavioural characterisation, but differing feature definitions and evaluation methods hinder comparison. We compared seven feature families and four combinations across attention tasks and assessed the stability of held-out explanations. Two serious games yielded four overlapping attention-task cohorts of 123-140 participants each. Repeated nested participant-held-out evaluation assessed recruitment-group discrimination. Exploratory paired participant-cluster bootstrap tests corrected for multiplicity in two separate families: 72 individual-task contrasts and 18 fusion contrasts. For eight configurations selected after inspecting predictive results, we explained held-out native probabilities before calibration. In the strongest task context, the highest configuration mean AUROC over three repetitions was 0.773, with a fixed-prediction 95% interval of 0.692-0.854 unadjusted for selecting the maximum. Precision, sensitivity and specificity were 0.740, 0.556 and 0.861. In that task, the paired AUROC difference for connectivity minus spectral features averaged +0.2083 across six classifiers and the common 8 s and 16 s durations, with pointwise 95% CI 0.1076-0.3072 and adjusted p = 0.0036. F4-AF4 beta-band coherence led repetition-level attribution summaries in five selected procedures and was selected in every fit. Other contexts showed weaker discrimination and less consistent retention of leading scientific inputs. No general classifier winner emerged. Connectivity and its recurring coherence input warrant independent replication, but do not justify a universal feature recommendation. These exploratory findings do not establish causal task effects, disease mechanisms or diagnostic validity.

AI.tldr: 研究比较注意任务脑电特征及其组合对招募组别的区分能力；在表现较强的任务情境中，连接性特征优于频谱特征，额区电极间β频段相干性反复成为重要输入，但结果仍属探索性，需独立验证。
AI.motivation: 注意缺陷多动障碍的临床表现存在差异，诊断依赖临床与发展评估。可重复的脑电指标或能补充临床和行为特征，但既有研究在特征定义与评估方法上不一致，难以比较。因此，本文系统比较多类脑电特征，并考察预测解释在留出参与者中的稳定性。
AI.method: 研究使用两款严肃游戏中的四个重叠注意任务队列，每个队列包含123至140名参与者。比较七类单独特征及四种特征组合，并采用重复嵌套、按参与者留出的评估方法区分招募组别。通过配对的参与者簇自助法检验任务内及特征融合差异，并分别对两组多重比较进行校正。对根据预测结果选出的八种配置，分析校准前、留出样本上的原始预测概率解释。
AI.result: 表现最强的任务情境中，最佳配置在三次重复中的平均受试者工作特征曲线下面积为0.773；固定预测条件下的95%区间为0.692至0.854，但该区间未校正从多个配置中选取最大值的影响。精确率、敏感度和特异度分别为0.740、0.556和0.861。在该情境下，连接性相较频谱特征的平均曲线下面积差为0.2083，点对点95%置信区间为0.1076至0.3072，多重比较校正后显著性概率为0.0036。F4与AF4之间的β频段相干性在五种所选分析流程中均位列重复层级归因结果前列，且每次拟合均被选中。其他任务情境的区分能力较弱，重要特征的稳定性也较低；未发现普遍占优的分类器。
AI.conclusion: 结果提示，在特定注意任务情境中，脑电连接性特征，尤其是F4与AF4间β频段相干性，值得开展独立重复验证；但现有证据不足以支持普遍适用的特征推荐。研究属于探索性分析，不能据此认定任务对结果具有因果影响，也不能推断疾病机制或脑电指标的诊断有效性。

title: AV-FLARE: Feature-Level Reliability Estimation for Multimodal Emotion Recognition
comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 2027 IEEE Symposium Series on Computational Intelligence (IEEE SSCI 2027)
summary: Multimodal emotion recognition (MMER) systems typically rely on learned feature representations and attention mechanisms that implicitly weight information across time and modalities. However, these mechanisms do not explicitly incorporate input reliability, despite the presence of noise in audio, occlusions in visual data, and the sparse and event-driven nature of affective cues. We propose AV-FLARE, a framework that explicitly estimates fine-grained reliability scores across both temporal and feature dimensions prior to temporal modeling and uses them to modulate feature representations. Reliability is computed using two complementary components: (i) a supervised network trained jointly with the classification objective, and (ii) an unsupervised Gaussian Mixture Model that models global feature distributions. These signals are combined to provide both task-driven and distribution-aware reliability estimates. To integrate modalities, we introduce a hierarchical cross-modal attention mechanism in which textual features are used to guide audio-visual fusion as a semantic reference modality. Experiments on the IEMOCAP dataset show that AV-FLARE improves over a no-reliability baseline, achieving 90.81\% accuracy and 81.69\% F1-score, corresponding to gains of +4.41% and +8.56%, respectively. These results suggest that incorporating explicit input reliability estimation may improve robustness in multimodal emotion recognition under the evaluated setting.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种显式估计输入可靠性的多模态情绪识别框架，在实验数据集上优于不使用可靠性估计的基线。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态情绪识别方法通常依赖特征学习和注意力机制隐式分配时间及模态权重，却没有明确考虑输入质量。音频可能含噪、视觉信息可能受遮挡，而情绪线索往往稀疏且由特定事件触发，因此模型容易受到不可靠信息干扰。
AI.method: 框架在时间建模前，沿时间维度和特征维度细粒度估计可靠性，并据此调节特征表示。可靠性由两部分共同提供：一是与分类目标联合训练的监督网络，二是用于建模全局特征分布的无监督高斯混合模型；二者结合后兼顾任务相关性与分布特征。此外，框架采用分层跨模态注意力，以文本特征作为语义参照，引导音频与视觉信息融合。
AI.result: 在所评估的多模态情绪识别数据集上，该方法取得百分之九十点八一的准确率和百分之八十一点六九的宏观调和平均分，相较于不含可靠性估计的基线分别提升四点四一个百分点和八点五六个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，在该评估设置下，显式建模输入可靠性并结合文本引导的跨模态融合，有助于提升多模态情绪识别效果。摘要未提供跨数据集或噪声条件下的验证，因此结论的适用范围仍需进一步实验确认。

title: TabK: Amortized Bayesian Estimation of the Number of Clusters in Tabular Data
summary: Estimating the number of clusters, $k$, is a fundamental prerequisite for most clustering algorithms. Traditionally, this estimation has relied on computationally expensive grid searches over internal cluster validity indices (CVIs) or adaptive clustering algorithms, both constrained by specific statistical assumptions. We introduce TabK, a zero-shot, permutation-invariant transformer architecture that frames the estimation of $k$ as an amortized Bayesian inference problem for tabular data. TabK leverages a novel Quantile Feature Encoder (QFE) to extract position-free, content-derived representations from empirical marginal distributions. By learning a generalized structural bias over a diverse synthetic prior, TabK estimates the number of clusters in a single forward pass per ensemble member. Evaluated across 50 diverse real-world benchmarks, TabK outperforms all competing methods, achieving a mean absolute error (MAE) value of 1.04 compared to 2.14 for the closest competitor. TabK also achieves the lowest average inference time, producing estimates in less than one second on average and running $2\times$ faster than TabClustPFN and $30\times$ faster than traditional CVIs such as Silhouette and Calinski-Harabasz. Code is available at https://github.com/mrbakhtyari/TabK.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向表格数据的零样本模型，可通过一次前向计算快速估计聚类数；在五十个真实数据集上，其估计误差和推理速度均优于对比方法。
AI.motivation: 聚类数是多数聚类算法的重要前提，但现有估计方法通常依赖计算开销较大的有效性指标网格搜索，或依赖特定统计假设的自适应算法，因而效率和适用范围受限。本文旨在提供一种快速、通用且无需针对新数据重新训练的估计方法。
AI.method: 作者将聚类数估计建模为摊销贝叶斯推断问题，并提出一种具备置换不变性的变换器架构。其核心是分位数特征编码器，从经验边缘分布中提取不依赖位置、由数据内容决定的表示；模型在多样化的合成先验数据上学习聚类结构规律，随后对新数据直接进行零样本推断，并在一次前向计算中给出估计。
AI.result: 在五十个多样化的真实基准数据集上，该方法的平均绝对误差为一点零四，优于表现最接近的对比方法的二点一四。其平均推理时间不到一秒；相较于一种已有表格聚类模型快约两倍，相较于传统的轮廓系数和卡林斯基—哈拉巴斯指标快约三十倍。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，利用合成先验学习通用结构规律，可以实现准确且高效的聚类数估计。该方法有望减少传统搜索与指标计算的成本，并提升聚类分析在多种表格数据上的实用性；不过，摘要未说明其在不同数据分布及聚类结构下的具体适用边界。

title: Which Loans, Not How Many: Exactly Level-Invariant, Anytime-Valid Monitoring of Deployed Risk Models
summary: A refinancing wave can change the number of mortgage prepayments without changing the relationship between scores and prepayment. In a logistic model, conditioning on the monthly count removes the intercept from the likelihood of which loans prepay. Our fixed-start slope product tests a lower bound on the calibration slope. At threshold 20 its probability of ever crossing under the null is at most 5%. The restarted level sum tracks departures from intercept tolerance. A confidence sequence estimates a constant slope, and the restart-intersection rule detects changes in that slope. A continuous mixture avoids the off-grid width floor of a discrete prior. On Freddie Mac loans, fixed-slope resampling reproduces 78% of maintained-model monthly AUC variance in development and 70% in the holdout (95% intervals 57-100% and 48-100%). From fresh holdout starts, the restarted level sum crosses on both paths, and the fixed-start slope product stays below threshold on both. The restart-intersection rule signals a downward change for the frozen model in April 2018 and an upward change for the maintained model in a supplementary run in August 2019.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一套用于监测抵押贷款提前还款模型的序贯统计方法，将提前还款数量变化与贷款评分和提前还款关系的变化区分开来，并在房利美贷款数据上验证其表现。
AI.motivation: 再融资浪潮会改变每月提前还款的贷款数量，却未必改变贷款评分与提前还款之间的关系。若不区分这两类变化，模型监测可能把数量波动误判为评分关系失准，因此需要能分别监测截距和斜率变化的方法。
AI.method: 在逻辑回归框架下，按月提前还款总数进行条件化，从判断哪些贷款提前还款的似然中消去截距。研究提出固定起点的斜率乘积检验，用于检验校准斜率下界；阈值为二十时，其在零假设下曾经越界的概率不超过百分之五。重启式水平和用于跟踪截距容忍范围的偏离；置信序列用于估计恒定斜率，重启—交集规则用于检测斜率变化。此外，连续混合先验可避免离散先验带来的网格外宽度下限。
AI.result: 在房利美贷款数据上，固定斜率重抽样分别复现了开发集模型月度曲线下面积方差的百分之七十八，以及留出集的百分之七十；相应百分之九十五区间为百分之五十七至百分之一百、百分之四十八至百分之一百。留出集采用新的监测起点后，两条路径上的重启式水平和均越界，而固定起点斜率乘积在两条路径上均未达到阈值。重启—交集规则在二〇一八年四月检测到冻结模型斜率下行，并在补充分析中于二〇一九年八月检测到维护模型斜率上行。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过条件化提前还款总数，将提前还款规模变化与评分关系变化分开监测，并提供针对截距偏离、斜率校准及斜率变化的序贯工具。实证结果显示，这些工具能捕捉不同类型的模型变化；不过，摘要所报告的斜率乘积检验在两条留出路径上均未越界，说明其信号与其他监测规则并不相同。

title: Toward Adversarially Robust World Models
summary: Latent dynamic world models have proven to be highly versatile tools for embodied artificial intelligence systems, enabling online action planning, safe policy evaluation, and scalable policy learning. However, this versatility makes world models a vulnerable and centralized point of failure as a compromised model can impact planning, evaluation, and training at once. Therefore it is critical that the security and robustness properties of world models are properly understood before they are universally deployed in embodied AI systems. In this work we take a unifying approach towards this understanding, developing two novel attacks against world models, named state hallucination and dynamic shift attacks, aimed directly at impacting downstream systems, and proposing a new theoretical lens through which to study the robustness of latent dynamic world models. Through our analysis we identify robust latent space encoders as the key component of robust world models. We empirically validate this finding on four separate latent dynamic world model families, studying Dino World Model, Le World Model, r2Dreamer, and Cosmos 3, demonstrating significant improvements in robustness through adversarial encoder model training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出两种针对潜在动态世界模型的新型攻击，并指出增强潜在空间编码器的鲁棒性，是提升整体模型安全性的关键。
AI.motivation: 潜在动态世界模型可支持具身智能体的规划、策略评估与学习，但模型一旦遭到攻击，可能同时影响这些下游环节，成为集中式故障点。因此，在广泛部署前，需要系统理解其安全性与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出状态幻觉攻击与动态偏移攻击，直接干扰世界模型的下游系统；同时建立分析潜在动态世界模型鲁棒性的理论视角，并通过对抗式训练增强潜在空间编码器。
AI.result: 研究发现，潜在空间编码器是构建鲁棒世界模型的关键。实验覆盖四类不同的潜在动态世界模型，结果显示，对编码器进行对抗式训练能够显著提升模型鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型的鲁棒性不仅关系到单一预测模块，还会影响规划、评估和学习等多个环节。提升编码器对抗扰动的抵抗能力，是增强具身智能系统整体安全性的一条有效路径。

title: Coupling-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Co-Evolving Graph Games
comment: 29 pages, 6 figures, 15 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Building hydrogen station networks, electric vehicle charging grids, or vaccine distribution systems requires coordinating two separately operated graphs, demand-side facilities and the supply-side networks they depend on, where each operator's payoff depends on the other's choices. We formalize this as the Co-Evolving Graph Game (CEGG), a setting that sits between facility location, interdependent-network analysis, and graph-based multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) but is not jointly addressed by any of them. We propose Cross-Graph Attention with Policy Mirror Descent (CGA-PMD), pairing cross-graph attention, which lets each agent read only the partner-graph nodes structurally coupled to its own, with a policy mirror descent update for stable training. Across three reward domains and a range of practical network scales, we find that the structure of the coupling selects which method wins: at small scale most methods are competitive, but as scale grows or coupling becomes irregular, CGA-PMD is the one method that stays reliable: it attains the highest success count on each of five real city networks, while own-only, unmasked-attention, and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)-based variants degrade in distinct ways. Our theoretical analysis addresses the optimizer side: the Kullback-Leibler (KL)-regularized update admits an iteration-uniform cumulative drift bound, whereas the clip update admits no such bound on the iterations where the clip does not bind. The implementation is available at https://github.com/Mina-Kim-Github/cegg-cga-pmd.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种用于协调相互依赖的两类网络决策者的方法，在网络规模增大或连接关系不规则时表现更可靠。
AI.motivation: 氢能站布局、电动汽车充电网络和疫苗配送等问题，都需要协调分别运营的需求侧设施网络与供给侧网络。双方收益相互影响，但设施选址、互依网络分析和图多智能体强化学习尚未共同解决这类问题，因此论文将其形式化为协同演化图博弈。
AI.method: 论文提出跨图注意力与策略镜像下降相结合的方法。跨图注意力使每个决策者只读取与自身结构相连的对方网络节点信息；策略镜像下降则用于稳定训练。理论分析比较了相对熵正则化更新与裁剪式更新的优化性质。
AI.result: 在三个奖励领域和多种实际网络规模的实验中，小规模时多种方法表现接近；规模增大或连接关系变得不规则后，所提方法的可靠性更强，并在五个真实城市网络上均取得最高成功次数。仅使用自身网络信息、未屏蔽注意力以及基于近端策略优化的方法则分别出现性能退化。理论上，相对熵正则化更新具有不随迭代次数变化的累积漂移界；裁剪式更新在裁剪未生效的迭代中不具备此类界。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，跨网络耦合结构会影响方法优劣；显式利用结构关联并采用稳定的策略更新，有助于提升大规模、不规则网络协同决策的可靠性。

title: Cross-Site Transformers Are Robust Heart Rate Estimators
summary: Single-site heart-rate estimation from photoplethysmography (PPG) degrades sharply under real-world motion. Multi-site PPG provides a natural solution, but existing models fuse sites as generic sensor channels rather than exploiting their hemodynamic structure: each heartbeat propagates along the arterial tree, appearing across body sites as delayed and transformed copies of the same cardiac event. We propose the Cross-Site Transformer, which introduces a hemodynamically informed inductive bias by restricting multi-sensor fusion to cross-attention between PPG sites. On WildPPG, the largest in-the-wild benchmark available, our model establishes a new single-model state of the art, reducing error by 21% over the previous best and 35% over the best prior transformer. The same cross-site restriction makes the trained network directly auditable. Because each cross-attention head lies on one directed pathway between sites, causal resample ablation can isolate and test each direction of information flow. Ablating the chest-to-wrist pathway doubles error, whereas the reverse costs far less. Encoding hemodynamic structure into attention routing thus improves real-world sensing robustness and enables rigorous auditing of multi-sensor fusion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨部位变换器，利用不同身体部位脉搏波之间的血流动力学联系进行融合，在真实场景心率估计中提升准确性，并支持对信息流方向进行审计。
AI.motivation: 单一部位的光电容积脉搏波在真实运动环境下容易受到干扰，导致心率估计误差显著增加。尽管多部位测量可提供互补信息，现有方法通常将各部位信号视为普通传感器通道，未利用同一心搏沿动脉传播时在不同部位呈现的延迟与变形关系。
AI.method: 提出跨部位变换器，将多传感器融合限制为不同光电容积脉搏波测量部位之间的交叉注意力，以此将血流动力学结构引入模型的信息路由。由于每个注意力头对应一条有方向的部位间通路，研究还通过因果重采样消融，分别检验各方向的信息流对预测的影响。
AI.result: 在目前最大的真实场景基准数据集上，该方法取得单模型最佳表现：相较此前最佳方法，误差降低21%；相较此前最佳变换器，误差降低35%。消融结果显示，移除胸部至腕部的信息通路会使误差翻倍，而移除反向通路造成的损失小得多。
AI.conclusion: 将血流动力学结构编码进注意力路由，可同时增强多部位心率估计在真实运动环境下的稳健性，并使模型融合过程更容易审计。实验还表明，不同方向的部位间信息通路并非同等重要，胸部至腕部通路对性能贡献尤为关键。

title: Data-Dependent Probability Estimation via Sample Amplification
summary:
Can we estimate the probability of an event chosen after seeing the data, without using any fresh samples? Its empirical probability can be arbitrarily misleading, while learning the entire distribution to constant accuracy requires $Θ(d)$ samples on a domain of size $d$. We show that $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{d})$ samples suffice for constant mean squared error, provided the rule choosing the event is known. More generally, our estimator handles arbitrary $[0,1]$-valued queries and runs in polynomial time given evaluation access to the rule. This sample complexity matches the known lower bound up to logarithmic factors and resolves the open question posed by Feldman, Kale, Raman, Talwar, and Tewari (arXiv:2610.41244).
  Our estimation framework relies on a new combination of sample amplification (arXiv:1904.12053 and arXiv:2201.04315) with distribution learning via online optimization. Our estimator achieves mean squared error $O(d^{3/4}/n)$ when $d\leq n$ and $\widetilde{O}(d^{1/4}/\sqrt{n})$ when $d>n$. We complement this with a lower bound of $Ω(\min\{1,\sqrt{d}/n\})$ on the mean squared error. Using our framework, we also design an efficient estimator for data-dependent queries on Gaussian distributions with unknown mean and identity covariance. Finally, we show that a smoothed variant of the problem is much (exponentially) easier. For discrete distributions, if the sample size is chosen uniformly from $\{n,\ldots,2n-1\}$, then $n=O(\log d)$ suffices for constant mean squared error.

AI.tldr: 论文研究数据依赖查询的无新样本估计：当查询选择规则已知时，可用约为平方根维度量级的样本实现常数均方误差，并给出更一般的误差界、下界及高斯分布和随机平滑情形的结果。
AI.motivation: 数据依赖查询是在观察样本后才选定的查询，因此直接用同一批样本估计可能产生任意大的偏差；但若要先学习整个离散分布并达到常数精度，通常需要与域大小同阶的样本。论文旨在弥合这两种方法之间的样本复杂度差距，并回答已有工作提出的开放问题。
AI.method: 提出一种估计框架，将样本放大与基于在线优化的分布学习结合起来。该方法适用于任意取值于零到一之间的查询；当算法能够访问查询选择规则的求值结果时，可在多项式时间内运行。论文还将框架扩展至均值未知、协方差矩阵为单位矩阵的高斯分布，并分析对样本量进行随机平滑后的离散分布问题。
AI.result: 对大小为 d 的离散域，约为平方根 d（忽略对数因子）个样本即可达到常数均方误差，且与已知下界在对数因子范围内匹配。更具体地，估计器在 d 不大于样本量 n 时的均方误差为 O(d 的四分之三次方除以 n)，在 d 大于 n 时为对数因子量级的 O(d 的四分之一次方除以 n 的平方根)；另有均方误差下界 Ω(min{1, √d/n})。对于随机平滑版本，若样本量均匀取自 n 至 2n−1，n 为对数 d 量级即可达到常数均方误差，显示该情形所需样本显著更少。
AI.conclusion: 已知查询选择规则能够显著降低数据依赖查询估计的样本需求，无须重新抽样或完整学习底层分布。论文给出了高效通用估计框架及与之相近的下界，并表明该思路也适用于特定高斯分布；此外，随机平滑可使离散情形变得指数级容易。

title: WingBench: Benchmarking How AI Agents Search for Better Designs
summary: Design search often uses cheap learned predictions to choose which candidates deserve expensive tests, but these tests can fail, especially on the unusual designs that optimization favors. We introduce WingBench, a multifidelity benchmark in which optimizers and AI agents design transonic wings with computational fluid dynamics (CFD) inside the search. They can query a learned aerodynamic surrogate and spend a fixed budget of sequential CFD evaluations, each returning a score or a failure type. WingBench grades the design each method recommends, reporting separately whether it receives a valid score and how good that score is. Using WingBench, we contribute a study of five baseline optimizers and a comparison of three AI agent methods, which produced 6,629 CFD evaluation records. Feedback helps baseline optimizers deliver valid designs when it changes their later proposals, but the differential-evolution variant does so with lower aerodynamic quality. An open-ended research agent finds designs of similar quality to the strongest baselines over 32 CFD queries, with different prior information and unmatched total computation. In early search, our reflection and planning implementations do not consistently improve on it. We release the data, code, agent prompts, and analysis scripts for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用于跨声速机翼设计的多保真基准测试，比较优化器与人工智能智能体如何在代理模型和有限次数的计算流体力学评估下搜索设计。
AI.motivation: 设计搜索常依赖成本低廉的学习模型预测来筛选候选方案，但优化过程偏好的非常规设计更容易导致高成本测试失败。现有评估若只关注设计得分，便难以反映方法能否获得有效结果及其应对失败的能力，因此需要更贴近实际搜索过程的基准测试。
AI.method: 研究提出“翼型基准测试”，让优化器和人工智能智能体在搜索过程中设计跨声速机翼。参与者可查询学习得到的气动代理模型，并在固定预算内依次进行计算流体力学评估；每次评估返回设计得分或失败类型。基准分别衡量推荐设计是否获得有效得分，以及有效设计的气动质量。研究还比较五种基线优化器与三种智能体方法，并汇集了六千六百二十九条评估记录。
AI.result: 反馈只有在能改变优化器后续提案时，才有助于其找到有效设计；但采用差分进化的变体虽然更能产出有效设计，气动质量却较低。一种开放式研究智能体在三十二次计算流体力学查询内找到了与最强基线质量相近的设计，不过其先验信息和总计算量与基线并不匹配。早期实验中，反思与规划机制未能稳定优于该智能体。
AI.conclusion: 该基准揭示，设计搜索不仅要追求得分，还必须同时考虑评估失败、反馈利用能力与计算预算。当前智能体已展现出有竞争力的设计质量，但不同方法的比较仍受先验信息和总计算量差异影响。研究公开了数据、代码、智能体提示词及分析脚本，以支持复现和后续研究。

title: Lean Census: A Distributional Analysis of AI-Generated Lean Code
summary: We compare two human-written and four AI-generated Lean libraries with Mathlib through the distributions of simple statistics of their code. For each library we measure inline claims in proofs, proof length, how often each declaration is used, and design choices such as instances and private declarations, and we read each against the variation among Mathlib's own areas. The AI-generated libraries have more inline claims per theorem, longer proofs, fewer instances, and more private declarations than the human-written ones. We release the code for the analysis as a package, lean-census, at https://github.com/project-numina/lean-census.

AI.tldr: 研究比较人工编写与人工智能生成的形式化数学库，发现两者在证明写法和库设计上存在差异，并发布了分析工具包。
AI.motivation: 人工智能生成的形式化数学代码日益增多，但其代码风格与人工编写的代码有何不同，尚缺乏系统比较。研究借助数学库内部不同领域的差异作为参照，分析这些差别。
AI.method: 比较两个人工编写和四个人工智能生成的证明器库，并将它们与大型数学库进行对照。统计指标包括证明中的行内断言数量、证明长度、各声明被使用的频率，以及实例声明和私有声明等设计选择；同时参考大型数学库不同领域本身的统计差异。
AI.result: 相较于人工编写的库，人工智能生成的库每个定理包含更多行内断言，证明更长，实例声明更少，私有声明更多。
AI.conclusion: 简单代码统计能够揭示人工编写与人工智能生成的形式化数学库在证明结构和设计选择上的差异。研究还发布了用于开展此类分析的软件包，供后续研究使用。

title: PFN-Syn: Generating Synthetic Tabular Data with Prior-Data Fitted Networks
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. VLDB 2026 Workshop: Tabular Data Analysis (TaDA). Code: https://github.com/brains-group/table-agent-toolkit
summary: Synthetic tabular data can help enable data sharing and model development in privacy-sensitive domains, but existing generators often require dataset-specific training and substantial computation. We introduce PFN-Syn, a training-free framework for synthetic tabular data generation based on prior-data fitted networks. We evaluate PFN-Syn against training-based generators on eight binary classification datasets. PFN-Syn achieves the highest average downstream utility among evaluated synthetic generators, with higher generation throughput than training-based baselines, while maintaining competitive distributional similarity and distance-to-closest-record privacy behavior. Our results suggest that tabular foundation models can serve as useful building blocks for practical synthetic tabular data generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需针对具体数据集训练的合成表格数据生成框架，在下游效用、生成速度及隐私相关表现之间取得较好平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有合成表格数据生成器通常需要针对每个数据集单独训练，且计算开销较大，限制了隐私敏感领域中的数据共享与模型开发。
AI.method: 提出基于先验数据拟合网络的免训练框架，用于生成合成表格数据；并在八个二分类数据集上，将其与需要训练的生成器进行比较。
AI.result: 在所评估的合成数据生成器中，该框架的下游效用平均表现最高，生成吞吐量也高于需要训练的基线方法，同时保持了有竞争力的数据分布相似度和最近记录距离隐私表现。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，表格基础模型可作为实用合成表格数据生成的有效组件，尤其有望降低针对特定数据集训练所需的计算成本。

title: When a Permitted Action Completes a Forbidden Workflow: Designing Consequence-Oriented Approval for LLM Agents
comment: Under Review at the 41st AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI-27)
summary: Tool-using language-model agents increasingly ask people to approve consequential actions, yet an approval prompt shows only the next step. A request to send a file to an approved recipient can look harmless even when that file was assembled, several steps earlier, from data the user said must never leave. We call this a cumulative authorization failure and argue that it is an interaction design problem as much as a security problem. The evidence a reviewer needs is spread across the trajectory, and listing it in time order leaves the reviewer to reconstruct the causal chain. We present the Cumulative Consent Ledger (CCL), an approval interface built on four design principles that restate the user's intent, bind the review to the exact action, compose the cumulative consequence, and keep every claim checkable. A trusted monitor that tracks artifact lineage supplies the evidence. In a between-subjects study with 80 participants and 960 approval decisions, CCL was associated with fewer unsafe approvals than an evidence-matched chronological log (24.2% vs. 32.5%), higher comprehension, and faster decisions, although the adjusted difference in unsafe approvals remained uncertain (-7.9 points, 95% CrI [-19.7, 3.8]). In a system evaluation, the monitor detected 89.2% of 120 violating checkpoints and, used as an execution gate, reduced executed unsafe effects from 43.3% to 5.0% for one agent at a small cost to benign completion. We derive implications for designing consent around consequences rather than individual calls.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“累积同意账簿”，将审批重点从单次操作转向整条行动链造成的后果；初步结果显示其有助于提升理解并减少不安全批准，但效果仍存在不确定性。
AI.motivation: 工具型语言模型可能在多步操作中逐渐形成敏感结果，而审批界面通常只展示即将执行的单一步骤，导致看似无害的操作掩盖了此前数据处理造成的累积风险。按时间顺序罗列证据，也要求审核者自行还原因果链。因此，作者将累积授权失效视为安全问题与交互设计问题，并主张围绕行动后果设计同意机制。
AI.method: 作者设计了“累积同意账簿”审批界面，遵循四项原则：重申用户意图、将审核绑定到确切操作、整合累积后果，并使每项说明都可核查。界面证据由可信监控器提供，该监控器追踪数据与产物的来源关系。研究通过一项包含八十名参与者、九百六十次审批决策的对照实验，将该界面与证据数量相同的时间顺序日志进行比较；另对监控器进行系统评估，并测试将其用作执行门控的效果。
AI.result: 在参与者实验中，使用累积同意账簿时的不安全批准比例为百分之二十四点二，对照组为百分之三十二点五；参与者理解程度更高，决策速度也更快。不过，校正后的不安全批准差异为减少七点九个百分点，百分之九十五可信区间为负十九点七至正三点八个百分点，仍无法确定实际降低幅度。系统评估中，监控器在一百二十个违规检查点上检出百分之八十九点二；作为执行门控时，一种智能体造成的不安全执行效果从百分之四十三点三降至百分之五点零，但良性任务完成率略有损失。
AI.conclusion: 审批机制不应只评估眼前的单次调用，而应呈现行动链如何累积并改变数据与产物的风险。累积同意账簿及其来源追踪监控器显示了这一设计方向的潜力，但实验结果仍不足以确认其对不安全批准的稳定改善，且执行门控可能牺牲部分良性任务完成率。

title: Optimal User-Level Private Stochastic Convex Optimization and Mean Estimation with Heavy Tails
summary: We study stochastic convex optimization with heavy-tailed stochastic gradients under $(\varepsilon, δ)$-user-level differential privacy, which protects each user's entire collection of samples. Instead of assuming a uniformly bounded Lipschitz constant, we only assume bounds on the second- and $k$-th moments of the random sample Lipschitz parameters. This allows for unbounded, heavy-tailed stochastic gradient distributions and can lead to sharper excess risk bounds. We characterize the minimax optimal excess population risk up to logarithmic factors. Our algorithm achieves the optimal rate with only $\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon)$ users. As a byproduct of our algorithmic developments, we obtain tight bounds for user-level private mean estimation under norm-moment assumptions, improving over the guarantees of Esfandiari et al. (2022) and Zhao et al. (2024). Finally, for mean estimation under the directional-moment assumption of Agarwal et al. (2025), we close their remaining approximate-DP gap by removing the additional $d/\varepsilon$ user requirement and attaining the optimal sample complexity up to logarithmic factors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究重尾随机梯度下的用户级差分隐私凸优化，在较弱的矩条件下刻画近乎最优的超额风险，并改进用户级私有均值估计的样本复杂度界。
AI.motivation: 现有分析常假设随机样本的利普希茨常数一致有界，难以适用于梯度可能无界、呈重尾分布的场景。本文希望在仅有二阶矩和高阶矩有界的条件下，研究用户级差分隐私凸优化的最优风险，并弥补相关私有均值估计结果中的样本复杂度缺口。
AI.method: 作者基于样本利普希茨参数的二阶矩与高阶矩假设，分析重尾随机梯度下的用户级私有凸优化，并构造达到最优收敛速率的算法。同时，将算法分析用于用户级私有均值估计，分别处理范数矩假设和方向矩假设下的问题。
AI.result: 论文将超额总体风险的极小极大最优界刻画到对数因子范围内；所提算法以约为一除以隐私参数 ε 的用户数达到最优速率。在范数矩条件下，论文给出紧的用户级私有均值估计界，改进了此前结果；在方向矩条件下，则消除了先前结果中额外的一除以 ε 倍维数用户需求，使样本复杂度达到对数因子意义下的最优。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，处理重尾梯度并不必依赖一致有界的利普希茨常数；在适当矩条件下，仍可实现近乎最优的用户级差分隐私凸优化，并推进两类私有均值估计问题的最优样本复杂度界。

title: HiPPO Functional Memory: Coordinate-Queryable Attention for Irregular Time Series
summary: Irregular time series are recorded at nonuniform times and are often queried at other times: between observations, after the last one, or on a regular grid. Continuous-time models answer such queries by integrating latent dynamics, and time-aware attention models answer them by revisiting the observation tokens. We introduce HiPPO Functional Memory (HiPPO-FM), an attention operator that writes an irregular history into a rank-M function space with explicit time coordinates. Masked self-attention first exchanges content among the observations; the updated values are then contracted against kernel-smoothed HiPPO-Legendre features and solved through a regularized Gram matrix, so the retained coefficients define a function that is read at any time through the same features. The write and read have the form of an interdomain sparse Gaussian-process mean: every readout lies in an M-dimensional reproducing-kernel subspace, and a pointwise bound separates the approximation error of this subspace from the error of the learned memory. Removing the functional memory from the encoder raises Spiral reconstruction RMSE 18-fold. The full model has the lowest error in 11 of 12 Spiral settings, the highest overall accuracy and best average rank on 20 irregular UEA datasets, the highest event-type accuracy on all five multi-type event benchmarks, and a 21% lower extrapolation MSE than CRU on PhysioNet. Because the memory has fixed rank, the state retained after encoding keeps a fixed size as the history grows and is 102 times smaller than a token cache at 1,024 observations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种固定秩的功能记忆注意力机制，将非规则时间序列压缩为可在任意时刻读取的连续函数表示，并在多项重建、分类和外推任务中取得优异结果。
AI.motivation: 非规则时间序列的查询时刻常与观测时刻不同，包括观测点之间、最后一次观测之后或规则时间网格上。连续时间模型通常需要积分潜在动力学，时间感知注意力则依赖重新访问观测标记；两者都未能直接提供一种紧凑、可在任意时刻读取的历史表示。随着历史增长，保存全部观测标记的存储成本也会增加。
AI.method: 提出希波功能记忆注意力机制。首先通过带掩码的自注意力让观测之间交换内容，再将更新后的观测值与带平滑核的希波勒让德特征结合，并通过正则化格拉姆矩阵求解记忆系数。所得系数定义一个可用相同特征在任意时刻读取的函数。该写入与读取过程具有稀疏高斯过程均值的形式；每个读出都属于一个维数为记忆秩的再生核子空间，并给出点态误差界，将子空间近似误差与学习记忆误差区分开来。
AI.result: 移除功能记忆后，螺旋数据重建均方根误差增至原来的十八倍。完整模型在十二种螺旋设置中的十一种误差最低，在二十个非规则时间序列数据集上取得最高总体准确率和最佳平均排名；在五个多类型事件基准上均取得最高事件类型准确率。在物理网络数据外推任务中，其均方误差比连续递归单元低百分之二十一。记忆秩固定，因此编码后状态大小不随历史长度增长；观测数为一千零二十四时，存储量仅为标记缓存的约百分之一。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将历史压缩为带显式时间坐标的低秩函数记忆，能够兼顾任意时刻查询、有限存储和良好预测性能。该机制为非规则时间序列提供了一种紧凑且可解释的注意力式表示；不过，摘要未提供各任务的绝对指标、统计显著性或不同记忆秩下的详细消融结果。

title: PAMS: Preconditioned Activation-Metric Subspace for Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-tuning
summary: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization provides a computationally efficient approach to fine-tuning large language models (LLMs), but conventional methods typically rely on isotropic perturbations that ignore the anisotropic structure of neural-network parameter spaces. We introduce Preconditioned Activation-Metric Subspace (PAMS), a ZO optimization framework that uses forward-pass activation statistics to construct structured, layer-wise perturbation geometries without computing gradients or forming dense curvature matrices. PAMS tracks a low-rank approximation of the dominant activation subspace and its associated spectrum online, and uses the spectrum to softly reweight perturbation variance while preserving exploration in directions outside the retained subspace. A trace normalization separates the perturbation geometry from its overall scale, enabling consistent perturbation magnitudes across layers. We show theoretically that the resulting perturbation covariance induces right-side preconditioning of the gradient of the corresponding Gaussian-smoothed objective. We further characterize the estimator's smoothing bias and second moment and derive a nonconvex convergence guarantee that captures the effects of the perturbation geometry and smoothing radius. The proposed low-rank tracking procedure requires $\mathcal{O}(n_l r)$ persistent memory for a layer with input dimension nl and retained rank r, avoiding the $\mathcal{O}(n_l^2)$ memory required by a dense activation covariance. Experiments on transformer-based language-model fine-tuning tasks across GLUE and SuperGLUE demonstrate that PAMS improves the effectiveness and stability of zeroth-order optimization while retaining its gradient-free and objective-evaluation-based advantages.

AI.tldr: 论文提出预条件激活度量子空间方法，利用前向传播中的激活统计构造分层、低秩的扰动几何，提升大型语言模型零阶微调的效果与稳定性，同时避免计算梯度和存储稠密曲率矩阵。
AI.motivation: 传统零阶优化通常采用各向同性扰动，未能利用神经网络参数空间的方向差异，可能导致搜索效率和稳定性不足。另一方面，直接构造稠密激活协方差矩阵需要较高的计算与存储成本。论文旨在设计一种无需梯度、又能利用网络结构信息的高效扰动方案。
AI.method: 该方法在线跟踪各层激活主导子空间的低秩近似及其谱信息，并据此柔性调整扰动方差；对保留子空间之外的方向仍保留探索能力。通过迹归一化将扰动几何与总体尺度分离，使各层扰动幅度更一致。理论上，扰动协方差相当于对高斯平滑目标的梯度施加右侧预条件；论文还分析了估计偏差与二阶矩，并给出非凸优化收敛保证。每层持续存储开销为输入维度与保留秩的乘积，而稠密协方差需要输入维度的平方级存储。
AI.result: 在多个基于变换器的语言模型微调任务中，实验显示该方法相较零阶优化基线提升了优化效果与稳定性，同时保留了无需梯度、仅依赖目标函数评估的特点。摘要未提供具体数值，因此无法比较提升幅度。
AI.conclusion: 利用前向传播激活统计构造低秩、分层的预条件扰动，是改进大型语言模型零阶微调的一种兼顾效率与结构感知的途径。该方法在避免稠密矩阵存储的同时获得理论收敛分析和实验支持。

title: Don't Train It, Write It: An AI Agent Writes New Capabilities into Language Model Weights
summary: We show that an AI agent can write new capabilities into a pretrained language model by adding gated attention heads and MLP neurons inside its existing layers, without backpropagation and without fitting any weight to the answers of task examples. It has a budget of 50 model passes and sees no validation or test instance. Composed in one model, its modules for six BIG-Bench Hard (BBH) subtasks raise the normalized BBH score of Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct from 19.95 to 41.05 (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct: at most 35.01) and that of Gemma-3-1B-it from 10.25 to 32.86. Against the unmodified model at the same precision, both composites leave the next-token distribution on 1,023,000 WikiText tokens unchanged (KL exactly 0), give identical answers on 15,845 items of five other Leaderboard tests and identical scores on the other 18 BBH subtasks. The agent also writes exact multiplication up to 20 digits, running the model only up to 6 (100.0% on the absent lengths of the sealed test in both models; a LoRA with the same budget: at most 2.1%). Sets, rules and report sentences were sealed in git before the first session (manifests timestamped in Bitcoin), with dated amendments listed in Appendix D; a frozen evaluator ran the sealed test once. Verdicts (H5: tracking; H6: composite; H8: one pass vs. chain of thought; H9: fresh and rewritten instances; H10: side effects; H12: multiplication), on the preregistered sealed test, Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct: H5 success, H6 success, H8 (web_of_lies) success, H9 success, H10 (composite) success on (i) to (iii), (iv) confirmed, H12 success; Gemma-3-1B-it (H7: H5, H6, H8 and H9 in this model): H5 success, H6 success, H8 (web_of_lies) success, H8 (tracking 3) success, H9 partial, H10 (composite) success on (i) to (iii), (iv) confirmed, H12 success. Not everything worked: 4 of 45 single modules show small side effects and 5 of 50 sessions hit the 12-hour limit without a module.

AI.tldr: 研究展示了一种无需反向传播、也不利用任务答案拟合权重的方式：智能体可在预训练模型现有层中增添模块，以扩展特定能力，同时在多项受测内容上保持原模型行为不变。
AI.motivation: 传统地为语言模型增加能力通常需要训练，并可能改变模型在无关任务上的行为。本文探索能否在不接触验证集或测试集、不针对任务答案调整权重的条件下，为模型写入新能力，并以严格封存测试检验能力提升与副作用。
AI.method: 智能体在最多50次模型运行的预算内，向模型现有层加入带门控的注意力头和多层感知机神经元；不使用反向传播，也不根据任务示例的答案拟合权重。针对六个困难推理子任务的模块被组合到同一模型中。研究预先封存任务集合、规则和报告文本，并由冻结的评估程序仅运行一次封存测试；另以词元预测分布、其他基准题目及不同位数乘法测试检查副作用和泛化。
AI.result: 组合模块将两种受测模型在困难推理基准上的归一化得分分别从19.95提升至41.05、从10.25提升至32.86；作为对照，较大的同系列模型最高为35.01。模型在102.3万个维基文本词元上的下一词分布与未修改模型完全一致，散度为零；在另外五项测试的15,845道题以及其余18个困难推理子任务上，答案或得分也保持一致。乘法方面，模型只运行至六位数，却在封存的缺失位数测试上对最长20位乘法达到100%正确率，而相同预算下的低秩适配基线最高为2.1%。封存测试的多数预注册检验通过；其中一项模型的改写实例检验仅部分通过。与此同时，45个单独模块中有4个出现轻微副作用，50次会话中有5次因达到12小时限制而未产生模块。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，直接在模型内部增添结构模块，可能以较低训练成本获得显著的定向能力提升，并在所测范围内维持原有行为；封存测试和行为一致性检查为这一主张提供了支持。但少量副作用、未完成的会话及部分检验未完全通过，说明该方法仍需更广泛复现，并进一步评估其可靠性与适用边界。

title: AMP-OD: Active Model Probing for Unsupervised Outlier Model Selection--Extended Version
comment: 25 pages. An extended version of "AMP-OD: Active Model Probing for Unsupervised Outlier Model Selection" accepted at KDD 2027
summary: Outlier detection is often deployed in fully unsupervised settings, where labels are unavailable and practitioners must choose a detector without direct performance feedback. Existing unsupervised outlier model selection methods predict detector quality from static meta-features and historical performance on meta-datasets, but they commit before observing how any detector behaves on the target dataset. We propose AMP-OD, an execution-conditioned probe-then-commit framework. AMP-OD runs a small number of inexpensive probe detectors, uses their score patterns as target-dataset evidence, and then selects a final detector from a larger candidate pool. To interpret unlabeled probe responses, we introduce a Leave-One-Out Family Probe Posterior (LOO-FPP), which converts probe score patterns into gated detector-family evidence while reducing self-validation in pseudo-label construction. AMP-OD further combines this evidence with historical reliability through a warm-start prior, a sequential probe/stop policy, and lower-confidence-bound arbitration. Extensive experiments and ablation studies show that detector responses provide useful evidence beyond static meta-features, with the LOO-FPP and conservative arbitration as key contributors.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种先探测、后选择的无监督异常检测器选择框架，利用目标数据上的少量探测结果提升最终选择。
AI.motivation: 在无监督异常检测中，通常没有标签可用于直接评估检测器。现有选择方法主要依赖静态数据集特征和历史数据集上的表现，因此在目标数据上尚未观察检测器行为前就作出选择，可能无法适应目标数据的实际特性。
AI.method: 框架先运行少量、成本较低的探测检测器，再根据其在目标数据上的异常分数模式，从更大的候选池中选择最终检测器。论文提出留一法家族探测后验，将探测分数模式转化为带门控的检测器家族证据，并通过留出一个检测器来减少伪标签构造中的自我验证偏差。此外，框架结合历史可靠性形成热启动先验，采用序贯探测与停止策略，并通过下置信界仲裁作出保守选择。
AI.result: 大量实验和消融研究表明，检测器在目标数据上的实际响应能够提供静态数据集特征之外的有效信息；留一法家族探测后验和保守仲裁是方法效果的重要贡献因素。
AI.conclusion: 在无标签的异常检测器选择任务中，先以低成本探测目标数据，再依据探测证据选择检测器，是对仅依赖静态特征和历史表现的有效补充。结合历史可靠性、控制探测过程并进行保守仲裁，有助于提高选择的适应性与可靠性。

title: State of Mind: Learning and Evaluating World Models of Naturalistic Brain Dynamics
summary: Understanding naturalistic brain activity requires going beyond the stimulus alone, as external inputs continuously interact with an individual's evolving brain state. A world model captures such dynamics in a latent state by inferring it from neural observations, predicting stimulus-driven evolution, and updating with new observations. However, existing brain world models fail to maintain a persistent latent state over time, and standard metrics of neural prediction accuracy cannot tell whether a model tracks an individual's brain state or relies solely on the stimulus. To directly test state inference, prediction, and updating, we introduce BrainStateBench, which evaluates a model's latent state through a frozen linear probe on whole-cortex, movie-driven fMRI. Its State task tests whether a model captures trial-to-trial variability in an individual's responses to repeated stimuli, while Forecast and Updating evaluate future activity predictions without and with new observations, respectively. To track individual brain state across time, we propose Spectator, a linear latent world model trained with a joint-embedding predictive objective. Spectator encodes short- and long-horizon observation histories into a two-timescale latent state and predicts state transitions linearly from the current state and stimulus. Stimulus-only encoders reach 0.320 in fMRI prediction correlation without observing the brain (0% on State), while prior deep brain world models reach 0.239 yet score at most 0.4% on State. In contrast, Spectator achieves 0.349 correlation alongside 5.5% on State, 16.0% on Forecast, and 20.3% on Updating, outperforming all baselines while forecasting over 20x faster than deep forecasting models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出脑状态评测基准与线性潜在世界模型，检验模型是否真正追踪个体脑状态，并在预测表现、状态识别和速度上优于基线。
AI.motivation: 自然情境下的脑活动不仅由外部刺激决定，也受个体不断变化的内部脑状态影响。既有模型难以在时间上维持潜在状态，而常用的神经活动预测准确率也无法区分模型是在追踪个体脑状态，还是仅依据刺激作出预测。
AI.method: 作者提出脑状态基准，基于电影刺激下的全皮层功能磁共振成像，以冻结的线性探针评估潜在状态。基准包含三项任务：状态任务检验模型能否捕捉同一刺激重复呈现时个体反应的差异；预测任务评估不接收新观测时的未来活动预测；更新任务评估结合新观测后的预测。作者还提出旁观者模型：采用线性潜在世界模型和联合嵌入预测目标，将短期与长期观测历史编码为双时间尺度状态，并依据当前状态和刺激线性预测状态转移。
AI.result: 仅使用刺激的编码器，神经活动预测相关系数为0.320，但状态任务得分为0；既有深度脑世界模型的相关系数为0.239，状态任务得分至多为0.4%。旁观者模型的相关系数达到0.349，状态、预测和更新任务得分分别为5.5%、16.0%和20.3%，优于所有基线；其预测速度超过深度预测模型的20倍。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，单看神经活动预测准确率不足以判断模型是否掌握个体脑状态。通过直接评估状态推断、未来预测及观测更新，旁观者模型展示了追踪动态脑状态的能力，并以线性结构实现了较高预测性能与显著速度优势。

title: DisSparse: Pipelined Top-$p$ Sparse Attention for Long-Context LLM Serving
summary: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by the memory demands of the key-value (KV) cache, whose size scales linearly with context length. Dynamic sparse attention reduces this bottleneck by fetching and attending only to a critical subset of tokens. The dominant primitive in dynamic sparse attention research and deployment is fixed-budget top-$k$ selection, which is favored because its deterministic block count aligns with the static memory allocation that systems like vLLM rely on. Top-$k$ uses a fixed budget regardless of how attention mass is distributed across heads, layers, and decode steps, leading to either wasted bandwidth on heads with peaky attention or dropped context on heads with diffuse attention. Top-$p$ (nucleus) selection adapts naturally to this variation but has seen limited adoption in production serving systems due to two system-level challenges: variable block counts that break deterministic block allocation and computationally expensive selection kernels that exceed the cost of attention itself. We present DisSparse, a serving system that integrates top-$p$ sparse attention into vLLM end-to-end. DisSparse decouples block selection from the scheduler's critical path, hides selection latency behind layer computation via a two-stream pipeline, and introduces a single-pass histogram-based top-$p$ kernel. We further observe intra-block sparsity, the inflation of selection budgets caused by mixing high- and low-importance tokens within fixed-size KV cache blocks, and address it with a token relocation kernel guided by accumulated prefill attention scores. Across long- and medium-context benchmarks on multiple models, DisSparse achieves 1.17x to 1.80x speedup in sparsity analysis (block selection) over state-of-the-art top-$p$ methods with negligible accuracy loss and supports up to 8x larger maximum batch sizes than dense vLLM under the same memory budget.

AI.tldr: 论文提出稀疏注意力服务系统，通过自适应选择重要键值块、隐藏选择开销并优化块内布局，降低长上下文推理的内存与带宽压力。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理的键值缓存随上下文长度线性增长，造成显著的显存和带宽负担。现有固定预算选择无论注意力分布如何都选取相同数量的块，可能在注意力集中的头上浪费带宽，也可能在注意力分散的头上丢失重要上下文。按累计注意力概率质量自适应选择虽更灵活，却因块数不固定、选择计算开销大，难以用于生产服务。
AI.method: 论文提出稀疏注意力服务系统，将自适应概率质量选择集成到推理框架中。系统把块选择从调度关键路径中分离，并通过双流流水线将选择延迟隐藏在层计算之后；同时设计单遍直方图选择内核以降低计算开销。此外，论文指出固定大小缓存块可能混合重要性不同的令牌，导致选择预算膨胀，因此依据预填充阶段累计的注意力分数重新安置令牌，减少块内稀疏性。
AI.result: 在多种模型的长上下文和中等上下文基准测试中，该系统的块选择速度较先进的自适应概率质量选择方法提升一点一七至一点八倍，准确率损失可忽略。在相同内存预算下，其支持的最大批量规模可达到稠密推理系统的八倍。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，自适应稀疏注意力能够兼顾不同注意力分布下的上下文保留与资源利用。通过将选择过程与服务调度及层计算协同设计，并优化缓存块内令牌布局，可以将这种方法高效用于生产推理，从而提升长上下文服务能力。

title: SAFE-DRIFT: Data Selection for Supervised Fine-tuning with Controllable Off-Target Drifts
summary: We propose SAFE-DRIFT, a data-selection framework for supervised fine-tuning that improves a target capability while controlling unwanted drift in the model's other behaviors. We formalize this as a constrained optimization problem that maximizes alignment with the target gradient, subject to a budget on off-target drift which we quantify using the Fisher information of a reference distribution. Under this objective, the optimal, closed-form update is a damped natural-gradient step that downweights reference-sensitive directions. To estimate these high-dimensional gradients and work within the right geometry, we further derive a scalable algorithm that approximates the Fisher information and the target gradient in a shared low-dimensional subspace and analyze how entanglement of the target and reference task can affect the update. We evaluate SAFE-DRIFT against state-of-the-art data selection methods across diverse domains including coding and medical question answering, yielding competitive target performance while reducing degradation on specified off-target behaviors.

AI.tldr: 提出一种监督微调数据选择框架，在提升目标能力的同时限制模型其他行为的退化。
AI.motivation: 监督微调可以增强特定目标能力，但也可能意外损害模型在其他任务或行为上的表现。现有数据选择方法难以明确控制这类目标外漂移，因此需要一种能在优化目标能力时量化并约束副作用的方法。
AI.method: 将数据选择形式化为约束优化：最大化更新方向与目标任务梯度的对齐程度，同时以参考分布的费舍尔信息度量并限制目标外漂移。由此得到闭式最优更新，即阻尼自然梯度步骤，并降低对参考分布敏感方向上的更新幅度。为适应高维场景，进一步在共享的低维子空间中近似费舍尔信息与目标梯度，并分析目标任务与参考任务相互纠缠时对更新的影响。
AI.result: 在编程、医学问答等多个领域的评测中，该方法相较于先进的数据选择方法取得了有竞争力的目标任务表现，同时减少了指定目标外行为的退化。摘要未提供具体数值或显著性检验结果。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过将目标能力提升与目标外漂移控制纳入统一优化过程，为监督微调中的数据选择提供了一种可扩展的方法。实验结果表明，它能够在保持目标任务效果的同时，更好地保护模型的其他指定行为。

title: Tight Mistake-Abstention Tradeoffs for Sequential Prediction under Adversarial Injections
summary: We study the sequential prediction problem introduced by Goel et al. (2023), where an adversary can inject arbitrarily many corrupted instances in an i.i.d. stream from a clean distribution $μ$, while the learner is allowed to abstain from making a prediction at no cost if the current instance was indeed injected. When $μ$ is unknown, Yu and Blanchard (2026) show a polynomial tradeoff between mistakes and false abstentions for classes with finite VC dimension and oblivious adversaries, but still leave open a significant gap between upper and lower bounds in their tradeoff landscape. In this paper, we propose the weighted shattering potential, and based on variants of this potential, provide gap-closing algorithms that essentially characterize the tradeoffs under various settings of interest: When $μ$ is known, our algorithm improves over Goel et al. (2023) and achieves their conjectured $O(d\log T)$ mistake bound; When $μ$ is unknown, for oblivious adversary, our guarantees are tight both in $T$ and in terms of the VC dimension $d$, which completely characterizes the abstention-mistake tradeoff in this setting and gives an $O(\sqrt{dT})$ balanced rate. For adaptive adversary, our results are tight up to $\operatorname{poly}(dD\log T)$ factors for structured classes with finite so-called reduction dimension $D$. Our guarantees also extend to censored feedback, where the label is hidden after an abstention.

AI.tldr: 论文提出加权打散势及其变体，弥补序贯预测中错误与误弃预测权衡的上下界差距，并在多种对手和反馈设定下给出近乎最优的算法保证。
AI.motivation: 研究关注带有恶意注入样本的序贯预测：学习者可以对注入样本弃权，但对干净样本弃权会产生代价。已有结果在分布未知且对手非自适应时，虽给出了错误数与误弃数之间的多项式权衡，却仍存在显著的上下界差距；其他设定下也有改进空间。
AI.method: 提出加权打散势，并构造该势的不同变体，用于设计针对不同信息条件、对手能力和反馈方式的预测算法。分析覆盖干净分布已知或未知、非自适应或自适应对手，以及弃权后标签被隐藏的删失反馈情形。
AI.result: 分布已知时，算法将错误数改进至与论文所述猜想一致的量级，即关于时间步数为对数级、关于类别复杂度为线性级。分布未知且对手非自适应时，错误数与误弃数的保证在时间步数和维克斯勒—查韦利维度上均达到紧致量级，完整刻画该设定下的权衡，并实现两者平衡时的平方根级速率。对自适应对手，在具有有限归约维度的结构化类别上，保证与最优界相差至多关于维度及对数时间的多项式因子；相关保证也适用于删失反馈。
AI.conclusion: 加权打散势为分析恶意样本注入下的序贯预测提供了统一工具。论文在若干重要设定中弥合了既有上下界差距，刻画了错误与误弃预测之间的基本权衡，并将结果扩展到更强的对手及删失反馈场景。

title: Understanding and Mitigating the Fragility of Self-Rewarding Optimization
summary: Self-rewarding optimization (SRO) promises to improve language models by enabling them to generate their own reward signals. Yet when and how SRO succeeds or fails remains poorly understood. We reveal that SRO is fundamentally fragile: even seemingly benign perturbations to training prompts can corrupt the self-generated preference signal and trigger iterative collapse. We demonstrate this through two prompt-level attacks that serve as controlled stress tests: a Re-Ranking attack that concentrates training on prompts where self-reward diverges from an oracle, and a Preamble attack that learns short prefixes inflating self-reward without any gain in oracle quality. To explain why these attacks succeed, we introduce self-reward fidelity (SRF), a metric quantifying on-policy agreement between self-evaluated and oracle rewards. We show that SRF can serve as a diagnostic signal of self-supervision reliability, and that controlled SRF perturbations induce a phase-transition region: SRO improves when SRF remains sufficiently high, but collapses once SRF drops below a model- and task-dependent threshold. This analysis motivates Projection Decoupling Defense, which suppresses SRO update components along directions to which the reward generator is locally sensitive, improving SRO robustness under adversarial conditions. This work sheds light on the fragility of SRO and charts promising directions toward making it more robust.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示自奖励优化容易受提示词扰动影响，并提出衡量自评可靠性的指标及提升鲁棒性的防御方法。
AI.motivation: 自奖励优化让语言模型自行生成奖励信号，但其在何种条件下有效、何时会失败仍不清楚。论文关注一个关键风险：即使是看似无害的训练提示词变化，也可能扭曲模型的偏好判断，导致训练过程逐步崩溃。
AI.method: 研究设计了两种提示词级压力测试：重新排序攻击，将训练集中到模型自评与预言机评价不一致的提示词上；前缀攻击，则学习能抬高自评奖励、却不改善预言机评价质量的短前缀。为分析自监督信号的可靠性，论文提出自奖励保真度指标，用于衡量模型自评奖励与预言机奖励在当前策略生成样本上的一致程度。研究还通过控制该指标的变化，考察其对训练表现的影响，并提出投影解耦防御，抑制更新中沿着奖励生成器局部敏感方向的分量。
AI.result: 实验表明，自奖励优化具有根本脆弱性：两种提示词攻击都能破坏自生成偏好信号并诱发迭代式性能崩溃。自奖励保真度可作为自监督可靠性的诊断信号；其影响呈现相变特征，即保真度足够高时优化能够提升性能，低于依赖模型和任务的阈值后则会崩溃。投影解耦防御能提升模型在对抗条件下的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 自奖励优化的成败取决于自评信号与外部评价的一致程度，提示词层面的微小扰动也可能使其失效。自奖励保真度为评估这一风险提供了工具，而投影解耦防御展示了改善鲁棒性的可能方向。

title: DRAM: Memory-Efficient Muon via Rank Reallocation in Principal-Random Subspaces
summary: Memory-efficient Muon methods aim to reduce storage overhead while preserving strong performance, yet existing approaches compromise either convergence guarantees or practical efficiency. In this paper, we focus on subspace optimization for Muon, where the choice of subspace determines the gradient information retained for updating. To preserve dominant information while providing the coverage needed for stochastic convergence guarantees, we construct a principal-random subspace that combines leading singular directions of the stochastic gradient with random directions sampled from their orthogonal complement. Under a fixed rank budget, there is a trade-off between principal exploitation and complementary coverage, making rank allocation important for practical optimization. Our key observation is that the preferred balance shifts from principal-heavy early in training to random-heavy later. Motivated by this shift, we propose \dram, a memory-efficient Muon optimizer that reallocates principal and random ranks across stages while maintaining momentum and performing matrix-sign normalization entirely in the subspace. Theoretically, we establish convergence guarantees for general rank-allocation schedules with nondecreasing coverage factors, obtaining rates of $O(T^{-1/4})$ in the stochastic setting and $O(T^{-1/2})$ in the deterministic setting, with fixed allocation as a special case. Using a simple linear reallocation schedule, \dram achieves the best low-memory performance across three pre-training scales and nine fine-tuning settings.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种动态分配子空间秩的低内存优化器：训练早期侧重梯度的主导方向，后期增加随机方向覆盖，在保持理论收敛保证的同时提升实际性能。
AI.motivation: 现有低内存穆翁优化方法难以同时兼顾存储效率、实际优化效果和随机情形下的收敛保证。子空间决定了更新时保留哪些梯度信息；固定的主导方向与随机方向比例，难以适应训练不同阶段的需求。
AI.method: 构造主成分—随机混合子空间：纳入随机梯度的主要奇异方向，并从其正交补空间采样随机方向。在固定秩预算下，按训练阶段动态调整两类方向的秩分配，早期偏重主导方向、后期偏重随机方向；同时在子空间内维护动量并完成矩阵符号归一化。理论上分析覆盖因子非递减的一般秩分配方案。
AI.result: 理论分析给出随机情形下随迭代次数呈四分之一次方衰减的收敛速率，以及确定性情形下呈二分之一次方衰减的收敛速率；固定秩分配是该分析的特例。实验中，采用简单线性重分配方案的方法，在三个预训练规模和九种微调设置中取得低内存条件下的最佳表现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，低内存优化的子空间分配不必在训练全程保持不变。依据训练阶段动态平衡主导信息利用与随机方向覆盖，可以兼顾内存效率、实践性能和收敛保证。

title: Bridging Teacher-Student Capability Gaps with Recurrent Computation
summary: Knowledge distillation transfers capabilities from large language models to smaller students, yet stronger teachers do not always yield better students. Recent studies report diminishing or even negative returns from teacher scaling. We hypothesize that these limitations arise in part from insufficient student capacity to absorb the teacher's knowledge. We therefore investigate loop and recurrent computation as a way to expand the student's effective capacity by modifying its computation graph while keeping the backbone parameter count fixed. Under teacher-forced KD during pretraining, weight-shared looping improves performance but retains teacher-size saturation, whereas cross-token recurrence avoids the observed reversal with larger teachers. In mathematical post-training under both teacher-forced KD and on-policy distillation (OPD), recurrent students scale better with increasing teacher size than looped and vanilla LLMs do. Crucially, we show that a pretrained LLM can be readily fine-tuned into a looped or recurrent architecture jointly with OPD, without repeating pretraining. Our recurrent Qwen model improves with larger teachers and consistently outperforms looped and vanilla LLMs. This suggests a new post-training paradigm that integrates architectural conversion into distillation, avoiding a separate conversion stage while substantially improving student performance and maintaining near-vanilla inference latency.

AI.tldr: 研究通过循环计算与跨词元递归扩大学生模型的有效计算能力，并在蒸馏过程中直接完成架构转换，使小模型更能吸收大型教师模型的知识。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏通常期待更强的教师带来更好的学生，但已有研究发现，教师规模增大后，学生收益会趋于饱和，甚至出现性能下降。论文认为，部分原因是学生模型容量有限，难以充分吸收教师知识，因此探索在不增加骨干参数量的前提下，通过改变计算图提升学生的有效容量。
AI.method: 论文比较了参数共享的循环计算、跨词元递归计算与普通语言模型。在预训练阶段采用教师强制式知识蒸馏；在数学任务的后训练阶段，则比较教师强制式蒸馏与策略上蒸馏。研究还将预训练语言模型直接微调为循环或递归架构，并与策略上蒸馏联合进行，无需单独重复预训练或设置独立的架构转换阶段。
AI.result: 预训练蒸馏中，参数共享的循环计算虽能提升表现，但仍会随教师变大而出现收益饱和；跨词元递归则避免了观察到的性能反转。在数学后训练中，递归学生随教师规模增长的表现优于循环模型和普通模型的扩展趋势。研究提出的递归问答模型能够从更大的教师中持续获益，并稳定优于循环与普通模型；其推理延迟也接近普通模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过改变计算图而不增加骨干参数量，可以提升学生吸收教师知识的能力，其中跨词元递归在扩大教师规模时尤其有效。将架构转换融入蒸馏后训练，有望形成新的模型训练范式，在避免额外转换阶段的同时提升学生性能，并基本维持普通模型的推理效率。

title: BitShare: Sensitivity-Aware Binning and Bit Sharing for Compacting LLM Weight Storage
summary: Decoding with large language models at small batch sizes is limited by memory bandwidth, so the bits stored per weight largely set its cost. Group-wise integer quantization stores every weight of a group at the same precision, although the input channels of a group differ in sensitivity. We present BITSHARE, a codebook-free weight format that keeps the integer grid and the dequantizer of group-wise quantization but varies precision within each group. Sensitivity-aware binning places the channels of each group into three bins at fixed positions, and static bit sharing with optimal bit-value allocation lets the less sensitive weights share their lower bits, each stored once per group or once per pair of weights. A sharing-aware version of GPTQ chooses every stored value, with no fine-tuning and no codebook. BITSHARE has two modes. BITSHARE-U gives every group the same layout, so its decoder routes bits by fixed wiring, while BITSHARE-N chooses a layout per group within the same bit budget. With calibration on the Pile and at the same storage, both modes have lower perplexity than GPTQ at 3 and 2 bits on WikiText-2 and C4. At 2 bits across Llama-2 and Llama-3 models, BITSHARE-N lowers WikiText-2 perplexity by up to 70% against SliM-LLM and up to 35% against GPTAQ. At the 2-bit perplexity of SliM-LLM, BITSHARE-U stores 13.6-19.4% fewer bits per weight, cutting DRAM weight traffic by the same fraction. A verified hardware decoder implementation synthesized in SkyWater 130 nm reconstructs BITSHARE weights at the throughput of INT-n and SliM-LLM decoders.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种组内按通道敏感度分配不同精度、并共享低位存储的权重量化格式，在相同存储预算下改善低比特推理的精度与存储效率。
AI.motivation: 小批量大语言模型解码常受内存带宽限制，权重存储位数因而直接影响推理成本。传统分组量化让同组权重使用相同精度，忽略了组内不同输入通道对量化误差的敏感度，导致低比特预算未能充分利用。
