Beyond the curve, information helps and effort does not: related runs in the prompt cut the error on loss curves by 39%, and knowledge of training dynamics lets the strongest LLMs order all 36 pairs of runs that differ by a described code change, which the early curves do not separate, whereas tools add little. This knowledge can be learned from logged runs: a small open model trained on public runs matches the best LLM on loss curves. Applied to the progress curves of research agents, the same reading ranks tasks by their remaining headroom, although for a single agent run it does not improve on the last value. We release the benchmark, the trained readers, and their training data to test and train LLMs' understanding of training and to help research agents decide which runs deserve their compute.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“茶叶”基准，用真实训练日志评估大语言模型能否根据训练配置及前五分之一的曲线预测后续表现，并判断哪些实验值得继续投入算力。
AI.motivation: 研究智能体已能提出研究想法并运行实验，但通常会把每次训练都执行到底。研究者则会结合实验配置和曲线初期走势，及时停止前景不佳的实验。要做到这一点，不仅要理解训练方法，还要掌握设计选择如何影响训练过程。论文旨在测量并提升大语言模型对训练动态的理解能力。
AI.method: 作者构建“茶叶”基准，收集涵盖预训练、微调和强化学习的682次真实训练记录。预测者可查看每次运行的配置、描述、代码及前五分之一的训练曲线，并预测剩余曲线。研究比较了11种大语言模型与多类曲线预测基线，还考察相关训练记录、工具和训练动态知识的作用，并利用公开日志训练小型开源模型。最后，将曲线解读方法用于研究智能体的进展曲线。
AI.result: 在平滑损失曲线上，表现最强的大语言模型达到0.66的预测技能，超过最佳曲线拟合方法的0.62；在噪声较大的强化学习奖励曲线上，大语言模型为0.43，优于基线的0.13。社区训练记录较稀疏时，所有方法的预测能力都明显下降，也都无法可靠地提前识别失败运行。提供相关训练记录可使损失曲线预测误差降低39%；掌握训练动态后，最强模型能正确排序全部36组仅在所描述代码改动上不同的实验，而初期曲线无法区分这些实验。使用工具带来的收益有限。由公开日志训练的小型模型，在损失曲线预测上达到最佳大语言模型的水平。用于研究智能体时，该方法能按任务剩余进展空间排序，但对单次智能体运行的预测并未优于直接采用其最新数值。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型能够从早期曲线及实验背景中推断训练后续走势，尤其能利用关于训练动态的知识，而不只是依赖曲线外推；这类能力也可通过公开训练日志习得。不过，预测效果受日志记录质量限制，且当前方法尚不能可靠预警失败运行，也未改善单次研究智能体运行的末值预测。论文发布基准、训练后的模型及训练数据，以支持评估和训练模型的训练过程理解能力，并帮助研究智能体决定哪些实验值得继续消耗算力。

title: Laya-IsoToken: Day-One Clinical Codebook Switching via Closed-Form Operator Compilation
comment: 21 pages, 6 main figures, 4 main tables, 1 algorithm, 2 supplementary figures, 6 supplementary tables. Code available at https://github.com/ZeqiangWangAI/Laya-IsoToken
summary: Healthcare systems periodically revise diagnostic and procedural classifications (ICD-9 to ICD-10/11), update hospital reimbursement groupers (MS-DRG), and deploy clinical coding across languages. Supervised coding networks bind clinical text encoders to fixed per-code classifier weights, forcing hospitals to re-annotate tens of thousands of records before switching codebooks, whereas standalone large language models incur high latency and hallucinate invalid codes. Here we show that day-one clinical codebook switching becomes feasible without target-labeled notes when local clinical evidence reading is decoupled from a strictly frozen multilingual concept space. Laya-IsoToken trains a clinical span reader once on source records with zero per-code classifier parameters, separating text evidence from historical disease prevalence. Given only public target code descriptions, closed-form matrix compilation aligns distributional shifts, compensates for paraphrased definitions, and deduplicates sibling codes in under three seconds, while a pre-deployment geometric residual routes unfamiliar concepts to offline language model verification. Across 32,804 MIMIC-IV ICD-9 discharges, Laya-IsoToken matches published supervised baselines (62.6% Micro-F1) while reducing active calibration error by 32%. Switched with zero target training notes to 13,783 unseen-patient ICD-10 discharges, MS-DRG groups, and multilingual cohorts, it outperforms biomedical dense retrievers, semantic crosswalks (+5.4 F1 points on ICD-10, paired $d_z = 0.49$, $p < 0.001$), and official US CMS equivalence mappings (+3.5 points, $p < 0.001$) at 9.4 ms per admission. Pairing this reader with an offline 31B verifier across 1,000 full discharge summaries lifts zero-training ICD-10 coding to 40.6% Micro-F1 (57.0% category F1, $d_z = 0.66$, $p < 0.001$) with 0.0% invalid code hallucinations.

AI.tldr: 该方法将临床文本证据提取与具体编码体系分离，仅凭目标编码的公开描述即可快速切换编码体系，无需目标数据标注；在多项测试中优于检索和官方映射方法，并可借助离线核验降低无效编码。
AI.motivation: 医疗机构会更新疾病分类、诊断与操作编码以及医保分组标准，也需要跨语言应用临床编码。传统监督模型依赖固定的逐代码分类器，切换编码体系时须重新标注大量病历；直接使用大型语言模型则可能延迟较高，并生成无效代码。因此，研究旨在实现无需目标编码标注、可靠且高效的编码体系迁移。
AI.method: 提出临床编码方法“Laya-IsoToken”：先利用源编码体系的病历训练临床文本片段读取器，不设置逐代码分类器参数，从而将文本证据与历史疾病流行率分开。切换时仅使用公开的目标代码描述，通过闭式矩阵编译校准分布差异、处理释义改写并合并相近代码。部署前利用几何残差识别陌生概念，并将其交由离线语言模型核验。
AI.result: 在32,804份重症监护病历的第九版疾病分类任务上，该方法达到62.6%的微平均F1值，与已发表的监督基线相当，并将主动校准误差降低32%。在没有目标训练病历的情况下迁移至13,783份未见患者的第十版疾病分类、医保分组及多语言队列时，其每份住院记录处理时间为9.4毫秒；第十版任务的F1值比生物医学检索器和语义对照映射高5.4个百分点，比美国官方等价映射高3.5个百分点，差异均有统计学显著性。与离线的310亿参数核验模型结合后，在1,000份完整出院摘要上的零训练第十版编码微平均F1值达到40.6%，类别F1值达到57.0%，无效代码比例为0%。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，将临床证据读取与固定代码分类器解耦，并利用目标代码描述进行快速矩阵编译，可在缺乏目标标注数据时实现高效的编码体系切换。对陌生概念增加离线核验，则有助于提升编码表现并避免无效代码。不过，摘要所述结果来自特定数据集和评测设置，实际推广仍需在更多机构、编码体系及临床场景中验证。

title: What Makes Good Data for Training Coding Agents? A Systematic Study on SWE-Gym
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Code at https://github.com/Arist12/SWE-Gym-Verified and dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Arist12/SWE-Gym-Verified
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) trains coding agents on software tasks whose hidden tests decide the reward, yet task collections check these tests only against the reference fix. We ask what makes a task good training data, focusing on the correctness of its reward labels. We audit SWE-Gym with two LLM families, and a suspected error counts only if execution reproduces it. We find that unsolved often means mislabelled: 74% of the tasks that a 9B base model never solves have a test that rejects correct fixes (a false negative), versus 20% of those it sometimes solves. We repair or remove such tasks, and the audited tasks that remain train better policies. At equal size and matched difficulty, models trained on them score 2.4 and 2.7 points higher on held-out tasks from SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro than models trained on the original tasks, whereas simply dropping the never-solved tasks shows no such gain. We further find that wrong patches that pass (false positives) make up about a quarter of all passing patches, and that new tests that catch a quarter of them do not change held-out scores detectably. A pass rate shows whether a task yields reward, not whether that reward is right, so the reward labels themselves must be checked. To this end, we release SWE-Gym-Verified with its 1,087 audited tasks, every verdict with its executed evidence, our training sets, and the full audit pipeline.

AI.tldr: 研究指出，软件智能体强化学习数据中的奖励标签可能有误；核验并修复测试集能提升训练效果，而单看任务通过率不足以判断奖励是否可靠。
AI.motivation: 强化学习代码智能体依赖隐藏测试来判定修复是否正确，但现有任务集通常只验证隐藏测试能否通过参考修复，未检查测试本身是否会错误拒绝正确修复或错误接受错误修复。因此，任务难以解决可能并非模型能力不足，而是奖励标签不正确。
AI.method: 研究者对一套软件工程训练任务进行审计，并使用两个大语言模型家族辅助检查；只有通过实际执行复现的问题才计为测试错误。审计后修复或移除有误任务，并在任务数量相同、难度匹配的条件下训练模型，与原始数据及仅移除从未解出任务的数据进行比较；此外还考察错误补丁通过测试的情况及新增测试的影响。
AI.result: 在一个九十亿参数基础模型从未解出的任务中，百分之七十四含有会拒绝正确修复的测试错误；而模型有时能解出的任务中，这一比例为百分之二十。经审计保留的任务训练出的模型，在两个独立评测集上分别高出二点四和二点七分；单纯删除从未解出的任务没有带来类似提升。约四分之一的通过测试补丁实际上是错误补丁；新增测试虽能抓出其中约四分之一，却未带来可检测的独立评测分数变化。
AI.conclusion: 任务通过率只能说明任务是否产生奖励，不能证明奖励是否正确。构建可靠的代码智能体训练数据，应直接核验奖励标签及测试证据。研究发布了包含一千零八十七个审计任务、逐项执行判定证据、训练数据和完整审计流程的经核验数据集。

title: Ontology-Compiled 2D Clinical State Fields with Bidirectional Diffusion Encoders for Zero-Training Cross-Ontology Medical Coding
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 4 main tables, 5 supplementary tables. Code available at https://github.com/ZeqiangWangAI/OCSF
summary: Healthcare systems continually revise clinical taxonomies, update reimbursement schedules, and harmonize cross-border registries. Existing automated coding models bind clinical text understanding to fixed vocabulary-specific heads, requiring manual relabeling and retraining whenever code sets change. We introduce Ontology-Compiled 2D Clinical State Fields (OCSF), a vocabulary-free framework that decouples clinical document reading from target ontology indexing so one trained encoder can switch across arbitrary medical vocabularies in seconds without target training. A single-pass bidirectional diffusion-pretrained encoder and vocabulary-free decoder map each clinical note into a fixed-dimension two-dimensional state matrix with zero code-specific parameters. Any target ontology is compiled offline on CPU from public text descriptions into a scale-invariant Tikhonov deconvolution operator that suppresses sibling-code interference while preserving source decision thresholds. Trained solely on English MIMIC-IV ICD-9 discharge summaries and evaluated without target tuning across 58,706 held-out test notes and five unseen ontologies spanning English ICD-10, MS-DRG, Spanish, Greek, and Chinese (115-185,458 codes), OCSF reaches 63.15% Micro-F1 on in-domain ICD-9 (outperforming a matched closed-vocabulary classifier and eliminating late-epoch tail overfitting) and transfers directly to 26,085 English ICD-10 codes (29.23% recall at gold cardinality), MS-DRG groups, and multilingual terminologies, compiling up to 185,458 codes in under 10 seconds on CPU with sub-millisecond GPU readout.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种不依赖目标词表专属参数的临床编码框架，可在无需目标数据训练的情况下，快速切换到不同国家、语言和版本的医学编码体系。
AI.motivation: 临床分类体系、报销规则和跨国登记标准会持续变化。现有自动编码模型通常将文本理解与固定编码词表绑定；词表更新或切换时，往往需要人工重新标注并重新训练。论文旨在将临床文本理解与目标编码体系解耦。
AI.method: 模型使用单次处理的双向扩散预训练编码器和无词表解码器，将临床记录映射为固定维度的二维状态矩阵，不设置针对具体编码的参数。目标分类体系则根据公开文本描述离线编译为尺度不变的蒂霍诺夫反卷积算子，以减轻相近编码之间的干扰，并保留源模型的决策阈值。整个过程无需针对目标体系训练。
AI.result: 模型仅在英文重症监护出院记录的第九版国际疾病分类数据上训练，并在五种未见过的编码体系上进行零样本迁移评估，覆盖英语第十版国际疾病分类、医疗保险诊断相关分组，以及西班牙语、希腊语和中文体系。对于58,706份测试记录，模型在源体系上取得63.15%的微平均F1分数，优于对照的固定词表分类器，并减轻训练后期对低频编码的过拟合。迁移至含26,085个编码的英语第十版体系时，在按真实标签数量截取预测的评估设定下，召回率为29.23%；模型也能迁移至其他分组和多语言术语体系。最多185,458个编码可在中央处理器上不到10秒完成编译，图形处理器上的读取耗时低于1毫秒。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了将临床文本编码与具体医学词表分离的可行性：同一模型可快速适配大规模、跨语言的目标编码体系，且不需要目标训练。不过，跨体系迁移的召回表现仍有提升空间；摘要未提供足够信息判断其在更广泛临床场景中的稳健性与实际部署效果。

title: Event-Driven Parameter Dynamics for Spatiotemporal Parameter-Update Application in Deep Learning
summary: Standard neural network training typically applies optimizer-generated update signals to model parameters at every iteration. This work introduces a spatiotemporal view of parameter updating and proposes Event-Driven Parameter Dynamics (EPD), which separates candidate-update generation from their application through an intermediate state with accumulation, event-triggered release, and reset. In a canonical coordinate-wise instantiation, accumulation produces temporal integration, release imposes a spatial budget, and reset separates successive inter-release intervals, while conventional dense updating is recovered as a boundary case. Across four model--optimizer configurations on CIFAR-100, EPD maintains final performance close to conventional training even when only a small fraction of coordinates are released at each step, including the 1\% regime. Matched-control experiments further show that temporal accumulation, state-dependent selection, and post-release reset each contribute to the observed behavior. Together, these results identify parameter-update realization as a controllable dimension of optimization and provide a concrete basis for studying its temporal and spatial organization separately from candidate-update generation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出事件驱动的参数更新机制，将更新信号的生成与实际应用分离；实验表明，即使每步仅释放少量参数更新，也能保持接近常规训练的最终性能。
AI.motivation: 常规神经网络训练通常在每次迭代中立即将优化器生成的更新应用于参数，因此更新信号如何积累、何时应用以及应用哪些坐标往往未被单独考察。论文旨在将参数更新的实现方式作为可独立控制的优化维度。
AI.method: 提出事件驱动参数动力学：候选更新先进入中间状态，再经历累积、事件触发释放与重置。在按坐标操作的典型实现中，累积形成时间积分，释放受空间预算限制，重置则划分连续释放之间的区间；常规的密集更新可视为该机制的边界情形。
AI.result: 在图像分类数据集上的四种模型与优化器组合中，即使每步仅释放百分之一的参数坐标更新，最终性能仍接近常规训练。对照实验还显示，时间累积、依赖状态的坐标选择以及释放后的重置均对实验表现有所贡献。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，参数更新信号的生成与落地可以分开设计和分析。事件驱动参数动力学为研究更新的时间组织与空间组织提供了具体框架，并显示稀疏、延迟释放更新在所测设置下仍可维持接近常规训练的性能。

title: Learn the Effects, Not the Examples: Implicit ICL via Attention Patching
summary: In-context learning (ICL) enables language models to adapt to new tasks from demonstrations, but repeatedly including multiple examples increases context length and inference cost. Many existing implicit ICL methods encode demonstrations as fixed vectors, limiting adaptation of the intervention to individual queries and token positions. We propose Attention-Patching, an implicit ICL method that models contextual changes in self-attention outputs through task-specific updates to attention output projections. Using query-answer pairs processed with and without a fixed demonstration set, Attention-Patching fits layer-wise affine transformations from non-contextual attention representations to the demonstration-induced output changes. Across 12 classification benchmarks and four model families, Attention-Patching achieves higher average accuracy than the evaluated implicit ICL baselines while maintaining performance comparable to explicit ICL at near zero-shot inference cost. Further experiments on diverse generation tasks demonstrate its applicability to autoregressive multi-token generation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出注意力补丁方法，通过学习逐层仿射变换，将示例带来的注意力变化压缩为任务专用更新；该方法推理开销接近零样本，并在多项分类与生成任务中表现良好。
AI.motivation: 上下文学习可让语言模型依据示例适应新任务，但每次推理都携带多个示例会扩大上下文并增加计算成本。现有隐式上下文学习方法常将示例编码为固定向量，难以根据具体查询和令牌位置灵活调整干预。
AI.method: 针对给定任务，分别用包含固定示例集和不包含示例集的方式处理查询—答案对，衡量示例对各层自注意力输出造成的变化。随后拟合逐层仿射变换，将无示例时的注意力表示映射为示例诱导的输出变化，并以此形成任务专用的注意力输出投影更新。
AI.result: 在十二个分类基准和四类模型上，该方法的平均准确率高于所比较的隐式上下文学习基线；在推理开销接近零样本的情况下，性能与显式使用示例的上下文学习相当。多种生成任务实验也表明，该方法适用于自回归的多令牌生成。
AI.conclusion: 注意力补丁通过直接拟合示例对注意力输出的影响，在减少推理时示例输入成本的同时保留较强的任务适应能力，并可用于分类及多令牌生成任务。

title: LimeTree: Linear-Memory Graph Neural Networks over Tree-Graphs for Resource-Efficient Language Modeling and Context Extrapolation
summary: The search for computationally efficient alternatives to the Transformer has yielded numerous architectures in recent years; however, most exhibit severe weaknesses in associative recall-such as key-value (KV) retrieval-and length extrapolation, where even standard Transformers struggle. This paper introduces LimeTree, a linear-complexity architecture in both memory and compute for sequence modeling. By integrating synthetic KV retrieval tasks directly into standard language modeling training, LimeTree achieves strong perplexity alongside reliable recall. Two variants were evaluated on WikiText-103 and PG-19 under strict compute constraints. On WikiText-103, LimeTree reaches a token-level perplexity of 19 in just 6 hours on four Quadro RTX 8000 GPUs, while maintaining 100\% KV retrieval accuracy even when extrapolating from a training context length of 512 to an evaluation length of 16,384. On PG-19, the model achieves a token-level perplexity of 13 in 35 hours on a single RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU with minimal hyperparameter tuning. These results position LimeTree as a competitive linear-complexity alternative to Transformers, combining superior perplexity and training throughput with robust in-context retrieval and length extrapolation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种线性复杂度序列建模架构，在语言建模中兼顾较低困惑度、键值检索能力和长上下文长度外推。
AI.motivation: 许多计算高效的变换器替代架构在关联式记忆任务（尤其是键值检索）和长度外推方面表现不足；标准变换器在这些能力上也存在困难。论文旨在探索一种兼具效率与可靠记忆能力的序列模型。
AI.method: 提出线性树架构，使序列建模的计算量和内存开销均随序列长度线性增长。训练时，将合成键值检索任务直接融入常规语言建模，并在两个文本语料上评估两种模型变体。
AI.result: 在维基文本一〇三上，模型用四块图形处理器训练六小时，达到每词元困惑度十九；训练上下文长度为五百一十二、评估长度扩展至一万六千三百八十四时，键值检索准确率仍为百分之百。在十九世纪书籍语料上，模型用单块图形处理器训练三十五小时，达到每词元困惑度十三，且所需超参数调优较少。
AI.conclusion: 摘要结果表明，线性树有望成为变换器的高效替代方案，在受限计算资源下兼顾语言建模质量、训练吞吐量、上下文检索和长度外推能力。不过，这些结论主要基于摘要所述语料、任务与实验设置，仍需更广泛的对比验证。

title: Beyond Self-Consistency: Recursive Self-Improvement at Test Time
summary: Large language models (LLMs) that continue improving after deployment (e.g., recursive self-improvement) offer a promising path toward general intelligence. Current test-time methods pursue this goal on unlabeled questions, primarily relying on self-consistency: they generate independent solutions and use majority voting to select an answer or construct training targets. This leaves earlier reasoning unused at inference and can reinforce an incorrect majority during training. Humans instead build on earlier attempts to preserve useful reasoning, correct mistakes and improve their problem-solving strategies. Following this principle, we propose Test-Time Recursive Self-Improvement (TT-RSI), a label-free framework for improving LLMs at test time through two mutually reinforcing components: (1) In-Context RSI repeatedly re-solves each question using the full previous solution as a reference, letting the model decide whether and how to use it so that inference compute builds on earlier reasoning. (2) In-Weight RSI distills successive refinements into the model's weights, enabling progress beyond an initially wrong majority and theoretically bringing the first attempt toward the model's infinite-step refinement limit. The updated model answers better and refines more effectively, generating stronger references for subsequent training. Extensive experiments show that TT-RSI improves average accuracy by +13.89% over the base model and outperforms the strongest self-consistency-based method by +4.79% under the same test-time scaling budget.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种无需标注数据的测试时递归自我改进框架，通过反复利用先前推理并将改进蒸馏到模型参数中，提升大语言模型的答题能力。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时改进方法主要依赖多次独立作答和多数投票，既没有充分利用先前推理，也可能在训练时强化错误的多数答案。论文借鉴人类逐步修正思路的方式，希望让模型保留有效推理、纠正错误，并持续改善解题策略。
AI.method: 提出测试时递归自我改进框架，包含两个相互促进的环节：一是上下文递归改进，针对每个问题反复作答，并将完整的先前解答作为参考，由模型自行判断是否以及如何利用；二是参数递归改进，将连续改进得到的结果蒸馏进模型参数，使模型能够超越最初可能错误的多数答案。更新后的模型又能产生更好的答案和参考解答，供后续改进使用。
AI.result: 实验显示，该框架相较基础模型平均准确率提升百分之十三点八九；在相同测试时计算预算下，相较最强的基于自洽投票的方法提升百分之四点七九。
AI.conclusion: 测试时改进不必局限于独立采样和多数投票。通过让后续推理继承并修正先前思路，再将改进累积到模型参数中，可以实现无需标注数据的递归提升，并在相同计算预算下取得更好的表现。

title: Unlocking the Power of Loops in Pretrained LLMs with Loop Residuals
summary: Looped Transformers iterate a shared block of layers to increase computation without adding parameters, offering stronger performance and test-time scaling. However, this power has so far required training from scratch and yielded only modest gains for LLMs. Finetuning existing models into loops is far cheaper, yet also brings only marginal gains over SFT. We propose LoopRes, an effective, scalable, and simple approach that turns loops into significant and consistent gains for pretrained LLMs. Building on Attention Residuals, LoopRes lets each looped layer attend directly to the outputs of earlier loops. Since these outputs are iterates of the same layers and become harder to tell apart, we give each a trainable loop-aware key that encodes its structural identity. Attending to all earlier loops also lets layers skip intermediate ones, so we restrict each layer to a residual window of the latest W loops, forcing every loop to build incrementally on recent ones. Across 6 pretrained LLMs from 3 model families and 9 benchmarks, LoopRes delivers significant and consistent gains: at 2x compute, it improves Qwen3-1.7B-Base by 29.1% over SFT, more than doubling the gain of the state-of-the-art baseline. The gains hold on larger models up to 30B and across all three families. More importantly, from 1.7B to 8B, LoopRes scales more steeply than SFT as compute grows, reaching a higher ceiling while needing less compute on long outputs. These results establish LoopRes as an effective looping approach, delivering both better performance and better test-time scaling.

AI.tldr: 环残差方法将预训练语言模型改造成循环计算模型，在不增加模型参数的情况下显著提升性能，并改善随测试时计算量增加而获得收益的能力。
AI.motivation: 循环式变换器通过重复使用同一组层来增加计算量，但以往通常需要从头训练，应用于大型语言模型时收益有限。将现有预训练模型微调成循环结构成本较低，却往往只比监督微调略有提升，因此需要一种能有效利用循环计算、稳定带来更大收益的方法。
AI.method: 该方法基于注意力残差机制，使循环中的每一层能够直接关注此前各轮循环的输出。由于这些输出来自同一组层、彼此较难区分，方法为每轮输出设置可训练的循环感知键，以标识其结构身份。同时，将每层可关注的范围限制在最近的若干轮循环内，形成残差窗口，促使每轮计算逐步建立在近期结果之上。
AI.result: 在三个模型系列的六个预训练模型及九项基准测试中，该方法带来显著且稳定的性能提升。计算量为两倍时，千七百亿参数规模模型的表现较监督微调提升百分之二十九点一，增益超过此前最优基线的两倍。提升也延伸至最高三百亿参数的模型。对于十七亿至八十亿参数规模的模型，随着计算量增加，该方法的性能扩展速度快于监督微调；生成较长输出时，也能以更少计算达到更高水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过为循环输出加入结构标识，并限制层间残差信息的关注范围，环残差有效提升了预训练模型循环微调的效果。实验表明，该方法兼具更强的任务性能与测试时扩展能力，为利用循环计算增强现有语言模型提供了简单且可扩展的方案。

title: Evaluating Memanto on DolphinBench for AI Agents
comment: Future version will submit to ACL
summary: Memory benchmarks built on question answering tell an agent which fact to recall. Workplace requests often leave that need implicit: to post an update in the team's channel, an agent must work out which channel from earlier interactions and use it in a tool call. We evaluate Memanto, a memory agent that ranks memories with an information-theoretic relevance score, on DolphinBench, which tests memory through 600 simulated workplace tasks, each validated as requiring memory. Running in the Hermes agent harness with GPT-6-Luna and at most 6 iterations per conversation, Memanto completes 503 tasks (83.83%). The strongest configuration reported by the benchmark's authors, Mem0 with GPT-5.6-Luna and up to 60 iterations, completes 424 (70.67%). Memanto's run also has the lowest total cost ($10.86, against $61.48 for the cheapest reported run) and the shortest median task latency (15.32s). Grading uses the benchmark's own judge, but the agent model differs, so these results compare complete systems. The memory system affects both whether an agent completes such tasks and what completion costs.

AI.tldr: 本文评估一种以信息论相关性评分检索记忆的智能体，在六百项职场任务中完成五百零三项，完成率为百分之八十三点八三，同时报告了较低成本和较短中位延迟。
AI.motivation: 常见记忆问答基准会直接提示智能体应回忆什么；但真实职场请求往往不会明说所需信息。智能体必须从过往互动中推断相关记忆，并将其用于工具调用，因此需要评估这种隐式记忆需求。
AI.method: 研究在海豚基准测试的六百项模拟职场任务上评估记忆体系统。每项任务均经验证需要调用记忆。系统使用信息论相关性评分对记忆排序，并运行于赫耳墨斯智能体框架中，采用指定的大语言模型配置，每段对话最多迭代六次。
AI.result: 该系统完成五百零三项任务，完成率为百分之八十三点八三。基准作者报告的最强配置使用记忆零系统、另一种大语言模型配置及最多六十次迭代，完成四百二十四项，完成率为百分之七十点六七。本文系统总成本为十点八六美元，低于报告中成本最低的一次运行的六十一点四八美元；任务中位延迟为十五点三二秒。评测采用基准自身的判定器，但智能体模型配置不同，因此这些结果比较的是完整系统，而非仅比较记忆模块。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，记忆系统会同时影响智能体能否完成隐式记忆任务，以及完成任务所需的成本。本文配置在该基准上取得了较高完成率、较低总成本和较短中位延迟；但由于模型配置不同，比较结论应理解为系统级结果，不能单独归因于记忆排序方法。

title: DM-Lab at TREC 2026 RAG: Multi-Query Retrieval, Ensemble Judging, and Claim-Pack Generation
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 8 tables. TREC 2026 RAG Track. Code: https://github.com/Elyasirankhah/TREC-RAG-2026
summary: We present DM-Lab-RAG-2026, a framework developed for the TREC 2026 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) track. The framework integrates large-scale evidence retrieval and citation-grounded answer generation over the 553-million-document ClimbMix-400B corpus. The retrieval architecture combines multi-query BM25, reciprocal rank fusion, ensemble relevance assessment, listwise reranking, and adaptive retrieval depth. The generation pipeline employs a claim-first strategy to extract evidence-linked atomic claims, construct cited responses, and verify source support. Across 22 development topics, the retrieval system achieved a mean nDCG@30 of 0.604. In the official evaluation, it attained a set precision of 0.455 and a manual nugget gain of 0.910. Additional experiments examine the influence of reranking, evidence selection, and citation verification on system performance. The evaluation demonstrates the potential of diversified lexical retrieval and language-model-based relevance assessment for large-scale evidence discovery. It further identifies evidence preservation and structured answer construction as key considerations for reliable RAG. This work provides a reproducible framework for investigating retrieval effectiveness and evidence-grounded generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向大规模检索增强生成的可复现框架，结合多样化检索、相关性评估、重排与证据核验，在官方评测中取得较高的人工证据要点增益。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成系统需要从海量文档中有效发现证据，并确保生成答案中的陈述有可靠来源支持。本文旨在研究大规模证据检索与有据可引的答案生成如何协同实现，并分析影响系统效果的关键因素。
AI.method: 框架在含有五亿五千三百万篇文档的语料库上运行。检索阶段结合多查询词项检索、倒数排名融合、集成式相关性评估、列表式重排和自适应检索深度。生成阶段先提取与证据关联的原子化主张，再构造带引文的回答，并核验来源是否支持相应主张。另通过实验考察重排、证据选择和引文核验的作用。
AI.result: 在二十二个开发主题上，系统的前三十名归一化折损累计增益均值为零点六零四。官方评测中，集合精确率为零点四五五，人工评定的要点增益为零点九一零。实验还表明，多样化词项检索与基于语言模型的相关性评估有助于大规模证据发现。
AI.conclusion: 该框架展示了将多阶段检索与证据约束生成结合的可行性。可靠的检索增强生成不仅需要找到相关材料，还应保留关键证据、以结构化方式组织答案，并核验引文支持。本文为后续研究检索效果与有据生成提供了可复现的实验框架。

title: Beyond Relevance: An Empirical Study of Multimodal LLMs for Diversity-Aware Recommendation Reranking
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as promising rerankers for recommendation, yet most existing approaches rely on textual item descriptions and primarily focus on relevance. In visually oriented domains such as video streaming, item images provide complementary signals that may also inform recommendation diversity. This raises two questions: when does visual information improve recommendation quality, and can multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) enhance relevance and diversity simultaneously? We investigate these questions through a training-free, diversity-aware multimodal reranking framework that jointly incorporates item images, textual metadata, and user interaction histories. We conduct an empirical study across three public Amazon Review datasets and an industrial Amazon Prime Video dataset, using both open-source and proprietary MLLMs. Our results reveal substantial domain-dependent effects: adding visual information yields up to 121.9% relative improvement in NDCG@5 on Prime Video, while producing limited or inconsistent gains on product recommendation datasets. Furthermore, MLLM-based reranking improves both relevance and category-diversity-sensitive ranking quality over a sequential recommendation baseline, achieving up to 71.0% improvement in NDCG@5 and 14.1% in $α$-NDCG@5 on Prime Video. These findings highlight the conditional value of visual information and the potential of training-free MLLMs for relevance- and diversity-aware recommendation reranking.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，图像信息对推荐的帮助取决于领域；多模态大语言模型可在部分场景中同时提升相关性与类别多样性。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型推荐重排方法多依赖文本，并侧重相关性。对于视频等视觉内容，图像可能提供补充信息并影响推荐多样性，因此需要厘清视觉信息何时有效，以及多模态模型能否兼顾相关性和多样性。
AI.method: 提出一种无需训练、具备多样性感知能力的多模态重排框架，联合利用商品图像、文本元数据和用户交互历史。研究在三个公开的亚马逊评论数据集及一个亚马逊视频平台工业数据集上，使用开源和专有多模态大语言模型开展实证评估。
AI.result: 视觉信息的效果具有显著领域差异：在亚马逊视频平台数据上，前五位归一化折损累积增益最高相对提升百分之一百二十一点九；在商品推荐数据集上，收益较小或不稳定。相较序列推荐基线，多模态模型重排在视频平台上使该指标最高提升百分之七十一，并使前五位α归一化折损累积增益最高提升百分之十四点一。
AI.conclusion: 视觉信息并非对所有推荐领域都同样有价值，其收益取决于领域特征。无需训练的多模态大语言模型重排具有同时改善推荐相关性与类别多样性的潜力，尤其适用于视觉内容丰富的场景。

title: The abc index: Exact Retrieval for Learned Sparse Representations
summary: In learned sparse retrieval (LSR), queries have tens of terms with learned weights, on which classic dynamic pruning is believed to fail, and approximate indexes such as Seismic and HNSW are considered faster than exact ones. We challenge this view with abc, an exact index built only from standard IR techniques: term-at-a-time (TAAT) evaluation, Block-Max MaxScore, binary packing and doc-id reordering. They are combined in a new design and engineered for modern CPUs. On MS MARCO encoded with four LSR models, the abc index is the fastest exact index at every k: 6.5-84x faster than the exact search of Qdrant, 13-55x faster than that of Lucene, and 2.9-18x faster than BMP with an index 5-7x smaller. Against approximate indexes, it takes 1.5-3.6x less space, and its latency grows much more slowly with k: they are up to 4.3x faster at k=10, but at k=1000 it overtakes them, by up to 7.4x. Exactness comes with an extra benefit: there are no parameters to tune.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种面向学习型稀疏检索的精确索引，证明经典动态剪枝技术经过重新设计后，能够在速度和空间效率上超越多种精确及近似检索方案。
AI.motivation: 学习型稀疏检索中的查询通常包含数十个带权词项，因此人们普遍认为经典动态剪枝难以奏效，并认为近似索引比精确索引更快。论文旨在检验这一看法，探索能否仅使用标准信息检索技术，构建兼具高效率与精确性的索引。
AI.method: 作者设计并针对现代中央处理器优化了一种精确索引，将逐词项遍历、块最大值最大分数剪枝、二进制打包和文档编号重排结合起来。实验在采用四种学习型稀疏检索模型编码的数据集上进行，并与多种精确及近似索引比较。
AI.result: 该索引在所有不同的前十项结果数量设置下，都是最快的精确索引：比一种精确搜索方案快六点五至八十四倍，比另一种快十三至五十五倍；相比块最大分数方案，快二点九至十八倍，且索引体积小五至七倍。与近似索引相比，其空间占用少一点五至三点六倍。近似索引在返回十项结果时最多快四点三倍，但随着结果数量增至一千项，该精确索引反而最多快七点四倍。
AI.conclusion: 实验挑战了“学习型稀疏检索不适合经典动态剪枝”的常见观点。经过合适的算法组合和工程优化，精确检索能够在速度、空间占用及大规模结果返回方面具备竞争力，同时无需设置近似检索所需的调节参数。

title: MADRec: Reliable Multi-Agent Reasoning with Evidence-Grounded Debate for Recommendation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are transforming recommender systems from conventional preference matching toward reasoning-driven and explainable decision-making. Multi-agent collaboration further advances this paradigm by distributing recommendation reasoning across specialized agents. However, existing frameworks rarely assess the reliability of intermediate reasoning during collaboration, allowing erroneous judgments to propagate across agents and ultimately degrade recommendation quality. To address this issue, we propose Multi-Agent Debate-based Recommendation (MADRec), an evidence-grounded multi-agent framework that enhances the reliability of multi-agent recommendation reasoning. MADRec consists of three coordinated modules. First, the Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) module enables an Interaction Agent and a Semantic Agent to analyze interaction signals and content-level semantic signals from complementary perspectives, generating diverse recommendation judgments through structured debate. Second, the Evidence-Grounded Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning (EG-RAR) module grounds the Semantic Agent's reasoning in item-level evidence and refines candidate scores by assessing how well the evidence supports the corresponding semantic claims. Third, the Judge-based Ranking Calibration (JRC) module leverages debate-derived reliability cues to adaptively calibrate interaction-based and semantic ranking results for the final recommendation. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that MADRec consistently outperforms competitive baselines and enhances the reliability of multi-agent recommendation reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于多智能体辩论的推荐框架，通过证据检索与排序校准提升推荐推理的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 多智能体推荐能够分工处理不同类型的信息，但现有方法较少评估协作过程中的中间推理是否可靠，错误判断可能在智能体之间传播，进而降低推荐质量。
AI.method: 提出基于多智能体辩论的推荐框架，包含三个协同模块：交互智能体与语义智能体分别分析用户交互信号和物品语义信息，并通过结构化辩论形成多元判断；证据检索增强推理模块为语义判断提供物品级证据，并依据证据对语义主张的支持程度修正候选评分；评审式排序校准模块利用辩论中产生的可靠性线索，自适应校准交互排序与语义排序，生成最终推荐。
AI.result: 在三个真实数据集上的大量实验表明，该框架持续优于具有竞争力的基线方法，并提升了多智能体推荐推理的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 将结构化辩论、证据支撑的语义推理和基于可靠性线索的排序校准结合起来，有助于减少不可靠判断的传播，提升推荐效果与推理可靠性。

title: PROSPER: LLMs as Sparse Retrievers for First-Stage Product Search
summary: Product search is a crucial component of large-scale e-commerce platforms, where first-stage retrieval should achieve high recall while ensuring efficient online deployment. Sparse retrieval remains attractive for this setting due to its interpretability and deployability, yet it suffers from severe vocabulary mismatch challenges, especially for short queries and product titles. Large language models (LLMs) offer strong semantic capabilities, but directly applying them to sparse retrieval in product search introduces new challenges: (i) semantic expansion may distort critical literal signals such as brand names and model identifiers; and (ii) learning meaningful sparse representations is difficult in the high-dimensional vocabulary space induced by LLMs.To address these challenges, we propose PROSPER, a framework that uses LLMs as sparse retrievers for product search while explicitly preserving lexical fidelity. PROSPER combines (i) a literal residual network that alleviates lexical expansion hallucination by reinforcing underweighted literal terms through a residual compensation mechanism; and (ii) a lexical focusing window that uses top-k selection for rapid early sparsification and effective training initialization. Extensive offline evaluations and large-scale online A/B tests demonstrate that PROSPER consistently improves over existing sparse retrievers, and provides revenue gains for industrial hybrid retrieval systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向电商商品搜索的稀疏检索框架，通过强化字面词项并聚焦高权重词项，兼顾语义匹配、词汇忠实度与在线效率。
AI.motivation: 商品搜索的首阶段召回需要高召回率和高效部署。稀疏检索易解释、便于部署，但短查询和商品标题常存在词汇不匹配。大语言模型虽有较强语义能力，直接用于稀疏检索却可能弱化品牌、型号等关键字面信息；同时，在其产生的高维词汇空间中学习有效稀疏表示也较困难。
AI.method: 提出一种利用大语言模型进行商品稀疏检索的框架，并显式保留词汇忠实度。其一，采用字面残差网络，通过残差补偿机制强化被语义扩展低估的字面词项，以缓解扩展造成的失真。其二，设计词汇聚焦窗口，利用前若干个高权重词项进行快速稀疏化，并改善训练初始化。
AI.result: 离线评估和大规模线上对照实验表明，该方法持续优于现有稀疏检索器，并为工业级混合检索系统带来营收提升。摘要未提供具体指标或提升幅度。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，将大语言模型的语义能力与字面信号保护机制结合，有望提升电商商品稀疏检索的效果与实用性；所提出的残差补偿和词汇聚焦设计，分别针对词汇失真和高维稀疏学习难题。

title: ChatGPT Can't Sell (And That's Probably a Good Thing): Buyer-Aligned AI Advice, the Sales-Representative Gap, and Evidence from Commercial Conversations
summary: AI assistants and merchant sales agents have different objectives: assistants should help buyers compare options and preserve the choice not to purchase, while sales agents also guide qualified buyers toward an authorized next step. We study this sales-representative gap with three evidence streams. In 12,178 historical English GPT-family conversations screened for commercial or transactional intent, a 279-request sample contained recommendation language in 63 first replies (22.6%) and no narrow transactional action wording. In a 56-conversation explicit-buying sample, 24 replies (42.9%) contained recommendation markers, 32 (57.1%) qualification phrases, and none transaction-specific phrases. These lexical measures do not estimate successful selling. A 2026 brand-monitoring cohort of 1,050 GPT-5.4--Gemini answer pairs over 383 purchase-related prompts showed transaction-specific phrases in 0.0% of recommendation-worded prompts, 0.21% of price/comparison prompts, and 9.52% of explicitly transaction-worded prompts. The prompts are selected, not organic shopping sessions. In a prospective pilot across five matched hypothetical product scenarios, sales instructions produced more next-step language than general-assistant instructions (5/5 vs. 2/5), but no increase in clean product choice (3/5 in both); unsupported offers and fit errors also occurred. This pilot cannot establish a population effect. A separate company-affiliated randomized field study reports higher engaged-visitor conversion for Javo, a commercially trained sales agent, than for a frontier-model agent in shared tooling, but does not identify the mechanism. We argue that apparent reluctance to sell can be appropriate for buyer-aligned assistants. Merchant agents should optimize qualified decision progress through catalog grounding, truthful authorization, and safeguards against unsuitable sales.

AI.tldr: 论文比较面向买家的通用助手与面向商家的销售代理，发现前者较少主动推动交易并不必然是缺陷；可靠的销售代理应在准确匹配和真实授权的基础上，帮助合适的买家推进决策。
AI.motivation: 通用助手与商家销售代理的目标并不相同：助手应帮助买家比较选项，并保留不购买的选择；销售代理则还应引导符合条件的买家采取获准的后续步骤。论文旨在考察助手是否存在“销售代表能力差距”，同时澄清少用促成交易的话语是否确实意味着销售表现不佳。
AI.method: 研究综合三类证据：分析历史对话和明确表达购买意图的对话，统计推荐、资格判断及具体交易措辞；考察品牌监测队列中不同购买提示下的交易措辞；在五组匹配的假设产品情境中，对比销售指令与通用助手指令。此外，论文还引用一项由公司参与的随机现场研究，比较商业训练销售代理与前沿模型代理的访客转化表现。作者强调，词语统计不等同于实际销售成功，提示样本也不是自然发生的购物会话。
AI.result: 历史对话样本中，279条请求的首轮回复有22.6%出现推荐措辞，没有出现狭义的交易行动措辞；明确购买意图样本中，42.9%出现推荐标记、57.1%出现资格判断用语，均无针对具体交易的措辞。品牌监测数据中，推荐类提示的具体交易措辞比例为零，价格或比较类提示为0.21%，明确交易类提示为9.52%。五组假设情境中，销售指令比通用助手指令更常促成下一步表达（五组对二组），但未增加明确且恰当的产品选择；两种指令下均有三组作出此类选择，且出现了无依据的优惠承诺和产品匹配错误。另有一项公司参与的现场研究报告称，商业训练的销售代理带来了更高的参与访客转化率，但无法据此确定提升的具体机制。
AI.conclusion: 助手不积极推动购买，可能是符合消费者利益的行为，而非能力不足。商家代理的目标不应只是增加成交话语或转化，而应推动合适买家的决策进展；这需要依据可靠商品目录提供信息、确保销售承诺确有授权，并设置防止向不适合的买家推销的保障。现有小规模试点和观察性证据不足以证明普遍效果，仍需更大规模、机制明确的评估。

title: Who Gets Re-ranked When a Clinical Model Gains New Data?
comment: Accepted at the 6th International Workshop on Multi-Modal Medical Data Analysis (MMMDA), IEEE BigData 2026
summary: Hospitals often update a deployed risk model by adding a data source, such as laboratory results, that only some patients have. Work on safe model updates assumes fixed inputs and so ignores patients who lack the new data. The update has no new measurements for them, yet their rank can change, and a sick patient not yet tested can drop off an alert list. We split rank-based compatibility by data availability and pair it with error correction and alert-list effects. We compared each update with ordinary retraining on the old inputs, predicting ICU admission or death and hospital admission, on 78,475 emergency department visits from MC-MED and, in a pre-registered replication, 100,000 stays from MIMIC-IV-ED at a second hospital. Radiograph report text gave no detectable gain and almost no extra re-ranking. Laboratory results improved prediction but, at both hospitals and with linear or tree models, pushed patients without labs down alert lists; linear updates also reshuffled them more than retraining did, without ranking them better. A top-20% admission list caught 4.2% of admitted patients without labs after the update, against 18.8% after retraining (second hospital: 4.9% against 22.6%), while catching more patients overall. This held for list sizes from 5% to 50% and in every patient group we checked, despite better measured calibration. Separate alert thresholds for patients with and without labs restored most or all of their catch rate at both hospitals at almost no cost. Teams should check these patients before deploying such an update.

AI.tldr: 在风险模型中加入仅部分患者拥有的化验数据，虽能提升整体预测表现，却可能让尚未接受化验的高危患者从预警名单中掉队；按数据是否可用分别设置预警阈值，可大幅缓解这一问题。
AI.motivation: 医院常通过加入新的数据源来更新已部署的风险模型，但新增数据并非人人都有。既有安全更新研究通常假设所有患者输入相同，因而忽略了缺少新数据的患者：即使这些患者没有新增测量值，其相对排名仍可能变化，未检测但病情严重者可能被排除在预警名单之外。
AI.method: 研究将基于排名的模型兼容性按新增数据的可用情况分别评估，并结合错误纠正与预警名单影响进行分析。研究比较了加入放射影像报告文本或化验结果的模型更新，与仅使用旧输入进行常规重新训练的模型。任务包括预测重症监护病房收治或死亡，以及预测住院；数据来自两家医院的急诊就诊记录，其中第二家医院的研究为预注册重复验证。研究还考察了不同名单规模、患者群体、模型类型，以及按是否有化验结果分别设置预警阈值的效果。
AI.result: 影像报告文本未带来可检测的预测增益，且几乎没有引发额外重新排序。化验结果提高了预测能力，但在两家医院及线性、树模型中，都会使没有化验结果的患者在预警名单中排名下降；线性模型更新对这类患者的排序扰动还大于常规重新训练，却没有更好的排序表现。以住院预警名单覆盖排名前百分之二十为例，更新后名单仅覆盖百分之四点二的无化验住院患者，而常规重新训练覆盖百分之十八点八；第二家医院相应为百分之四点九与百分之二十二点六。该现象在名单规模为百分之五至百分之五十、以及所有受检患者群体中均存在，尽管模型校准度有所改善。按有无化验结果分别设置阈值，可在两家医院恢复大部分或全部此类患者的覆盖率，且几乎不增加代价。
AI.conclusion: 新增数据源带来的整体预测提升，不代表对所有患者都更安全；尤其要关注缺少新增数据的患者，其预警机会可能显著下降。医院部署此类模型更新前，应专门检查这些患者的排名与名单覆盖情况，并考虑按数据可用性设置不同预警阈值。

title: MoR4Rec: Mixture-of-Recursion for Sequential Recommendation
summary: Sequential recommender systems aim to predict a user's next interaction by modeling temporal dependencies in historical behavior sequences. To capture such dependencies, recent approaches increasingly rely on attention-based architectures, particularly transformers. While effective at modeling long-range sequential patterns, these models apply a fixed computation depth to all interaction items, treating them as equally complex. However, user behavior is inherently heterogeneous, with many interactions following simple repetitive patterns, whereas others require modeling higher-order dependencies. This mismatch leads to inefficient utilization of model capacity and unnecessary computational overhead, particularly in deep transformer-based architectures. To address this issue, we propose MoR4Rec, a sequential recommendation framework based on a Mixture-of-Recursion paradigm, which enables item-wise adaptive computation through a shared transformer backbone. A learned routing mechanism dynamically assigns each item to an appropriate recursion depth, allocating deeper computation to complex interactions while processing simpler patterns more efficiently. To improve computational efficiency, we develop a cascade-based strategy with key-value sharing across recursion steps. We further introduce a gated attention mechanism that adaptively regulates contextual information during recursive sequence modeling. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets show that MoR4Rec consistently outperforms strong transformer-based baselines, achieving average gains of 2.28% in Recall@5, 2.50% in NDCG@5, and 2.0% in MRR@5 over the strongest baseline. The improvements remain consistent across top-10 and top-20 recommendation cutoffs, while comparisons with vanilla transformers demonstrate the computational efficiency of adaptive recursive processing.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MoR4Rec，通过为序列中的不同交互项动态分配递归计算深度，在提升推荐效果的同时减少不必要的计算。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 Transformer 的序列推荐模型通常对所有交互项使用相同的计算深度，但用户行为复杂度存在差异：重复、简单的行为无需深度建模，复杂行为则需要捕捉高阶依赖。统一计算会造成模型容量利用不充分和额外开销。
AI.method: MoR4Rec采用共享 Transformer 主干与混合递归机制，并通过学习式路由器为每个交互项动态选择递归深度，使复杂行为获得更多计算、简单行为以较低成本处理。为提升效率，模型在递归步骤间采用级联式键值共享；此外引入门控注意力，自适应调节递归序列建模中的上下文信息。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上，MoR4Rec 相较最强基线的平均 Recall@5、NDCG@5 和 MRR@5 分别提升 2.28%、2.50% 和 2.0%。在前十和前二十推荐指标上也保持稳定优势；与普通 Transformer 的比较还显示，自适应递归处理具备计算效率优势。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，按交互项复杂度自适应分配计算深度，有助于更有效地利用模型容量。MoR4Rec结合递归计算、键值共享和门控注意力，在提升序列推荐效果的同时兼顾计算效率。

title: Structure-Exploiting Hierarchical Retrieval for Long Narrative Documents: A Precision-Oriented Alternative to Learned Abstraction Trees
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation over book-length documents must locate a small, coherent set of passages inside tens of thousands of tokens. Flat dense retrieval ignores document structure; RAPTOR instead builds a hierarchy by recursively clustering and summarizing with a language model. We study a complementary design that exploits the native structure of a document: a two-level retriever that (i) selects chapters with a hybrid BM25+dense match over chapter recaps, (ii) runs a chapter-filtered dense search, and (iii) expands top passages into contiguous, section-aware spans under a token budget, plus content-hash-gated delta ingestion to keep the index cheap to update. We evaluate on five public-domain books (113 chapter-localization queries) and on QuALITY and NovelQA (200K+ token novels). In-house, we find a seed-stable precision/ranking tradeoff: with section expansion off, hierarchical retrieval returns a higher fraction of chunks from the correct chapter (+3.3pp, Wilcoxon p=0.014); with expansion on, ranking improves (MRR, p=0.040). Accuracy differences are not significant. On QuALITY, hierarchical retrieval beats flat top-k (81.0% vs 70.4%, p=0.0019) and matches the full article (p=0.74). On NovelQA, hierarchical and flat retrieval are statistically tied (55.7% vs 56.8%, p=0.24); hierarchy helps aggregation questions while flat wins on localized facts. Against a faithful RAPTOR baseline we find a complementary tradeoff, not superiority. Delta ingestion reuses 94 to 99.7% of embeddings on incremental edits. We make no claim of semantic chapter-boundary inference and scope claims to English narrative prose.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用书籍原生章节结构的分层检索方案：先定位章节，再检索段落，并按章节与篇幅约束扩展上下文；在部分基准上优于平面检索，但总体优势依任务而异。
AI.motivation: 长篇文档包含数万乃至数十万词，检索系统需要从中找出少量连贯且相关的段落。平面稠密检索忽略章节结构；递归聚类与摘要虽能建立层级，却依赖重新组织文档。本文探索直接利用原有章节结构，改善检索相关性并降低增量更新成本。
AI.method: 构建两层检索器：首先对章节摘要结合关键词匹配与稠密匹配，筛选候选章节；然后仅在候选章节内进行稠密检索，并在令牌预算内将高排名段落扩展为连续、符合小节结构的文本片段。另以内容哈希判断是否需要更新，使未改变内容的嵌入向量得以复用。
AI.result: 在五本公版书籍的章节定位测试中，关闭片段扩展时，正确章节中的检索块比例提高3.3个百分点；开启扩展后，平均倒数排名有所改善，但准确率差异均未达显著。在质量问答基准上，分层检索准确率为81.0%，高于平面前若干项检索的70.4%，并与全文输入表现相当。在长篇小说问答基准上，两种方法无显著差异：分层检索有利于综合类问题，平面检索更擅长定位具体事实。与递归聚类摘要基线相比，结果体现为互补取舍，而非全面胜出。增量编辑时可复用94%至99.7%的嵌入向量。
AI.conclusion: 利用文档原生章节层级，能在某些问答任务中提升检索表现，并支持低成本增量更新；但收益取决于问题类型，不能据此认定其普遍优于平面检索或递归摘要方法。研究不主张推断语义章节边界，结论范围限于英文叙事文本。

title: Beyond Knowledge Transfer: How User Overlap Shapes Diversity in Cross-Domain Recommendation
summary: A common paradigm in cross-domain recommendation (CDR) transfers knowledge through users shared by source and target domains. Although this overlap bridge is effective in improving accuracy, its effect on diversity remains unclear. We identify two bottlenecks: the bridge can be too narrow when overlapping users cover limited target-domain tastes, and too loud when shared signals dominate the sparse personal evidence of non-overlapping users. To address both, we propose DivCDR, a model-agnostic Push--Pull framework. Pull constructs confidence-gated virtual positives for overlapping users and optimizes their exposure-entropy gain, broadening the preferences carried by the bridge. Push uses overlap-density-guided negative sampling to move non-overlapping users away from overlap-dense regions. Experiments on three datasets and five representative CDR backbones show that DivCDR improves recommendation diversity while preserving or improving accuracy in most settings.

AI.tldr: 论文提出推拉式跨域推荐框架，通过扩展重叠用户传递的偏好、减弱共享信号对非重叠用户的支配，在多数实验设置中提升推荐多样性且保持或提高准确率。
AI.motivation: 跨域推荐常借助源域与目标域的重叠用户迁移知识，这一机制能提高准确率，但对推荐多样性的影响尚不明确。论文指出两项瓶颈：重叠用户覆盖的目标域偏好有限，使知识桥梁过窄；共享信号又可能压过非重叠用户稀疏的个体证据，使其推荐偏好趋同。
AI.method: 提出模型无关的推拉框架。拉动机制为重叠用户构造经置信度门控的虚拟正样本，并优化曝光熵增益，以拓宽通过重叠用户传递的偏好。推动机制依据重叠密度进行负采样，使非重叠用户远离重叠用户密集区域，从而减轻共享信号的主导作用。
AI.result: 在三个数据集和五种具有代表性的跨域推荐骨干模型上进行的实验表明，该框架提升了推荐多样性，并在多数设置下保持或提升了准确率。
AI.conclusion: 跨域知识迁移不仅应关注准确率，也需控制共享用户信号对偏好覆盖范围和个体差异的影响。该推拉框架分别拓宽重叠用户所承载的偏好、抑制其对非重叠用户的过度影响，为提升跨域推荐多样性提供了可适配不同模型的方案。

title: Can Search Agents Correct Their Own Errors? Evaluating Retrieval, Evidence Delivery, and Answer Completion
summary: A search agent can leave an earlier error unresolved by missing the right source, overlooking a relevant passage, or failing to revise and deliver the answer after receiving the evidence. We evaluate these possibilities on BrowseComp-Plus by replaying each model's own wrong closed-book answer in conversation and intervening on what evidence reaches the model. In a supplied-evidence study spanning four open-weight checkpoints, 709 questions and 26,665 test conditions, a confident assistant prior reduced Nemotron's paired accuracy by 16.1 percentage points despite answer-bearing passages in context. When the user insisted on the prior, accuracy fell by 32.9 points for Nemotron and 12.6 for gpt-oss. Among gpt-oss responses that lost correctness in that condition, abstention was more common than repeating the prior. In separate search interventions with Qwen3.5 and Nemotron, placing a gold page first often left the decisive source unopened. Delivering a decisive passage in context improved accuracy over neutral delivery by 51.0 percentage points for Qwen3.5 and 22.4 for Nemotron. Even with the passage in context, Nemotron exhausted its search budget and returned no answer in 19 of 51 episodes. The tests distinguish failures of retrieval, passage delivery, correction and answer completion, giving system builders a way to test which changes resolve a recurring error.

AI.tldr: 研究将搜索问答错误拆分为检索、证据呈现、答案修正和最终作答等环节，发现即使关键证据已提供，模型仍可能受先前错误答案影响，或未能完成作答。
AI.motivation: 搜索代理给出错误答案后，错误可能并非只因找不到来源或漏看相关内容，也可能因为模型收到证据后没有修正答案，或未能提交答案。研究旨在区分这些失效环节，帮助系统开发者判断应改进搜索、证据传递还是答案修正与完成机制。
AI.method: 研究者在一个搜索问答基准上重放模型先前生成的错误闭卷答案，并控制模型能够接触到的证据。在证据提供实验中，使用四种开放权重模型、709道题和26,665种测试条件，考察上下文中提供含答案段落及用户坚持原有答案时的表现。另对两种模型进行搜索干预，分别测试将正确网页排在首位，以及直接把决定性段落提供给模型的效果。
AI.result: 即使上下文已含答案段落，模型对先前答案的强烈确信仍使其中一种模型的配对准确率下降16.1个百分点。用户坚持原答案时，两种模型的准确率分别下降32.9和12.6个百分点；其中一种模型在因此失去正确性的回答中，更常选择弃答而非重复原答案。搜索干预显示，把正确网页排在首位往往仍不足以促使模型打开决定性来源；直接提供决定性段落，相比中性证据呈现，使两种模型的准确率分别提高51.0和22.4个百分点。即便段落已在上下文中，其中一种模型仍在51次情境中的19次耗尽搜索预算并未给出答案。
AI.conclusion: 提供正确来源或答案证据，并不保证搜索代理能够纠正错误并完成作答。评估应分别检查检索、关键段落获取、依据证据修正以及最终答案提交等环节；这种分环节诊断有助于定位错误持续存在的原因，并指导针对性改进。

title: SuSi-RAG: A Hybrid Graph RAG for Equipment Maintenance
comment: Polished version of the accepted paper at 2026 IEEE International Conference on Knowledge Graphs (ICKG). In this revised version, some terminology has been clarified for precision. Underlying scientific data, methodology and results remain identical to the version published in IEEE ICKG 2026. Official DOI 10.1109/ICKG70389.2026.00009 resolving soon. +: The authors contributed equally to this work
summary: In the manufacturing domain, equipment maintenance tasks depend on expert knowledge. Their documentation is often stored in heterogeneous formats and sources. The enhancement of LLMs with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is promising for bridging the scattered knowledge, but traditional vector-based RAG shows weaknesses with two characteristics which are common in real maintenance queries: complex causal chains and cross-domain synthesis. To address this, we propose SuSi-RAG, a hybrid Graph RAG solution, that matches a user query and each maintenance record using subgraph similarity. This work shows an in-use system: SuSi-RAG has run on an active Bosch production line for more than eight months, handling 10,664 question-answer interactions and demonstrates upper bound answer accuracy of 96.25% (confirmed error rate 3.75%). In a proof-of-concept, SuSi-RAG improves top-1 retrieval accuracy from 61.5% to 96.2% and expert-rated answer quality from 44.9% to 84.1% against a vector-based baseline. We present an integrated operational feedback loop to update SuSi-RAG.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种结合知识图谱与检索增强生成的维护知识问答方案，在真实生产线持续运行，并在检索准确率和专家评估的回答质量上显著优于传统向量检索方案。
AI.motivation: 制造设备维护依赖专家知识，但相关记录分散于不同来源和异构格式。传统基于向量的检索增强生成难以处理维护问题中常见的复杂因果链推理及跨领域知识综合，因此需要更适合关联性知识检索的方法。
AI.method: 提出混合式图检索增强生成方案，通过计算用户问题与各条维护记录之间的子图相似度进行匹配，以支持跨记录、跨领域的知识检索与回答。系统还包含一套整合式运行反馈闭环，用于持续更新方案。
AI.result: 该系统已在博世一条运行中的生产线上部署超过八个月，处理了10,664次问答；报告的答案准确率上限为96.25%，经确认的错误率为3.75%。概念验证中，相较于向量检索基线，前一名检索准确率从61.5%提升至96.2%，专家评定的回答质量从44.9%提升至84.1%。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，基于子图相似度的混合图检索增强生成能够改善制造维护场景中的复杂知识检索与回答质量，并已展示真实生产环境中的长期应用能力。整合式反馈闭环为系统持续更新提供了机制。

title: Ask Again: Answer-List Instability in Generative Engines
summary: Visibility in generative search engines is measured by which entities appear in responses, and in what order. Ask an engine the same question twice and the answer list can change: a different ordering, or different items altogether. Across 60,000 responses, we find that answers to the same prompt name a different first item 32% of the time, and even two answers with the same items disagree on which comes first. The first position is a measurement target of its own. A "clear leader" emerges after seven or eight runs, which are the budgets recommended for brand and source monitoring, but a "close leader" only about half the time. After 25 runs, a close leader is identified only 60% of the time. Variability between engines is larger than within the same engine. For open-ended prompts, the gap is more than double that for determinate ones. Search queries and cited sites observed leave most of the disagreement unexplained. Visibility measurement should report, for each engine, which items appear and how often each comes first, each with its own quantification of uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 生成式搜索中的可见度具有显著波动；评估时应分别统计哪些实体出现、哪些实体位居首位，并为两类指标报告不确定性。
AI.motivation: 生成式搜索引擎对同一问题的回答可能在实体排序和实体构成上发生变化，因此单次回答不足以可靠衡量品牌或信息来源的可见度。研究旨在确定这种波动的程度，以及监测需要多少次重复查询。
AI.method: 研究分析了六万份生成式搜索回答，比较同一提示词重复查询所得的实体及其排序，并考察不同引擎之间、开放式与确定性提示词之间的差异。同时评估随着重复次数增加，能否识别领先实体。
AI.result: 同一提示词的回答有百分之三十二会更换首位实体；即使两份回答包含相同实体，首位也可能不同。约重复七至八次后通常可识别明确领先者，但只有约一半情况下能识别优势接近的领先者；重复二十五次后，这一比例也仅为百分之六十。引擎之间的差异大于同一引擎内部的差异，开放式提示词的差异超过确定性提示词的两倍。观察到的搜索查询和引用网站只能解释大部分分歧中的少数部分。
AI.conclusion: 生成式搜索可见度不是单一且稳定的排名指标。监测报告应按引擎分别呈现实体出现频率，以及各实体位居首位的频率，并为这两项指标分别量化不确定性；尤其在领先者差距较小时，不应仅凭少量重复查询下结论。

title: From Head to Tail: LLM-Augmented Sequential Recommendation and Trade-off Optimization
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at GRAIL 2026: Workshop on Generative, Retrieval-augmented, and Agentic Intelligence for Personalization, held at CIKM 2026
summary: Recommender systems exhibit popularity bias, often under-serving long-tail and cold-start items with sparse interaction data. We propose a group-specific data augmentation approach that leverages LLMs to generate synthetic interactions, formulated as a constrained optimization problem, maximizing group-specific NDCG@20 and coverage while bounding overall NDCG@20 degradation within an acceptable threshold. Items are partitioned by interaction frequency to find the optimal augmentation strategy for each group. We further study combining the augmentation across groups simultaneously and find that while individual optimal strategies navigate the multi-group augmentation design, they are not simply additive. We further ablate on the LLM-based augmentation itself, comparing LLM scales, augmentation configuration under token constraints, finding that augmentation quality scales with contextual richness, albeit at a proportionally higher cost. Experiments with SASRec demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach, achieving over 100% and 60% improvement in group-specific NDCG@20 for extreme and regular long-tail items, respectively, on our industrial dataset, and 40%, 25% for MovieLens-32M, while increasing their coverage without significant overall degradation.

AI.tldr: 论文利用大语言模型为不同热门程度的物品生成合成交互数据，在提升长尾物品推荐效果与覆盖率的同时，控制整体推荐性能损失。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统存在流行度偏差，交互数据稀疏的长尾物品和冷启动物品往往得不到充分推荐。统一的数据增强策略难以兼顾不同交互频率的物品群体，也可能损害整体推荐效果。
AI.method: 按交互频率将物品划分为不同群体，并将大语言模型生成合成交互的过程建模为约束优化问题：针对各群体优化截断位置为二十的归一化折损累积增益和覆盖率，同时将整体指标的下降限制在可接受范围内。研究还比较了各群体分别增强与同时增强的效果，并考察模型规模、增强配置及上下文丰富度对效果和成本的影响。
AI.result: 在基于序列推荐模型的实验中，工业数据集上的极端长尾物品和普通长尾物品，群体指标分别提升超过百分之百和百分之六十；在电影评分三千二百万条数据集上，分别提升百分之四十和百分之二十五。两类长尾物品的覆盖率均有所提高，整体性能没有显著下降。实验还发现，各群体的最优增强策略不能简单相加；更丰富的上下文能提升增强质量，但成本也相应增加。
AI.conclusion: 按物品群体定制的大语言模型数据增强，可以在整体性能可控的前提下改善长尾推荐。实际应用需联合考虑群体间策略的相互作用，以及增强质量与计算成本之间的权衡。

title: CO-GRAFT: Attributing Reinforcement Learning Gains in Search Agents via Role-Level Policy Grafting
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves large language model search agents by up to 32 exact-match (EM) points over their pre-RL initializations, yet overall accuracy gains do not identify which underlying functional capabilities improve or interact during training. We introduce CO-GRAFT, a reward-agnostic interventional attribution framework in which an RL-trained agent and its pre-RL initialization jointly generate a single trajectory under closed-loop execution with live retrieval. Each policy controls a mutually exclusive subset of four functional roles: intermediate reasoning, search-or-answer decision, search query generation, and final answer extraction. Evaluating all 2^4=16 role assignments without modifying weights or retraining defines a cooperative game whose Shapley values decompose the total RL gain across roles, while M"obius interaction terms distinguish standalone role improvements from multi-role coupling. Applying CO-GRAFT to Search-R1 agents across Qwen2.5 and Llama-3.2 models (spanning two sizes, base and instruction-tuned initializations, GRPO and PPO optimizers, and NQ and HotpotQA datasets), we show that query generation never exceeds 15% of the total gain; instead, gains are governed by pre-RL answer validity, search retention, model scale, and fixed task-level search budgets, shifting credit from reasoning toward answer extraction in larger or well-formatted answer response checkpoints while smaller base models rely on reasoning--decision coupling.

AI.tldr: 研究提出一种无需改动模型或重新训练的干预归因方法，用于拆分强化学习带来的搜索能力提升。结果显示，提升主要取决于答案提取、答案有效性、搜索保留、模型规模及任务搜索预算，而非单独依赖查询生成。
AI.motivation: 强化学习能够显著提高大语言模型搜索智能体的准确率，但整体准确率无法说明哪些功能能力得到改善，也无法揭示不同能力在训练中的协同作用。研究旨在把强化学习带来的总体收益归因到具体功能角色及其交互上。
AI.method: 研究提出一种不依赖奖励函数的干预归因框架。执行一条带有实时检索的闭环轨迹时，由强化学习后的模型和训练前的初始模型分别控制四种互不重叠的功能角色：中间推理、搜索或作答决策、搜索查询生成、最终答案提取。穷举这四种角色由两类模型分配的全部十六种组合，构建合作博弈；再用沙普利值分解各角色对总收益的贡献，并用莫比乌斯交互项区分单一角色提升与多角色协同效应。
AI.result: 在涵盖不同模型家族与规模、基础版和指令微调版初始模型、两种优化算法及两个问答数据集的实验中，查询生成贡献从未超过总收益的百分之十五。收益主要受训练前答案是否有效、搜索结果是否得到保留、模型规模以及任务固定搜索预算影响。对于规模较大或答案格式较规范的模型检查点，收益归因更多转向最终答案提取；较小的基础模型则更依赖推理与搜索决策之间的协同。
AI.conclusion: 搜索智能体的强化学习收益并非由单一的搜索或推理能力提升所决定，而是由模型条件、任务约束及多种功能角色共同塑造。该框架能够在不重新训练的情况下细粒度分析这些贡献，为理解强化学习如何改善智能体、以及如何针对具体模型和任务优化训练提供了工具。

title: GERF: A Token-Efficient Multimodal Retrieval Framework for Schema-Guided Scientific Information Extraction
summary: Scientific information extraction (IE) is a fundamental component of AI for Science, transforming experimental knowledge embedded in scientific literature into structured and traceable data for evidence synthesis, scientific database construction, and data-driven discovery. However, critical experimental details are often distributed across text, tables, figures, captions, and surrounding discussion, making them difficult to recover using conventional text-only extraction. Existing LLM-based and multimodal RAG pipelines typically rely on full-document context or coarse page-level retrieval, introducing substantial irrelevant evidence and high textual and visual token costs. We propose GERF, a Graph-based Evidence Retrieval Framework for token-efficient, schema-guided multimodal scientific IE. GERF represents each article as a heterogeneous evidence graph that connects schema fields, text chunks, figures, and figure-derived content through semantic and structural relations. Using schema fields as retrieval anchors, GERF combines direct semantic retrieval, Random Walk with Restart, and null-aware evidence expansion to construct compact, field-specific multimodal evidence packages. Visual interpretation is applied only to graph-selected figures, avoiding indiscriminate processing of the entire document. We evaluate GERF from two complementary perspectives: evidence retrieval quality and pipeline-level input-token consumption. On the expert-annotated SOFC-Exp corpus, GERF retrieves gold-supported evidence for 94.55% of the evaluated field instances, providing broad field-level evidence coverage for downstream extraction. In the token comparison, GERF reduces average input-token usage by 73.40% relative to full-context processing and uses fewer tokens than the evaluated page-level pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于异构证据图的多模态科学信息抽取框架，能够以较低输入令牌消耗检索支持实验字段的文本与图像证据。
AI.motivation: 科学论文中的关键实验信息分散在正文、表格、图像、图注及相关讨论中，传统纯文本方法难以完整恢复。现有大语言模型与多模态检索增强流程常依赖全文或粗粒度页面检索，容易引入无关信息并造成较高的文本和视觉令牌开销。
AI.method: 该框架将论文表示为异构证据图，连接信息抽取模式字段、文本片段、图像及图像衍生内容，并建立语义与结构关系。以模式字段为检索锚点，结合直接语义检索、带重启的随机游走和感知空值的证据扩展，生成紧凑且针对具体字段的多模态证据包；仅对图中筛选出的图像进行视觉解读。
AI.result: 在专家标注的固体氧化物燃料电池实验语料上，该框架为百分之九十四点五五的评估字段实例检索到有金标准支持的证据。在输入令牌对比中，相较全文处理，平均令牌用量降低百分之七十三点四，且低于所评估的页面级处理流程。
AI.conclusion: 基于证据图的字段级检索能够兼顾多模态证据覆盖与令牌效率，为科学文献中的模式引导信息抽取提供了一种更精简、可追溯的处理方案。

title: LLM-Based Assistant for Dog Care Guidance
summary: This study investigates whether domain grounding through Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and parameter-efficient fine-tuning using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) can enhance the accuracy and reliability of pet care advice generated by large language models (LLMs). We curated a dataset of breed-specific dog care information and used it to develop two systems: a RAG pipeline based on TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0, and a fine-tuned LLaMA-3.2-1B model adapted using LoRA. Both systems were evaluated on 15 dog care questions. The RAG model achieved a perfect average score of 2.0, outperforming the fine-tuned model (mean = 1.47). Statistical analyses, including Welch's t-test, Mann-Whitney U, and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests (all p < 0.05), confirmed the significance of the performance gap. Our findings suggest that retrieval-based domain grounding leads to more accurate, consistent, and trustworthy responses than standalone fine-tuning in specialized LLM applications.

AI.tldr: 研究比较检索增强生成与低秩适配微调在犬类护理问答中的表现，结果显示检索增强生成准确性更高。
AI.motivation: 通用大语言模型在犬类护理等专业领域可能缺乏具体、可靠的知识。研究旨在检验通过外部资料检索提供领域依据，或通过参数高效微调调整模型，哪种方式更能提升护理建议的准确性与可靠性。
AI.method: 研究整理了按犬种分类的护理资料，分别构建基于小型对话模型的检索增强生成系统，以及使用低秩适配微调的小型大语言模型。两种系统均以十五个犬类护理问题进行评估，并采用韦尔奇独立样本检验、曼—惠特尼检验和威尔科克森符号秩检验分析表现差异。
AI.result: 检索增强生成系统的平均得分为二分，达到满分；微调系统的平均得分为一点四七。三种统计检验均显示两者差异具有统计显著性，显著性水平小于百分之五。
AI.conclusion: 在本研究的犬类护理问答任务中，检索增强生成比单独进行低秩适配微调表现更好，说明以领域资料为回答提供依据可能有助于提升专业应用中的准确性、一致性与可信度。不过，评估仅涵盖十五个问题，结论仍需在更大规模、更多样的数据和任务上验证。

title: VistaTree: Question Answering over Long Multimodal Documents with Image-Derived Summary Trees
summary: Answering questions over long multimodal documents requires locating relevant evidence across pages containing text, tables, and figures. When the document exceeds the model's context window, selective retrieval becomes necessary. We introduce VistaTree, a document question-answering agent that builds a summary tree directly from rendered page images. VistaTree segments documents into contiguous page spans, recursively groups them into a topic hierarchy, and refines sibling summaries to distinguish neighboring sections. At query time, the agent uses node summaries to select relevant nodes and reads the corresponding pages, using hierarchical navigation when the full outline exceeds the context budget. Experiments on MMLongBench-Doc and LongDocURL evaluate answer quality and retrieval cost using a locally hosted vision-language model, and quantify the performance gap between global and hierarchical access to the index.

AI.tldr: VistaTree 从文档页面图像构建分层摘要树，帮助模型在长篇多模态文档中定位证据并回答问题。
AI.motivation: 长篇文档可能包含文字、表格和图表，相关证据分散在不同页面；当文档超出模型的上下文窗口时，无法一次读取全文，因此需要高效的选择性检索方法。
AI.method: VistaTree 直接依据渲染后的页面图像构建摘要树：先将文档划分为连续页面片段，再递归归并为主题层级，并优化同级摘要以区分相邻章节。回答问题时，系统根据节点摘要筛选相关内容并读取对应页面；若完整目录超出上下文预算，则采用层级导航。
AI.result: 研究在 MMLongBench-Doc 和 LongDocURL 上，使用本地部署的视觉语言模型评估回答质量与检索成本，并考察全局访问和层级访问索引之间的性能差异。摘要未提供具体实验数值或比较结论。
AI.conclusion: VistaTree 提出一种面向长篇多模态文档问答的分层检索方案，通过从页面图像构建摘要树，在有限上下文下逐步定位相关页面。其实际效果及检索效率仍需结合论文中的具体实验结果判断。

title: Where Do Fact-Checking Errors Arise? Separating Retrieval, Search Control and Judgement in Evidence-Grounded Verification
summary: An evidence-grounded fact-checker can fail because it does not find the evidence or because it does not use it; end-to-end accuracy does not tell the two apart. We present a protocol that follows the reference evidence from the store to the verdict and separates retrieval, search control, judgement and verdict validation. We assess 293 claims from FEVER, FEVER 2.0 and AVeriTeC with one open-weights 9B model under two evidence conditions: small stores of annotated evidence, where discovery is easy, and the full source collections. In the control condition a single hybrid retrieval pass delivers complete reference evidence for 226 of 228 evidence-bearing claims, and adaptive controllers and a tool agent spend two to nine times as many model calls without a consistent gain. Of 34 decisive claims labelled as lacking evidence, 33 have the complete evidence in the packet: in 15 the judge abstains, and in 18 validation rules overturn a decisive verdict. On AVeriTeC these rules lower single-pass accuracy by six points, to 65.0% (balanced accuracy 57.6%). Ten judges from eight model families also show abstentions and validation conversions on fixed packets. Against the full stores hybrid single-pass accuracy falls by 17 to 29 points. Wikipedia evidence recovery declines; AVeriTeC recovery changes from annotated answers to cited pages and is measured separately. No controller recovers the accuracy loss. The agent also shows no resolved gain on 714 further Wikipedia claims. Evidence recovery, judgement and validation should be measured separately before an error is attributed to search.

AI.tldr: 研究将事实核查拆分为证据检索、搜索控制、判断和结论验证，发现许多错误并非源于找不到证据，而是模型未能正确使用已找到的证据；增加搜索调用也未带来稳定改善。
AI.motivation: 端到端准确率无法区分事实核查失败究竟是因为没有检索到证据，还是因为模型没有正确利用证据。若不区分这些环节，就可能把判断或验证错误误归咎于搜索策略，进而难以准确评估系统能力。
AI.method: 研究提出一套沿着参考证据从资料库到最终结论进行追踪的评测流程，分别衡量证据检索、搜索控制、证据判断和结论验证。研究使用一个开放权重的九十亿参数模型，在小型标注证据库和完整来源资料库两种条件下，评测来自三个事实核查数据集的二百九十三条主张；此外，还用八类模型家族中的十个判断模型测试固定证据包，并在另外七百一十四条维基百科主张上评估智能体。
AI.result: 在小型证据库的控制条件下，单次混合检索为二百二十八条含证据主张中的二百二十六条提供了完整参考证据。自适应控制器和工具智能体消耗的模型调用量是控制条件的二至九倍，却未带来稳定提升。三十四条被标记为缺少证据的关键主张中，有三十三条的证据实际上已完整包含在证据包内：其中十五条被判断模型弃答，另有十八条的明确结论被验证规则推翻。在一个数据集上，验证规则使单次检索准确率下降六个百分点至百分之六十五，平衡准确率为百分之五十七点六。改用完整资料库后，混合单次检索准确率下降十七至二十九个百分点；维基百科证据恢复率降低，另一数据集则将证据恢复评估从标注答案改为引用页面，并单独报告。没有控制器弥补准确率损失，智能体在额外主张上的表现也未显示已解决的收益。
AI.conclusion: 事实核查系统的评估应分别报告证据恢复、证据判断和结论验证表现，而不能仅凭端到端准确率推断搜索是否失败。证据已被检索到，并不意味着模型会据此作出结论；验证规则本身也可能改变甚至推翻模型判断。因此，在将错误归因于搜索之前，应先定位失败发生的具体环节。

title: SHAKTI: Evidence-Grounded Conversational AI for Nutrition and Health
summary: Large language models (LLMs) answer many diet and health questions but can state unsupported claims and cite sources that do not support them. We present SHAKTI (Smart Health Advisor for Knowledge-based Tailored Interventions), a conversational assistant that answers only from retrieved scholarly papers and exact food-composition data, and evaluate it with retrieval, generation, grounding, efficiency and contextawareness metrics. We indexed 484,368,086 OpenAlex works, searched exactly on a GPU for evaluation (10,065 NFCorpus, BioASQ, SciFact and PubMedQA questions) and through a compressed 230-million-abstract index in deployment. On 1,000 stratified questions, we compared single-shot, multi-hop, corrective and deep-research retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with Claude Sonnet. SHAKTI adds conversational query rewriting, USDA FoodData Central lookups, source-link checks and online verification of quotes and numbers. It was tested in 36 scripted conversational turns, a 248-question memory-depth test and a 38-question load test. Claims were checked by a Claude Opus judge against exactly the text the system saw. MedCPT reranking of hybrid retrieval gave the best MRR (0.21) and MAP@100 (0.14). Across existing RAG methods, faithfulness was 0.95-0.96, claim hallucination 0.5-0.8% and context precision up to 0.98; the deep-research agent answered 73.2% of BioASQ questions correctly. In conversation, SHAKTI reached a context-awareness score of 97.1%, faithfulness 95.5%, 1.9% unsupported claims, no contradicted claims and 229/229 working source links; it resolved references to the first question after 16 unrelated questions. An answer cost 14,716 tokens (US$0.06) with a median latency of 24 s. Large-scale retrieval with agentic evidence selection and mechanical verification yields auditable, low-hallucination nutrition answers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出营养健康问答助手「夏克提」，通过检索学术文献与精确食物成分数据，并核验引文、链接及数值，降低营养建议中的无依据陈述。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型虽能回答饮食与健康问题，却可能生成缺乏证据的说法，或引用无法支持相关结论的来源。研究旨在构建可追溯、可靠且能理解对话上下文的营养健康助手。
AI.method: 系统仅依据检索到的学术论文和美国农业部食物成分数据作答，并结合对话查询改写、来源链接检查、引文与数值在线核验。研究建立大规模文献索引，比较多种检索增强生成策略及混合检索重排方法，并通过问答、对话记忆和负载测试评估检索、事实依据、效率与上下文理解能力；主张由模型评审员对照系统实际读取的文本进行核查。
AI.result: 混合检索配合医学文本重排取得最佳检索表现，平均倒数排名为0.21，前百项平均准确率为0.14。已有检索增强生成方法的忠实度为0.95至0.96，主张幻觉率为0.5%至0.8%；深度研究代理在生物医学问答题上的正确率为73.2%。对话测试中，系统上下文理解得分为97.1%，忠实度为95.5%，无依据主张率为1.9%，未发现相互矛盾的主张，且229个来源链接全部有效；即使经过16个无关问题，仍能正确追溯首个问题。单次回答中位耗时24秒，成本约为0.06美元。
AI.conclusion: 大规模文献检索、智能证据筛选与机械化核验相结合，有望提供可审计且较少产生幻觉的营养健康回答。结果显示系统在对话记忆、证据忠实度和来源可用性方面表现良好，但评估依赖特定数据集、测试设计及模型评审，实际临床应用仍需进一步验证。

title: Trallie: from Free-Form Text to Structured Data with LLMs
summary: Trallie is an open-source framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to perform information extraction (IE) from natural language sources with or without user guidance. Unlike conventional approaches that rely on extensive labeled datasets or domain-specific training, Trallie enables the conversion of unstructured data into structured formats with minimal or no representative examples. The framework is designed with three key objectives: (i) reducing manual annotation by harnessing prompt-based zero-shot and few-shot capabilities of modern LLMs, (ii) flexibly parsing diverse document formats (i.e., HTML, PDF, TXT, and JSON), and (iii) improving accessibility for non-expert users by automatically inducing schemas from document collections, which can then be refined for extraction. We evaluate Trallie with open-weight LLMs on FDA 510(k) documents and on movie and university websites from SWDE. It outperforms previously reported systems when the target attributes are provided for text extraction and is competitive when it must discover attributes for the schema automatically. The project is available at https://github.com/PiSchool/trallie

AI.tldr: 特拉利是一个开源信息抽取框架，利用大语言模型从多种格式的自然语言文档中提取结构化信息，减少对标注数据和专业训练的依赖。
AI.motivation: 传统信息抽取通常需要大量标注样本或针对特定领域训练模型，增加了数据准备与使用门槛。该研究旨在借助大语言模型的零样本和少样本能力，降低人工标注成本，并让非专业用户也能便捷地从异构文档中获取结构化信息。
AI.method: 特拉利通过提示方式调用大语言模型，支持在用户提供目标属性时抽取信息，也支持从文档集合中自动归纳信息模式，再由用户调整后进行抽取。框架可解析网页、便携式文档、纯文本和结构化数据等多种格式，并使用开放权重大语言模型进行评估。
AI.result: 在美国食品药品监督管理局的五一〇（Ｋ）类文件，以及结构化网页数据抽取基准中的电影和大学网站上进行评估。目标属性已知时，特拉利优于此前报告的系统；需要自动发现属性、构建信息模式时，其表现具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，提示驱动的大语言模型可支持低标注成本、格式灵活的信息抽取。特拉利将属性自动发现与后续抽取结合，降低了使用门槛；不过，摘要未提供具体指标或不同模型间的详细比较。

title: Orthogonally Mixed Sign Coding with Progressive Residual Refinement for Transformer Weight Compression
summary: LLM quantization reduces storage but often degrades predictive fidelity at low bit rates. We propose a training-free, CDF-free, Gaussian-CLT-motivated progressive residual-sign quantization framework that uses randomized orthogonal mixing to promote Gaussian-like residual distributions and improve sign based reconstruction of Transformer weights. Each stage independently normalizes residuals and analytically calibrates reconstruction, progressively recovering quantization errors. The framework enables flexible storage-fidelity trade-offs without learned codebooks, empirical CDFs, or trellis optimization. We evaluate GPT-2 Large and Llama-3-8B across attention and MLP projections. At five residual stages, joint quantization preserves near-baseline predictive fidelity, achieving perplexities of 32.16 and 12.73, compared with full-precision values of 29.89 and 11.07, respectively. Ablations further demonstrate that orthogonal mixing substantially improves reconstruction over identity-based sign coding, while activation-aware scaling improves output fidelity and reduced-precision statistics lower storage overhead with negligible perplexity degradation. Comparisons with conventional quantizers establish the method's progressive fidelity recovery and characterize its storage-quality and runtime trade-offs. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of orthogonally mixed residual-sign coding for flexible, training-free Transformer weight compression.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练、无需经验累积分布函数的渐进式残差符号量化方法，通过随机正交混合改善权重残差分布，并逐阶段恢复量化误差，在显著压缩模型权重的同时尽量维持预测性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型量化可降低存储需求，但低比特量化往往会损害预测精度。作者希望设计一种不依赖训练、学习码本、经验分布估计或复杂格点优化的压缩方案，在存储量与模型保真度之间提供灵活权衡。
AI.method: 方法受中心极限定理启发，对权重进行随机正交混合，使残差分布更接近高斯分布，从而提升基于符号的重建效果。随后采用渐进式残差编码：每个阶段独立归一化残差，并通过解析方式校准重建结果，以逐步补偿前序量化误差。方法还结合激活感知缩放，并可使用低精度统计量降低存储开销。
AI.result: 在ＧＰＴ二大型版和拉玛三八十亿参数模型的注意力与多层感知机投影层上进行评估。采用五个残差阶段时，困惑度分别为三十二点一六和十二点七三，接近全精度基线的二十九点八九和十一点零七。消融实验显示，正交混合显著优于不混合的符号编码；激活感知缩放可改善输出保真度，低精度统计量则能以极小的困惑度变化降低存储开销。与传统量化器的比较也呈现了该方法逐步恢复保真度的效果及其存储、质量和运行时间权衡。
AI.conclusion: 正交混合的渐进式残差符号编码为变换器权重压缩提供了一种灵活且无需训练的方案。实验表明，它能在控制存储开销的同时较好地保留预测性能；不过，存储质量与运行时间之间仍需根据应用需求进行取舍。

title: What Counts as Attack Success? Evaluating Harmfulness in Red Teaming LLMs
summary: Judging whether a model response is harmful requires contextual and normative choices, yet red-teaming studies often delegate this judgment to automated evaluators. We examine how harmfulness criteria are specified in red-teaming research and how they carry through to reported results. Reviewing 76 papers, we find that many adopt their criteria from prior datasets, classifiers, or judge prompts rather than defining harmfulness themselves. Applying evaluators from these papers to identical outputs, we find that they can reach different judgments on the same response, which can change conclusions when comparing models. These differences arise partly because evaluators draw the boundary of harm in different places: some count any response that does not refuse, while others count only output that could plausibly cause harm. We argue that red-teaming studies should state their harmfulness criteria and report how they chose and validated their evaluators to support more reliable measurement and interpretation.

AI.tldr: 论文指出，红队研究中“有害性”的定义及自动评估器选择会显著影响评测结果，建议明确标准并报告评估器的选择与验证过程。
AI.motivation: 判断模型回答是否有害，涉及具体语境与规范性取舍。然而，许多红队研究将这一判断交给自动评估器，却未充分说明有害性的定义，因而难以判断研究结果是否可靠、不同研究能否比较。
AI.method: 研究者回顾了七十六篇红队研究，考察其中有害性标准的来源与表述；随后将这些研究使用的评估器应用于相同的模型输出，比较其判断差异及其对模型比较结论的影响。
AI.result: 许多研究直接沿用既有数据集、分类器或评判提示中的标准，而非自行界定有害性。不同评估器可能对同一回答作出不同判断，进而改变模型优劣的比较结论。差异部分源于有害性边界不同：有的将任何未拒绝回答的情形都计为有害，另一些则只将可能实际造成伤害的输出计为有害。
AI.conclusion: 红队研究应明确说明有害性的判定标准，并报告评估器的选择依据及验证方式，以提高有害性测量的可靠性，并使研究结论得到更恰当的解释。

title: Benchmarking and Adapting LLMs for English-Swedish Medical Question Answering
summary: Large language models do well on English medical exams, but less is known about Swedish. This matters most for small open models that hospitals can run locally. To reduce this gap, we first build an item-aligned English-Swedish benchmark from ten medical multiple-choice datasets; each Swedish item keeps the options and answer of its English source. A conservative refinement loop repairs the translations: open models from three families find errors, ground them in a Swedish medical term base, and keep a model-written edit only if blind judges vote for it. On this benchmark, small models lose much more accuracy in Swedish than large ones, especially when they answer without reasoning. Second, we ask whether English data and open teacher models can close this gap. We translate the training data, let teachers write reasoning traces, and fine-tune two small students on gold answers or traces in English, Swedish, or both. Training on reasoning traces that include Swedish closes the gap and lifts the 1.2B student from 23.5\% to 52.0\% in Swedish, slightly above a 20B open model in its fast mode, with a sixth of its memory. We release the benchmark, its edit history, and the code.

AI.tldr: 论文构建英瑞医学选择题基准，并通过包含瑞典语推理过程的训练，显著提升小型开放模型的瑞典语医学问答能力。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在英语医学考试中表现良好，但其瑞典语能力研究不足。对需要在本地运行、资源有限的小型开放模型而言，语言差距尤其关键；同时，模型在瑞典语下的准确率下降幅度及缩小差距的有效训练方式尚不明确。
AI.method: 研究者从十个医学选择题数据集中构建题目一一对应的英瑞基准，确保每道瑞典语题目保留英文原题的选项和答案。随后采用审慎的迭代修订流程：由三个模型系列的开放模型发现翻译问题，依据瑞典医学术语库核查，并仅在盲评者投票认可时采纳模型修改。训练实验中，研究者翻译训练数据、让教师模型生成推理过程，并以标准答案或推理过程为监督信号，分别使用英语、瑞典语或双语数据微调两种小型学生模型。
AI.result: 小型模型的瑞典语准确率比大型模型下降更多，尤其是在不生成推理过程时。包含瑞典语推理过程的训练能缩小这一差距：一个12亿参数学生模型的瑞典语准确率从23.5%升至52.0%，略高于一个200亿参数开放模型的快速作答模式，且所需显存仅约六分之一。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，经过校验的英瑞对齐基准可用于评估医学语言能力，而在训练中加入瑞典语推理过程，是提升小型开放模型瑞典语医学表现的有效途径。作者还公开了基准、修订历史和代码，便于后续复现与研究。

title: SnakeTranslate: Weakly Supervised Policy Learning from Offline Parallel Text for Simultaneous Translation
summary: Adaptive simultaneous translation requires reliable prefix translation and timely READ/WRITE decisions, but ordinary parallel corpora provide no action annotations. We present SnakeTranslate, which adapts loss-derived alignment to sampled causal histories for jointly learning both capabilities. The framework supports supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on parallel text and on-policy distillation (OPD) with reverse Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence on student-generated translations. At inference, source and target tokens form one append-only interleaved history, enabling incremental decoding with cache reuse. On FLEURS, NTREX128, and WMT24++, our 4B model improves quality--latency trade-offs over streaming policies applied to the same offline-tuned backbone, with further gains from OPD. It also compares favorably with larger translation models at low and moderate latency, while higher-latency quality gaps remain on WMT24++.

AI.tldr: 本文提出蛇形翻译框架，从普通平行语料中学习流式翻译所需的逐步译文生成与读写决策，并通过在线策略蒸馏改善质量和延迟之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 自适应同时翻译需要模型可靠地生成部分译文，并及时决定继续读取源语还是输出目标语。但常见平行语料不含读取与写入动作标注，难以直接训练这两种能力。本文旨在利用现有平行文本，学习适用于流式翻译的动作决策与增量翻译。
AI.method: 蛇形翻译将基于损失推导的对齐关系适配到模型采样生成的因果历史中，以联合训练译文前缀生成和读写决策。训练包括平行文本上的监督微调，以及针对学生模型自身生成译文、采用反向库尔贝克—莱布勒散度的在线策略蒸馏。推理时，源语和目标语词元按交错顺序组成仅追加的历史，从而支持增量解码并复用缓存。
AI.result: 在多项翻译基准测试上，四十亿参数模型相较于将流式策略应用于同一离线调优骨干模型，取得了更好的翻译质量与延迟权衡；加入在线策略蒸馏后表现进一步提升。在低延迟和中等延迟条件下，该模型也能与更大型的翻译模型竞争；但在较高延迟下，它在其中一项基准上的质量差距仍然存在。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，无需人工提供动作标注，也能借助损失推导的对齐和模型自身生成历史，联合学习流式翻译中的译文生成与读写决策。在线策略蒸馏可进一步改善质量—延迟权衡，但高延迟条件下的翻译质量仍有提升空间。

title: Language Model Harnesses can be Compositional Generalizers
summary: Modern language models (LMs) are post-trained and deployed as agents inside a "harness", but standard harness designs accumulate context that the neural network is forced to generalize to, making training for long-horizon tasks expensive and time-consuming. We study an alternative emerging path: training inherently neurosymbolic LM harnesses, which externalize and manage context programmatically to compose existing LM capabilities. We hypothesize that training around these harnesses can offer a better return on compute by enabling compositional generalization, as they can learn to decompose complex problems so that every observation their neural LM receives is locally in-distribution, even when the full task is novel. We find that harnesses like the Recursive Language Model (RLM) learn such decompositions readily under reinforcement learning post-training: (1) we demonstrate that training only on short tasks can generalize to tasks 2-64$\times$ longer while the base neural LM improves less, and (2) training on one domain transfers to novel domains that share latent structure. On messier, complex tasks, we find that we can target individual LLM calls within a harness by generating and training on easier, synthetically generated surrogate environments with fake tool / sub-calls, a technique we call surrogate harness training. From this finding, we train RLM-27B on synthetic data, and show it improves Qwen3.8-27B in the same RLM harness on a hard suite of long-context tasks like CTC-Bench and ExpertLongBench by 26.9% on average while using $\sim$2$\times$ fewer tokens at inference time. Finally, we show that harnesses can compose over these newly learned decompositions using recursive sub-harness calls.

AI.tldr: 论文提出通过强化学习训练能够程序化管理上下文的神经符号式语言模型框架，使模型学会拆解长程任务。短任务训练可迁移至长任务和新领域；合成替代环境训练还提升了复杂长上下文任务表现，并减少推理用量。
AI.motivation: 常见的语言模型智能体框架会不断累积上下文，使模型必须适应越来越长、越来越复杂的输入，导致长程任务训练成本高、耗时久。论文希望将上下文管理与任务拆解交由程序化框架处理，让神经语言模型每次接收的内容都较为局部且符合训练分布，从而提升计算资源的使用效率和任务泛化能力。
AI.method: 研究以递归语言模型框架为代表，利用强化学习训练框架在外部管理上下文，并将复杂问题拆解为较小子任务。作者先考察短任务训练对更长任务及其他领域的迁移；针对复杂任务，则提出“替代框架训练”：在较容易合成的环境中模拟工具调用和子调用，针对框架内的单次模型调用生成训练数据。最后，通过递归子框架调用，将已学会的拆解能力组合起来处理更复杂任务。
AI.result: 仅用短任务训练，框架即可泛化到长度为训练任务二至六十四倍的任务，其表现提升超过单独改进基座语言模型的效果；在一个领域训练也能迁移到具有相同潜在结构的新领域。使用合成数据训练的二百七十亿参数递归语言模型，在长上下文任务基准上较同规模基座模型平均提升百分之二十六点九，同时推理阶段使用的词元约减少一半。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，训练语言模型智能体时，不必只让神经网络直接吸收更长的上下文；也可以训练能够管理上下文、拆解任务并递归组合子任务的框架。此路径有望以较低推理成本获得更好的长程泛化，并可借助合成替代环境扩展到难以直接训练的复杂任务。

title: Grammar-as-a-Draft: More Tokens per Speculative Decoding Step on Grammar-Constrained Structured Outputs
summary:
Under structured outputs (JSON schemas, regexes, tool calls), speculative drafters do not see the grammar constraint and repeatedly propose invalid keys, delimiters, and indentation, while the grammar engine already knows which tokens must come next.
  We present Grammar-as-a-Draft (GaaD), which treats the grammar as a second drafter. Before each verify step, the scheduler merges the drafter's proposal with grammar-forced tokens into one draft row: matching tokens stay as GRAMMAR, the proposal is cut where it leaves the forced path, and forced tokens fill the rest of a row wider than the drafter's proposal. The verify step accepts GRAMMAR drafts without computing their logits, composing with any drafter with no new kernels or compilation on the critical path. Because grammars fix text rather than tokens, committing canonical forced tokens changes the output distribution relative to grammar-masked target decoding.
  We implement GaaD in vllm-torchtpu and an independent Rust serving runtime, evaluating on TPU v7x with MTP, DFlash, and n-gram drafters on a JSON character-profile benchmark. GaaD raises average acceptance length from 2.06 to 5.43 (MTP, Qwen3.5-0.8B), 1.99 to 5.31 (MTP, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B), 1.57 to 4.13 (DFlash, Qwen3-4B), and 1.30 to 3.64 (n-gram, Qwen3-4B), decoding 2.66-2.81x faster at batch size 1 and 1.14-1.70x at batch size 64. In Rust, MTP+GaaD is 2.23x faster on Qwen3.5-0.8B, 2.02x on Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8, and 1.22x at 128 concurrent requests. Under mixed traffic (25-50% structured), GaaD finishes the workload 1.03-1.23x sooner (structured requests 2.2-3.2x sooner) while plain-text TPOT rises 7-42%. We also show grammar-masked greedy decoding can pick non-canonical tokenizations, so GaaD can yield different valid outputs that an fp32 reference finds equally likely.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“语法即草稿”方法，将语法约束直接作为推测解码的第二份草稿，显著提升结构化输出的解码速度，但可能增加普通文本请求的延迟，并改变输出分布。
AI.motivation: 在生成符合格式约束的内容时，推测解码器通常看不到语法规则，因而会反复提出无效的键、分隔符或缩进；与此同时，语法引擎已经能够确定后续必须出现的内容。让语法信息参与草稿生成，可减少无效提议和验证开销。
AI.method: 每次验证前，调度器将推测解码器的提议与语法强制要求的词元合并为一行草稿：两者一致的部分标记为语法草稿；提议偏离强制路径时即截断，并用强制词元补足草稿。验证时无需为语法草稿计算模型分数。该方法可与不同草稿器组合，且无需新增计算内核，也不在关键执行路径上增加编译步骤。由于语法约束的是文本而非词元，提交规范化的强制词元会使输出分布不同于采用语法掩码的目标解码。
AI.result: 在字符档案生成基准上，平均接受长度提升明显：不同草稿器和模型配置下，从约一点三至二点一提升到约三点六至五点四。批量大小为一时，解码速度提升二点六六至二点八一倍；批量大小为六十四时提升一点一四至一点七零倍。独立服务运行时中，速度最高提升二点二三倍；并发请求较多时仍有提升。在结构化请求占四分之一至一半的混合负载中，整体完成时间缩短约百分之三至二十三，结构化请求缩短约二点二至三点二倍，但普通文本的每输出词元延迟上升百分之七至四十二。
AI.conclusion: 将语法引擎提供的确定性信息转化为草稿，可有效加速结构化输出的推测解码，并能适配多种草稿器与服务运行时。不过，该方法存在输出分布变化和混合负载下普通文本延迟上升的权衡。论文还指出，语法掩码下的贪心解码可能选择非规范的词元切分，因此该方法产生的不同有效输出仍可能与高精度参考结果同样可能。

title: Contrastive On-Policy Distillation via Dual-Branch Supervision
summary: For on-policy distillation (OPD), more capable models are a natural choice as teachers. However, higher task performance does not necessarily imply greater teachability. A controlled token intervention study suggests that even a model weaker than the student can serve as an informative contrastive reference. Building on this observation, we propose Contrastive On-Policy Distillation (cOPD), which provides dual branch supervision by contrasting strong teacher, weak teacher, and student predictions at student generated prefixes.
