Across 20 random seeds, the final three-class model achieves a mean Macro-F1 of 73.54%, while the final binary model achieves 85.17% using validation-selected decision thresholds. Task adapted harmful-language comparators are additionally evaluated under the common training protocol, and the proposed model obtains the highest mean Macro-F1 among them. For the primary three-class task, matched backbone analyses show higher internal validation Macro-F1 with BERTurk than with TurkishBERTweet or Turkish Mamba, while substantial train-validation separation persists across all three backbones. Separate direct-transfer and zero-shot experiments examine performance without StutterStigma-TR supervision. Across the task-adapted, direct-transfer, and zero-shot comparisons, the condition-specific supervised systems retain the strongest aggregate performance.

AI.tldr: 研究构建了土耳其语口吃污名数据集，并提出面向目标的分类模型；在有监督任务中，该模型整体表现优于所比较的基线方法。
AI.motivation: 针对残障相关歧视伤害的计算研究仍较少，尤其缺乏口吃污名领域的专门资源。研究旨在补足土耳其语口吃相关社交媒体文本的标注数据与检测方法。
AI.method: 研究构建了包含六千零一十九条公开社交媒体帖文的数据集，并将文本标注为污名化、非污名化或语境相关、支持性三类。标注流程结合言语与语言治疗专业知识，并由具有相关亲身经历者独立评估。模型以土耳其语文本预训练模型为基础，融合显式目标标记、目标片段表示、目标条件化上下文、字符级与人工设计的正字法特征，以及门控话语线索。研究在三分类和二分类任务中进行消融实验、随机种子稳健性评估，并与适配后的有害语言检测模型、直接迁移及零样本方法比较。
AI.result: 最终配置依据内部验证集的宏平均F1选定。在二十个随机种子下，三分类模型平均宏平均F1为百分之七十三点五四；采用验证集选定阈值的二分类模型为百分之八十五点一七。与所比较的适配型有害语言模型相比，提出的方法取得最高平均宏平均F1。三分类骨干网络对比中，土耳其语预训练模型的内部验证表现高于土耳其语推文模型和土耳其语状态空间模型，但三种骨干网络均存在明显的训练集与验证集表现差距。直接迁移和零样本比较也显示，针对该领域进行监督训练的系统总体表现最强。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了口吃污名检测所需的专门土耳其语数据资源，并表明结合目标信息与文本、话语特征的专用监督模型具有较强效果。不过，训练与验证表现差距提示模型仍可能存在泛化局限；其表现优势也主要建立在领域专属标注数据和监督训练之上。

title: Voyag: Joint Multi-Intent Detection and Execution-Relation Classification for In-Vehicle Voice Assistants
summary: An in-vehicle voice assistant must decide not only which intents an utterance contains but also how co-active intents may be executed: concurrently, in a fixed order, or not at all without arbitration. We present Voyag, a single-forward decision model that jointly predicts ten controlled vehicle-intent slots and a three-way execution relation (parallel, sequential, mutually exclusive) over each co-active intent pair. Voyag combines a multilingual ModernBERT-style encoder (mmBERT-base, 306.9M parameters), a typed per-slot choice head, and a lightweight GroupCalibration relation head (1.61M parameters) that consumes marker hidden states, pooled context, explicit resource-requirement profiles, and symmetrized outer-product conflict features. All objectives are optimized in one joint loss: soft cross-entropy over slot choices, focal cross-entropy over relations, and a mutex-consistency penalty. On a synthetic Chinese vehicle-life benchmark with semantic scene-level splits and a leakage audit (30,017 / 3,473 / 5,000 groups), validation-only selection yields 0.9893 slot accuracy and 0.0526 expected calibration error over 50,000 slot decisions. Conditioned on gold intents, the relation head reaches 0.8548 accuracy, 0.8473 macro-F1, and 0.6062 mutually-exclusive recall over 4,000 pairs; end to end with one encoder forward it reaches 0.8530 accuracy and 0.8464 macro-F1. Against a two-stage rule pipeline, the aggregate end-to-end gain is small and borderline, so we claim no aggregate advantage; the learned head's advantage lies in sequential and parallel recall where surface rules are blind. We report rule baselines with a tautology disclosure and a held-out thermal conflict failure.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种面向车载语音助手的联合决策模型，同时识别车辆意图并判断多个意图应并行执行、顺序执行还是互斥；在合成中文基准上表现良好，但相对规则基线的整体优势有限。
AI.motivation: 车载语音助手不仅要识别一句话包含哪些操作意图，还需判断这些操作能否同时执行、是否需要按固定顺序执行，或是否因资源冲突而不能共存。单纯依赖意图识别或表层规则，难以可靠处理这类执行关系。
AI.method: 提出单次编码器前向计算的联合模型，同时预测十类受控车辆意图槽位，以及每对共现意图之间的三类执行关系。模型由多语言编码器、按槽位类型设计的选择头和轻量关系头组成；关系头融合标记位置的隐状态、整体语境、显式资源需求特征及对称化冲突特征。训练目标联合包含槽位选择损失、关系分类损失和互斥一致性惩罚。
AI.result: 在按语义场景划分并经过数据泄漏审计的合成中文基准上，槽位准确率为0.9893，校准误差为0.0526。以真实意图为条件时，关系预测准确率为0.8548、宏平均Ｆ１为0.8473，互斥关系召回率为0.6062；端到端指标分别为0.8530和0.8464。相较两阶段规则流水线，整体增益较小且处于临界水平；模型主要在规则难以识别的顺序执行与并行执行关系上改善召回，并报告了一项未能处理的热冲突案例。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了将意图识别与执行关系预测整合到一次模型推理中的可行方案，并通过资源特征与一致性约束处理意图间的协调问题。但证据来自合成基准，互斥关系召回仍有限，且整体性能并未明确优于规则基线，因此不宜宣称具有总体优势；真实车载场景中的泛化能力仍需验证。

title: DUET: Dual-MDL Unsupervised Entropy-Trie Segmentation for Low-Resource Languages
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 20th Conference of the European Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics (EACL2027 main)
summary: Morphological segmentation, the task of decomposing words into constituent morphemes, becomes particularly challenging under extreme data scarcity, a regime that can arise in language documentation and linguistic reasoning. This difficulty stems from existing approaches' reliance on annotated data, external resources, or recurring patterns that emerge only in larger corpora. To address this limitation, we propose Dual-MDL Unsupervised Entropy-Trie Segmentation (DUET), a deterministic unsupervised algorithm that decouples structural candidate generation from statistical candidate ranking. DUET combines branching entropy with recursive paradigm discovery to generate linguistically plausible candidate segmentations, then ranks them using a dual minimum description length (MDL) criterion: a corpus-level objective rewards morpheme reuse, while a construction-tree objective guards against over-segmentation. On the SIGMORPHON 2023 interlinear glossing shared task, DUET outperforms unsupervised baselines in Morpheme F1 under both the standard and simulated extremely low-resource settings, while providing broader candidate coverage. Augmenting prompts with DUET segmentations improves performance on a linguistic reasoning benchmark, yielding the best overall results among the evaluated segmentation methods.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种无需监督数据的形态切分方法，在极低资源场景中提升切分效果，并能改善语言推理表现。
AI.motivation: 形态切分在语言记录和语言推理等数据极度稀缺的场景中尤其困难。现有方法往往依赖标注数据、外部资源，或需要较大语料才能显现的重复模式，因此难以适用于低资源环境。
AI.method: 提出一种确定性的无监督算法，将候选切分生成与统计排序分开处理。算法先结合分支熵和递归范式发现，生成具有语言学合理性的候选；再通过双重最小描述长度准则排序：语料级目标鼓励词素复用，构式树级目标则抑制过度切分。
AI.result: 在形态标注共享任务的标准设置和模拟极低资源设置中，该方法的词素精确度、召回率综合指标均优于无监督基线，并覆盖了更广泛的候选切分。将其切分结果用于提示后，语言推理基准上的表现也得到提升，在所评估的切分方法中取得总体最佳结果。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过结构化候选生成与双层统计准则，在不依赖监督资源的情况下有效应对极低资源形态切分，并显示出切分结果对下游语言推理任务的实用价值。

title: Evaluating Persona Consistency in LLM User Simulators Without External Reference Annotations
summary: Standard evaluations assess LLM-simulated personas against an external ground truth, such as community trait annotations, but that reference is unavailable when the persona is inferred only from a short, task-oriented chat. We ask how persona consistency can be evaluated without such a reference, and propose a self-anchored internal-consistency diagnostic: the persona describes itself once and acts twice. A Likert self-report supplies a soft internal anchor; two behavioral profiles come from constrained scenario choices scored without a judge and from open-ended responses judged by an LLM. Consistency is the correlation between the self-report and each behavioral profile, in a shared six-facet BFI-2 space. The framework compares persona-construction strategies by assessing how consistently their elicited responses reflect their self-reported traits. Across ordinary-user chats (WildChat and LMSYS) and well-documented personas with community annotations (the Personality Database, PDB), profile-enriched representations agree with the anchor more closely than a raw-dialogue baseline. On PDB, this self-anchored ordering reproduces the community-annotation ordering. The pattern is stable across answering and judge models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种不依赖外部人格标签的评估方法：比较角色自述的人格特征与其行为表现是否一致。结果显示，补充人格档案的构建方式优于直接使用原始对话。
AI.motivation: 现有评估通常需要社区标注等外部真实参照，但根据简短、以任务为导向的聊天推断角色时，这类参照往往不存在。因此，论文关注如何在缺少外部标准的情况下评估角色的人格一致性。
AI.method: 提出自锚定的内部一致性诊断：让角色先进行一次人格自述，再通过两种方式产生行为画像——在受约束情境中作选择，以及回答开放式问题。自述采用量表评分，选择题由预设规则评分，开放回答由语言模型评判。研究将自述与两种行为画像映射到包含六个维度的人格空间，并计算相关性，以比较不同角色构建策略的一致性。
AI.result: 在普通用户聊天数据和具有社区人格标注的角色数据上，加入人格档案的表示方式都比仅使用原始对话更符合角色自述。在带有社区标注的数据上，内部一致性评估所得的策略排序与社区标注排序一致；总体趋势在不同答题模型和评判模型下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 自述可作为缺少外部真实标签时的内部参照，用于诊断语言模型模拟角色的人格一致性。该方法能区分不同角色构建策略，并在具备外部标注的数据上呈现与外部评估相符的排序。

title: When Does Reasoning Help Entity Disambiguation? Small LLMs In-Domain and Under Shift
summary: Entity disambiguation (mapping ambiguous mentions in text to entities in a knowledge base) is a foundational step in tasks such as knowledge graph construction, question answering, and information extraction. Recent work has applied LLMs to this problem, achieving stateof-the-art performance. Notably, reasoning LLMs have been shown to perform entity disambiguation in a true zero-shot fashion, generalizing across knowledge bases and domains. However, it is unclear whether this capability survives, or remains competitive, with smaller LLMs, where entity disambiguation has typically relied on reranking rather than reasoning. We ask when reasoning is worth its cost at small scale. We compare pointwise, listwise, and reasoning-based candidate-selection components within a classical coarse-to-fine entity disambiguation pipeline, across the classical, few-shot and true zero-shot settings. The reasoning paradigm is trained with distillation and reinforcement learning recipes. The benefit of reasoning grows with domain shift: negligible in-domain, decisive in the true zero-shot setting. We show that two distinct factors are at work: the reranker's uncertainty over the candidates locates where the paradigms disagree, while shift governs which is right when they do.

AI.tldr: 论文研究小型语言模型在实体消歧中何时值得采用推理，发现推理的优势随领域迁移增强：同领域提升有限，真正零样本场景下则显著。
AI.motivation: 大型推理语言模型已能跨知识库和领域进行零样本实体消歧，但小型模型是否也具备这一能力、推理相较于候选重排是否值得其计算成本，尚不明确。论文旨在厘清推理在不同规模与迁移条件下的价值。
AI.method: 在经典的由粗到细实体消歧流程中，比较逐项选择、列表式选择和基于推理的候选选择组件，并评估经典、少样本和真正零样本设置。推理方案通过知识蒸馏与强化学习训练；研究还分析重排器对候选的不确定性及领域迁移如何影响不同方法的判断。
AI.result: 推理的收益随领域迁移程度增加：在同领域场景中提升几乎可以忽略，在真正零样本场景中则具有决定性优势。分析显示，重排器对候选的不确定性可以定位各类方法意见不一致的样本，而领域迁移程度则影响哪种方法更可能判断正确。
AI.conclusion: 小型模型中的推理并非始终优于重排，其价值取决于应用场景。领域迁移越强，采用推理越值得；候选不确定性可用于识别推理与重排可能产生分歧的样本，从而为有针对性的推理调用提供依据。

title: LeanReviewBench: Semantic Alignment Review in Mathematical Lean Projects
summary: Lean verifies that a proof establishes its formal proposition, but whether that proposition preserves the mathematical content of an informal source requires separate review. In project-scale formalizations, this correspondence can depend on definitions and constraints distributed across many declarations. We introduce LeanReviewBench, a benchmark for project-level semantic alignment review containing 197 versioned inputs collected from 18 real Lean projects, with 87 aligned and 110 misaligned reference judgments. Each input binds an informal mathematical target to selected formal declarations and an extracted dependency context. Construction combines development-history discovery, independent target binding, reconstruction under a common Lean environment, and Astra annotation with human review of uncertain cases. The collection spans diverse mathematical domains and includes 69 historical pairs. We evaluate six language models with Direct and ReForm prompts on all 197 inputs against final human-reviewed reference labels. GPT-6.1 Sol with Direct prompting achieves the highest reported accuracy of 0.827 and misalignment-detection F1 of 0.844; the effects of prompting vary across models. LeanReviewBench provides a testbed for reviewing semantic correspondence in existing mathematical formalization projects. LeanReviewBench is available at https://github.com/MechMath/LeanReviewBench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个用于评估大型语言模型能否审查数学形式化内容与非形式化目标是否语义一致的基准集，包含一百九十七个案例；测试中最高准确率为百分之八十二点七，错配检测的最高调和平均值为百分之八十四点四。
AI.motivation: 形式化证明系统能够验证证明是否成立于给定命题，却不能保证该命题忠实保留了原始非形式化数学内容。在大型项目中，判断这种语义对应关系往往需要综合分散于多处的定义、约束与依赖，因此有必要建立项目级的评审基准。
AI.method: 研究者从十八个真实的精益项目中收集并整理了一百九十七个带版本信息的案例，其中八十七个被标注为语义对齐，另有一百一十个为语义错配。每个案例将非形式化数学目标与选定的形式化声明及其依赖上下文绑定起来。基准构建包括从开发历史中发现案例、独立绑定目标、在统一环境中重建，以及由自动系统标注并对不确定案例进行人工复核。研究还使用两类提示方式评估六种语言模型，并以最终经人工审阅的标签作为参照。
AI.result: 最佳结果由一种模型在直接提示下取得：准确率为百分之八十二点七，语义错配检测的调和平均值为百分之八十四点四。提示方式对不同模型的影响并不一致。数据集还覆盖多种数学领域，并包含六十九组成对的历史版本案例。
AI.conclusion: 该基准集为评估语言模型审查既有数学形式化项目中的语义对应关系提供了测试平台。结果显示，模型具备一定的错配识别能力，但表现会受到模型与提示方式影响；因此，形式化证明的机器验证仍不能替代对命题是否忠实表达原始数学目标的专门审查。

title: TAP: Policy Interfaces for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models denoise a masked canvas, making them a natural setting for selective generation decisions such as answering, waiting, clarifying, or refusing. We introduce TAP-DiLM, which adds a typed policy variable to masked diffusion LMs, and study how this policy should be attached to the denoising process. Across BERT-base, MDLMOWT, LLaDA-8B, and Dream-7B, we compare shared-vocabulary slots, dedicated slot heads, and CLS-based external heads. The results reveal a clear interface-backbone interaction: dedicated heads provide robust policy learning across scales, while sharedvocabulary heads can be effective when the LM-head geometry is favorable. A simple LMhead sharpness probe predicts when sharedhead policy internalization is reliable, giving a practical diagnostic for interface selection. Causal clamp and slot-injection tests show that dedicated policy slots can influence body denoising through feedback, especially at 8B scale. Safety-refusal experiments further show that TAP-DiLM supports competitive typed refusal behavior when trained with diverse unsafe prompts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向扩散语言模型的策略接口，使模型能够选择回答、等待、澄清或拒绝；专用策略槽在不同模型规模下表现稳健，共享词表方案则取决于语言模型输出头的特性。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型通过逐步去噪恢复被遮蔽文本，适合在生成过程中作出选择性决策。但策略变量应如何接入去噪过程尚不明确，因此需要比较不同接口，并研究策略是否能影响文本生成本身。
AI.method: 作者提出一种带有类型化策略变量的扩散语言模型框架，并在四种不同规模与架构的模型上比较三种接入方式：共享词表槽位、专用策略槽位，以及基于分类标记的外部策略头。研究还使用输出头尖锐度探针判断共享词表方案是否适用，并通过因果钳制、槽位注入和多样化不安全提示下的拒绝训练，检验策略槽位对去噪过程及安全拒绝的作用。
AI.result: 专用策略头能够跨模型规模稳健地学习策略；共享词表头在语言模型输出头几何性质较有利时也有效。简单的输出头尖锐度指标可预测共享词表方案的可靠性。因果干预结果表明，专用策略槽位能够通过反馈影响正文去噪，这种影响在八十亿参数规模的模型上尤为明显。此外，该框架经多样化不安全提示训练后，可实现具有竞争力的类型化拒绝行为。
AI.conclusion: 策略接口的选择应考虑其与模型骨干的匹配关系。专用策略头是较稳健的默认方案，而输出头尖锐度可作为选择共享词表接口的实用诊断依据。策略槽位不仅能表达决策，还可能反馈并调节文本生成过程。

title: Disclosure Bias in AI Reviewers
summary: AI models increasingly help to review papers, and many conferences and journals now require authors to state how they used AI. Does this AI-use statement change how an AI reviewer rates a paper, and could it change which papers are accepted? In a preliminary study, we varied only the AI-use statement of 150 ICLR 2027 submissions, in up to nine versions adapted from real statements: from no AI, through writing help and coding, to an AI research agent and an AI author. Six AI reviewers rated the versions: the decision model Jev and the language models Claude Haiku 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 3.1 Pro and Gemini 4 Argon. Across 23,652 reviews, we find that every reviewer rates papers lower on average when the statement says AI did all the work than under a statement of no AI use. The AI research agent statement lowers the rating significantly for Jev, Sonnet and Argon. We find no evidence of a disclosure bias for AI assistance: for writing help, coding and research help, no reviewer's rating differs significantly from its rating under a statement of no AI use. Whether the observed penalty changes which papers are accepted depends on more than the size of the penalty: on how finely and how consistently the reviewer separates the papers near the acceptance boundary, on whether the penalty is spread over all papers or concentrated on a few, and possibly on how many other papers disclose AI use.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，人工智能审稿人会因论文声明由人工智能完成全部工作而降低评分；对写作、编程或研究辅助的披露则未发现显著评分偏差。评分惩罚是否影响录用，取决于论文在录用线附近的排序方式及惩罚的分布。
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能越来越多地参与论文写作与研究，会议和期刊开始要求作者披露人工智能的使用情况。本研究考察：仅改变人工智能使用声明，是否会影响人工智能审稿人的评分，以及这种影响是否可能改变论文录用结果。
AI.method: 研究选取一百五十篇国际学习表征会议二〇二七年投稿论文，仅修改其人工智能使用声明，并依据真实声明构造最多九种版本，涵盖未使用人工智能、写作辅助、编程辅助、人工智能研究代理及人工智能作者等情形。六种人工智能审稿系统对这些版本进行了共二万三千六百五十二次评审，并比较不同声明下的评分。
AI.result: 所有审稿系统对声明人工智能完成全部工作的论文，平均评分都低于声明未使用人工智能的版本。声明使用人工智能研究代理时，三个审稿系统的评分显著下降。对于写作、编程和研究辅助声明，没有发现任何审稿系统的评分与未使用人工智能声明下的评分存在显著差异。惩罚是否改变录用结果，不能仅由平均降分幅度判断，还取决于审稿人能否稳定区分录用线附近的论文、惩罚是普遍分布还是集中于少数论文，以及可能存在的其他论文人工智能披露比例。
AI.conclusion: 研究显示，人工智能审稿人对人工智能使用声明的反应并不一致：完整委托人工智能完成工作可能招致评分惩罚，但披露常见辅助用途并未显示显著偏差。评分变化不必然转化为录用变化；评估其实际影响时，还需考察评分排序、录用门槛附近的论文分布及披露情况。

title: Rethinking the Evaluation of Contrastive Decoding for Hallucination Mitigation in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Contrastive decoding (CD) mitigates object hallucination in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by contrasting token distributions under different conditions to adjust token scores. However, existing generative and discriminative benchmarks primarily measure final task scores, which can be confounded by candidate filtering, changes in generation trajectories, and response biases, making it difficult to isolate the effects of the underlying contrastive adjustments. To address these limitations while complementing existing evaluations, we introduce CONCOR (Contrastive Correction Evaluation), a controlled benchmark that directly evaluates the competition between ground-truth and different types of hallucinated candidates using the Contrastive Grounding Margin (CGM). CGM also enables analysis of directional consistency, composition, and reliability of contrastive corrections. Our evaluation reveals that existing CD methods exhibit distinct correction behaviors: some consistently favor ground-truth candidates, whereas others produce strong corrections but also introduce more errors. Crucially, these differences help explain their contrasting responses to increased contrast strength, which improves some methods while degrading others. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating the contrastive correction itself, rather than relying solely on final-output performance, and CONCOR provides a controlled and interpretable framework for understanding and improving CD methods for hallucination mitigation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出受控评测基准「对比校正评估」，直接衡量对比解码如何改变真实候选与幻觉候选之间的竞争，并揭示不同方法的校正特性及其对对比强度的不同反应。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式和判别式基准主要评估最终任务表现，结果容易受到候选筛选、生成轨迹变化和回答偏差的干扰，因此难以单独判断对比解码本身的校正效果。论文旨在补充现有评测，直接、可解释地分析对比调整是否让真实候选胜过幻觉候选。
AI.method: 提出「对比校正评估」基准，控制真实候选与多种幻觉候选之间的竞争，并以「对比落地边际」衡量二者的相对优势变化。该指标还用于分析校正方向的一致性、校正效果的构成及可靠性。
AI.result: 评测发现，不同对比解码方法呈现不同校正行为：有些方法较稳定地偏向真实候选；另一些方法校正力度较强，但也会引入更多错误。这些差异解释了对比强度增大时，为何某些方法表现改善、另一些方法反而退化。
AI.conclusion: 评估幻觉缓解方法时，不应只看最终输出表现，还应直接考察对比校正本身。「对比校正评估」为理解和改进多模态大语言模型的对比解码提供了受控且可解释的分析框架。

title: When Does Continual Pre-Training Help? An Empirical Study of Decoupled Knowledge and Generation Trajectories in Clinical LLMs
comment: EAccepted at EACL 2027 (Main Conference). 26 pages, 13 figures, 6 tables
summary: Continual pre-training (\textit{CPT}) is a standard route for domain adaptation, yet existing studies typically track pre-training loss or multiple-choice question answering (\textit{MCQA}) accuracy alone, offering only a narrow view of how adaptation unfolds. We jointly track factual knowledge via \textit{MCQA} and open-ended behavior via pairwise preference rankings across $18$ checkpoints for each of eight instruction-tuned \textit{Qwen} models ($0.5B$ to $8B$), adapted to German medicine with \textit{CPT} and \textit{SLERP} merging. The two axes converge at consistently different rates, with preference rankings reaching $90\%$ of their total gain after a median of $1.7B$ tokens versus $3.5B$ for \textit{MCQA}. A judge-free token-distribution measure reaches this threshold at $1.9B$ tokens. Per-aspect scores indicate that these early preference gains largely reflect surface alignment, meaning models can sound domain-appropriate before their factual knowledge catches up. Larger adapted models close more of the gap to unadapted next-tier generalists, whereas preference gain per FLOP falls by about an order of magnitude across our size range. We therefore argue that judge-based preference scores, which can plateau while \textit{MCQA} knowledge is still improving, should not be used alone to infer adaptation convergence or domain readiness.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，模型适应德语医学领域时，回答偏好表现通常早于事实知识提升；仅凭偏好评分判断适应是否完成，可能高估模型的领域准备度。
AI.motivation: 既有持续预训练研究常只关注预训练损失或选择题准确率，难以全面揭示领域适应的进程。尤其是，开放式回答听起来符合领域规范，是否意味着模型已掌握相应事实知识，仍需检验。
AI.method: 研究追踪八种不同规模的指令微调通义千问模型，在德语医学领域适应过程中的十八个检查点。适应方式包括持续预训练和球面线性插值模型合并；评估同时考察选择题事实知识、成对偏好排序，以及一种不依赖评审模型的词元分布指标，并分析不同回答方面的得分。
AI.result: 偏好排序达到其总增益百分之九十所需的词元数中位数为十七亿，选择题指标则为三十五亿；词元分布指标约为十九亿。偏好评分的早期提升主要体现表层对齐，模型可能先学会呈现符合领域预期的表达，事实知识随后才逐渐提升。较大的适应模型更能缩小与更高一档未适应通用模型的差距，但每单位计算量带来的偏好增益随模型规模增加而下降，约降低一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 偏好评分与事实知识的提升速度并不一致，且偏好评分可能在事实知识继续改善时已趋于平稳。因此，不应单独依靠评审模型给出的偏好分数判断领域适应是否收敛，也不应据此认定模型已具备领域应用能力。

title: Quantizing Diffusion LLMs under Parallel Decoding: Commitment Risk and the Parallelism Tax
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) are served with accelerated decoders that cache context and commit, in one step, every masked position whose confidence clears a threshold. Yet post-training quantization of dLLMs has so far been calibrated and evaluated under fixed-step samplers without caching. We study W4A4 quantization under the deployed decoder and find that the decoder determines both where quantization harms accuracy and what it costs. Irreversible errors enter chiefly through forced commitments, made when no position clears the threshold: they are a minority of commitments but carry most quantization-induced flips. Quantization also levies a parallelism tax, extra forward passes per response: by compressing top logit gaps, it pushes positions below the threshold while leaving predictions largely intact. We propose DECAL, which reweights layer-wise calibration by a commitment-risk prior measured on the deployed decoder, and an argmax-preserving commit temperature that recovers the tax. On LLaDA and Dream, DECAL attains the best average accuracy among W4A4 methods, with lower run-to-run variance than the closest existing calibration method.

AI.tldr: 论文针对扩散语言模型的实际加速解码流程改进四位权重、四位激活量化，在维持预测结果的同时提升准确率并减少额外推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散语言模型量化方法通常在固定步数、无缓存的采样器上校准和评估，与部署时使用的加速解码器不一致。实际解码器会缓存上下文，并依据置信度一次性提交多个掩码位置，因此量化的准确率损失和推理成本可能与传统评测结果不同。
AI.method: 论文分析部署解码器下的量化误差，发现主要风险来自强制提交：当没有任何位置达到置信度阈值时，解码器仍会提交位置，这类提交虽然数量较少，却造成了多数由量化引起的预测翻转。为此，作者提出一种方法：依据部署解码器测得的提交风险先验，重新加权各层的校准过程；同时采用保持最大预测类别不变的提交温度，缓解量化压缩最高类别与次高类别之间的分数差距所导致的额外前向计算。
AI.result: 在两种扩散语言模型上，该方法的四位权重、四位激活量化取得了各量化方法中最高的平均准确率；与最接近的校准方法相比，其多次运行间的结果波动也更小。提交温度还可减少量化导致的额外前向计算，而基本保持预测类别不变。
AI.conclusion: 扩散语言模型的量化应针对实际部署的解码器进行校准和评估。区分高风险的强制提交错误与主要增加推理开销的置信度变化，并分别加以处理，可以兼顾量化准确率与解码效率。

title: Does the Mixer Matter ? Paired-Seed Ablations of Tiny Bilingual Language Models
summary: We report paired-seed architecture ablations from the development of Sophea Artemis, our in-house Greek-English model family. Every arm trains on the same 3B targets with a shared tokenizer and recipe; models range from 54M to 759M total parameters and roughly 54M to 124M active parameters. The main finding is that, at this tiny scale, stored capacity matters far more than mixer design. On a fixed held-out test, replacing the dense feed-forward blocks of a recurrent/attention hybrid with sixteen routed experts, at nearly the same approximate active parameters, lowers loss by 0.079 (Greek) and 0.112 (English) nats per target, and doubling to 32 experts lowers it by a further 0.022 and 0.031, at every paired seed. Reusing a four-layer block three times recovers about 40-44% of the gap between a shallow and an independently deep model, consistent with looped-Transformer results. In contrast, the choice among grouped-query attention (GQA), Gated DeltaNet (GDN) hybrids and a Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) hybrid moves loss by only about 0.01-0.02 nats; a 1:1 GDN/GQA hybrid is the one dense variant that improves on GQA in both languages at every held-out seed. In bits per character, Greek and English held-out losses are similar despite a 74.49%/25.51% training split, and synthetic mathematics, which comes from a collection outside the training sources, is the hardest Greek test component and gains least from added experts. Cached decoding needs its own qualification: trained models passed cached-versus-full logit checks only under a fixed-reduction inference policy, which itself changes 1.4-2.8% of next-token argmax choices relative to native evaluation. All results are conditional on one recipe and scale.

AI.tldr: 在约五千四百万至七亿五千九百万参数的小规模希腊语—英语模型实验中，增加专家数量带来的收益明显大于更换注意力或混合器结构；结论仅适用于本文采用的训练方案与模型规模。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在通过配对随机种子的结构消融，厘清小规模模型性能提升究竟更多来自存储容量、计算结构，还是注意力与序列混合器的选择，并比较这些设计对希腊语和英语的影响。
AI.method: 所有实验使用相同的三十亿个训练目标、分词器与训练方案，模型总参数量约为五千四百万至七亿五千九百万，活跃参数量约为五千四百万至一亿二千四百万。作者比较稠密前馈层与十六、三十二个路由专家，比较浅层模型、重复使用四层模块三次的循环结构与独立加深模型，并测试分组查询注意力、门控增量网络及其混合结构，以及基于增量注意力的混合结构。评估包括固定留出集、合成数学测试，以及缓存解码与完整计算的对照。
AI.result: 在近似相同活跃参数量下，将稠密前馈层替换为十六个路由专家，使希腊语和英语每个目标的损失分别降低零点零七九和零点一一二奈特；增加至三十二个专家又分别降低零点零二二和零点零三一奈特，且各配对种子结果一致。重复使用四层模块三次，可弥补浅层模型与独立深层模型性能差距的约百分之四十至四十四。相比之下，更换注意力或混合器通常只使损失变化约零点零一至零点零二奈特；稠密结构中，一比一混合门控增量网络与分组查询注意力的方案，是唯一在两种语言的每个留出种子上均优于单独分组查询注意力的变体。按字符计算，希腊语和英语留出损失相近，尽管训练数据比例分别为百分之七十四点四九和百分之二十五点五一。合成数学是最难的希腊语测试部分，也最少受益于增加专家。缓存解码与完整计算只有采用固定归约推理策略时才通过逻辑值检查；但该策略相较原生评估会改变百分之一点四至二点八的下一词元最高概率选择。
AI.conclusion: 在本文的小模型与单一训练方案范围内，扩大路由专家带来的存储容量收益，远大于多数混合器或注意力设计调整；循环复用层也能以较少独立层数追回部分加深模型的性能差距。语言训练占比不直接决定留出损失，且增加专家对不同测试领域的帮助并不均衡。推理时的缓存与数值归约策略会影响评估结果，因此结果应视为有条件的实验发现，不能直接外推至其他规模或训练方案。

title: From Rewarding What Models Say to How They Think: Attention Process Reward Model for LLM Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become an important component in large language models (LLMs). However, existing RL approaches focus on final outputs or textual solution trajectories, leading to coarse-grained rewards and unreliable reasoning. Such paradigms focus mainly on what the model outputs while overlooking how the model internally reasons. Therefore, can we reward how a model thinks internally rather than merely what it says? We first reveal the problem of textual reward aliasing in existing reward modeling approaches. Motivated by this, we propose the Attention Process Reward Model (APRM), which assigns internal rewards based on hidden states and attention maps to capture high-quality reasoning patterns. With only approximately 46M parameters, APRM is trained using ranking and counterfactual objectives, and its reward guides RL optimization while being periodically updated to handle distribution shifts. Integrated with representative RL methods, APRM achieved an average pass@8 gain of 2.88\%. Our results demonstrate the promise of incorporating internal reasoning signals into RL for LLMs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种利用模型内部状态评估推理质量的奖励模型，并将其用于强化学习优化；实验中，八次采样通过率平均提升了2.88%。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法通常根据最终答案或文本推理过程提供奖励，容易产生粒度粗糙、信号不可靠的问题。它们关注模型说了什么，却忽略模型如何进行内部推理；此外，不同内部推理过程可能对应相似文本，造成奖励难以区分的“文本奖励混淆”。
AI.method: 提出注意力过程奖励模型，利用模型隐藏状态和注意力图为内部推理过程评分，以捕捉高质量推理模式。该模型规模约为四千六百万个参数，通过排序目标和反事实目标训练；其奖励信号用于指导强化学习，并定期更新以适应训练过程中的分布变化。
AI.result: 将该奖励模型与具有代表性的强化学习方法结合后，八次采样通过率平均提高2.88%。摘要未提供具体基准、对比方法或统计显著性等进一步结果。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，强化学习可以利用模型内部推理信号，而不只依赖外显答案或文本轨迹。这为提升大型语言模型推理能力提供了一种有潜力的方向；其实际效果及适用范围仍需通过更多实验验证。

title: Empirical Margin Sensitivity: An Interventional Neuron-Level Probe of Post-Trained Medical LLMs
summary: Medical post-training raises benchmark accuracy, but accuracy does not show which internal components a model's decisions depend on, or whether components that support one benchmark also support another. We apply the weight-space intervention paradigm of ROME and MEMIT at the granularity of one MLP down-projection column. Our measurement, Empirical Margin Sensitivity (EMS), replaces each coordinate magnitude of a column by its mean while preserving the column's sign pattern and L1 scale, and records the resulting change in the logit margin between the correct option and its hardest-wrong competitor. This isolates the margin's dependence on a column's fine-grained coordinate structure while the column stays in place. We discover high-EMS columns (anchors) on MedQA in ten public checkpoints (four general-purpose bases and six medical post-trained variants) across the Gemma, Llama, Qwen, and AFM families, and measure the same columns on MedMCQA and PubMedQA. Mean-ablating each discovered anchor set lowers MedQA accuracy in all six post-trained models, by 6 to 28 points. In the two pure-SFT checkpoints, crushing anchors raises the PubMedQA margin on correctly answered items (negative EMS), and anchors with this property sit significantly deeper than the same model's other anchors; the four checkpoints trained with RL or mixed recipes show positive PubMedQA EMS and no significant depth shift. The depth association recurs in each of three held-out checkpoints. Because the checkpoints differ in data and pipeline as well as objective, we report these as per-checkpoint observations.

AI.tldr: 研究通过单个多层感知机下投影列的权重干预，识别支撑医学问答表现的关键列，并发现其跨基准作用与训练方案有关。
AI.motivation: 医学领域的后训练能够提升基准准确率，但准确率无法揭示模型决策依赖哪些内部组件，也无法说明支持一个基准的组件是否同样支持其他基准。研究旨在以细粒度方式衡量模型内部权重结构对判断的影响。
AI.method: 研究借鉴既有的权重空间干预方法，将分析单位设为多层感知机下投影矩阵中的单列。提出经验边际敏感度：把列中各坐标的绝对值替换为该列的平均值，同时保留符号模式和绝对值总和，再测量正确选项相对于最难错误选项的对数几率差变化。研究在十个公开模型检查点上，根据医学问答基准识别高敏感度列，并在另外两个医学问答基准上测量这些列的作用。
AI.result: 对六个医学后训练模型中识别出的关键列进行均值消融后，医学问答准确率均下降，降幅为六至二十八个百分点。两个纯监督微调模型中，消融关键列反而提高了另一基准上正确作答样本的边际值，即呈负敏感度；这些列显著更深。采用强化学习或混合训练方案的四个模型则呈正敏感度，且未发现显著深度差异。关键列深度与该现象的关联还在三个留出检查点中重现。
AI.conclusion: 模型内部关键权重列对不同医学问答基准的作用并不一致，且可能与训练方案及网络深度相关。由于各检查点在训练数据和流程上也存在差异，研究将这些发现限定为逐个检查点的观察，不将其解读为训练目标造成的普遍因果效应。

title: Synthetic Twins: Closing the Gap Between TTS Test Sets and Real Recordings in Turkish ASR Evaluation
summary: Speech synthesized by text-to-speech engines is a low-cost substitute for recorded test sets in automatic speech recognition, yet an off-the-shelf synthetic test set is worth only a few dozen real recordings for estimating the real error rate of a recognizer. This paper examines which properties of real recordings are missing from synthetic speech and how much of the gap can be closed. For 507 Turkish Common Voice recordings, synthetic twins are built: a ladder of synthetic copies that adds, one factor at a time, the pitch of the speaker, a clone of the same speaker, the real recording channel and the speaking rate. At each step, the agreement between ASR behaviour on the copy and on the real recording is measured. Across three zero-shot cloning engines and panels of six and 19 recognizers, the speaker clone is the step that improves agreement on which sentences are hard, raising the Spearman correlation from .41 to .55 for Chatterbox. Matching the channel or adding generic noise corrects the error level when the synthetic speech is easier than real speech. The twin with the highest worth is equivalent to 70 to 122 real recordings, depending on the recognizer panel, compared with about 9 for a stock voice. The findings replicate on VoxForge, a second corpus in which speaker identity is known rather than inferred: the clone raises sentence agreement from .31 to .50 and the worth from 8 to about 50 recordings. Agreement on which sentences are hard is distinct from agreement on how hard they are. The paper concludes with a practical recipe and a reporting checklist for synthetic ASR test sets.

AI.tldr: 论文研究如何让合成语音更好地替代真实录音，用于评估自动语音识别系统；加入说话人克隆最能提升对“哪些句子较难”的判断一致性。
AI.motivation: 合成语音成本低，但直接使用现成合成语音来估计识别系统在真实录音上的错误率，效用有限，约只相当于几十条真实录音。论文试图找出真实录音与合成语音之间的关键差异，并评估弥合这些差异能带来多大改进。
AI.method: 研究者为土耳其语公共语音语料中的五百零七条真实录音制作对应的合成版本，逐步加入说话人音高、同一说话人的声音克隆、真实录音通道特征及语速等因素。使用三种零样本声音克隆引擎，并在包含六个或十九个识别器的测试组上，比较合成版本与真实录音上的识别表现，分别考察句子难度排序的一致性和错误程度的一致性。随后在说话人身份已知的另一语料上复核结果。
AI.result: 说话人克隆是提升“哪些句子较难”这一判断一致性的关键步骤：在一个克隆引擎上，斯皮尔曼相关系数从零点四一升至零点五五。匹配真实录音通道或加入一般噪声，则有助于修正合成语音比真实录音更容易识别时的错误水平。最佳合成版本的效用相当于七十至一百二十二条真实录音，而现成合成声音约相当于九条。在第二个语料上，克隆使句子一致性从零点三一升至零点五，效用从约八条真实录音提高到约五十条。研究还指出，判断哪些句子难，与准确判断其难度大小并非同一回事。
AI.conclusion: 经过针对性处理的合成语音测试集，能显著提高自动语音识别评估的效用，尤其应优先匹配说话人身份；通道和噪声处理也有助于校准错误水平。不过，句子难度排序与难度程度仍需分别评估。论文据此提出了合成语音测试集的实用制作流程及报告清单。

title: Hard to Translate, Harder to Detect: Human Analysis Remains Essential in AI Meme Translation
comment: 39 pages, 1 figure, 21 tables. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23504282; code: https://github.com/olzama/hard-to-find
summary: We present a dataset and evaluation setup for a problem in creative machine translation: translating culturally loaded passages that carry much of a text's meaning and humor that may depend on subtle or implicit discourse. We study Soviet comedy quotations that function as memes in Russian-language communication. Off-the-shelf difficulty estimators do not find these passages; current models searching the web find most but not all of them, but their own analyses of the difficulty do not help translation as well as a human-validated one. Given a brief human-validated analysis of why each passage is difficult, older models improve modestly; the strongest current translators (GPT-6 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5) improve more, and in human evaluation GPT-6 Sol comes close to the approved references on most films. Newer models have thus become much better at using such an analysis while still not reliably producing it themselves. We release (1) a dataset of five films' Russian subtitles with their audience-selected culturally salient passages, human-validated analyses, and reference translations (into English, Galician, and Spanish), together with every full-film LLM translation and evaluation produced in this study; and (2) an item-level MQM-style evaluation protocol that measures translator and evaluator noise to set the number of runs the evaluation needs, and whose automatic version tracks human judgment of these passages, which reference-free neural metrics do not, whether they score the whole text or the passages alone.

AI.tldr: 论文构建了苏联喜剧文化典故的机器翻译数据集与评测方案，发现先进模型能有效利用人工核验的难点分析，但尚不能稳定地自行生成这类分析。
AI.motivation: 文化负载表达常承载文本的核心含义与幽默，其理解还可能依赖隐含语境，因此对机器翻译构成挑战。现有难度估计方法难以识别这类片段；即使模型能从网络检索到片段，其自行生成的难点分析也未必能有效改善翻译。
AI.method: 研究以俄语交流中作为网络迷因流传的苏联喜剧台词为对象，整理五部影片的俄语字幕、受众选出的文化显著片段、经人工核验的难点分析，以及英、加利西亚语和西班牙语参考译文。研究比较模型自行分析与人工核验分析对翻译的影响，并发布完整影片的模型译文及评测结果。此外，设计逐条目的多维质量评估式评测流程，以估计译者和评估者的波动，并据此确定所需运行次数；其自动评测版本也与人工判断进行对照。
AI.result: 人工核验的难点分析能提升翻译质量：较旧模型仅有小幅改善，最强的当前模型改善更明显。人评显示，GPT-6 Sol 在多数影片上的表现已接近认可的参考译文。尽管模型越来越善于利用难点分析，它们仍无法可靠地自行生成分析。该研究的自动评测方案能够追踪人工对这些片段的判断，而无参考神经评测指标无论评估全文还是仅评估目标片段，都未能做到这一点。
AI.conclusion: 文化语境分析是改善文化负载幽默翻译的重要辅助，但目前更适合由人工提供或核验，而不宜完全依赖模型自行生成。论文通过公开数据集、译文与评测协议，为研究此类翻译及其评估提供了可复用资源。

title: CocoonBench: Can Multilingual Search Agents Escape Language Information Cocoons?
summary: Multilingual search agents can access the global Web, yet may remain trapped in a language environment with insufficient evidence; we refer to this failure as a language information cocoon. However, existing search benchmarks largely operate within a single language, especially English, overlooking entity connections across multiple languages. We introduce CocoonBench, a benchmark that evaluates whether multilingual search agents can escape such language information cocoons. CocoonBench mines answer-centered relational paths from a frozen Wikidata-derived graph and selects clue sets that are individually necessary and jointly identify a unique answer. Using language-specific entity names, it records each task's minimum language cover, removes direct identifiers, and renders each task as matched prompts in three languages together with its construction certificate and provenance. Across 10 state-of-the-art models, mean accuracy on CocoonBench ranges from 33.8% (DeepSeek-V4-Flash) to 69.7% (Claude-Opus-4.8), leaving even the strongest system below 70%. The same construction certificates support path-aligned trajectory analysis, enabling diagnosis of model failures in language routing, evidence-path recovery, and answer use. The result shows that escaping a language cocoon requires more than switching languages: successful cross-lingual search depends on both covering the correct languages and connecting the evidence found across them.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用于评估多语言搜索智能体能否突破“语言信息茧房”的基准；实验显示，现有模型仍难以同时跨语言搜集并关联证据。
AI.motivation: 多语言搜索智能体虽然能够访问全球网络，却可能受困于证据不足的单一语言环境。现有搜索基准多以单一语言、尤其英语为主，未能充分评估跨语言实体关联与证据整合能力。
AI.method: 研究构建了“跨语言信息茧房基准”。该基准从冻结的维基数据衍生图谱中挖掘以答案为中心的关系路径，挑选出每条线索都不可或缺、且合并后能唯一确定答案的线索集合。任务采用各语言对应的实体名称，记录完成任务所需的最小语言覆盖范围，移除直接标识答案的信息，并为每项任务生成三种语言的匹配提示及构造证明和来源信息。构造证明还用于按证据路径分析模型执行轨迹。
AI.result: 对十种先进模型的评测显示，平均准确率介于百分之三十三点八至百分之六十九点七之间，表现最好的模型也未达到百分之七十。路径对齐分析可进一步诊断模型在语言选择、证据路径恢复和答案使用等环节的失误。
AI.conclusion: 突破语言信息茧房不仅意味着切换语言，还要求搜索智能体覆盖正确的语言，并将不同语言中找到的证据有效连接起来。该基准为评估和分析这一跨语言搜索能力提供了系统化工具。

title: Task-Dependent Linguistic Measures in Aphasia Discourse: A Comparative Analysis of Narrative, Descriptive, and Procedural Speech
summary: Background: Transcript-based measures such as word counts, lexical diversity and disfluency rates are widely used to describe language ability in aphasia. Each measure comes from a specific elicitation task, and studies use different tasks, so values from different tasks may not be comparable. Aims: To test whether discourse tasks change these measures within the same speakers, and whether the measures follow a gradient from Procedural to Descriptive to Narrative discourse. Methods & Procedures: Baseline transcripts from 61 adults with chronic post-stroke aphasia were taken from the Fridriksson-2 corpus in AphasiaBank (POLAR trial, ClinicalTrials.gov NCT03416738). Each speaker produced a Procedural (Sandwich), a Descriptive (Broken Window) and a Narrative (Cinderella) sample in one session. A rule-based pipeline extracted 13 measures, 10 of which were common enough to test. Friedman, Page and Wilcoxon tests with false discovery rate correction were used, with a speaker-grouped Random Forest classifier as a supporting check. Outcomes & Results: Total words and number of different words followed the full gradient, but the step from Procedural to Descriptive was small. For most other measures, Narrative stood apart, while Descriptive and Procedural did not differ. Among the 31 speakers with at least 25 words in every task, filler rate, repetition rate and total disfluency density were higher in Narrative than in both other tasks. The classifier reached an accuracy of 0.61 (always guessing the most common task would give 0.41), mainly by recognizing Narrative samples. Conclusions: Discourse tasks are not interchangeable, and expressing disfluencies per word does not remove the task effect. The task should be reported with every measure, and values should be compared only within the same task.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，失语症话语指标会随诱发任务而变化，尤其叙事任务与程序性、描述性任务差异明显；不同任务所得数值不宜直接比较。
AI.motivation: 词数、词汇多样性和不流畅率等转录指标常用于评估失语症语言能力，但它们依赖具体的话语诱发任务。由于研究采用的任务不同，指标数值可能无法直接比较。研究旨在检验同一说话者在不同任务中的指标是否变化，以及指标是否呈现从程序性、描述性到叙事性任务的递增趋势。
AI.method: 研究分析了六十一名慢性卒中后失语症成年人的基线转录文本。每位参与者在同一场次完成程序性任务（制作三明治）、描述性任务（描述破窗场景）和叙事性任务（讲述《灰姑娘》故事）。研究通过规则式流程提取十三项指标，其中十项因数据充足而纳入检验；采用弗里德曼检验、佩奇趋势检验和威尔科克森检验，并进行错误发现率校正。另以按说话者分组的随机森林分类器作辅助验证。
AI.result: 总词数和不同词数整体呈现从程序性、描述性到叙事性任务递增的趋势，但程序性到描述性的增幅较小。多数其他指标中，叙事任务与另外两类任务不同，而程序性和描述性任务之间没有显著差异。在每项任务均至少产出二十五个词的三十一名参与者中，叙事任务的填充词率、重复率和总体不流畅密度均高于另外两类任务。分类器准确率为零点六一，高于始终猜测最常见任务的零点四一，主要依靠识别叙事样本。
AI.conclusion: 话语诱发任务并非可互换的测量条件；即使将不流畅现象按词数标准化，任务效应仍然存在。因此，报告任何语言指标时都应注明所用任务，比较数值时也应尽量限定在相同任务之内。

title: SARA: An Auditor-in-the-Loop LLM Recommender for Sustainability Reports
comment: Accepted at IEEE BigData 2026 as poster paper. 5 pages, 2 figures, 1 table
summary: Auditing corporate sustainability reports requires assurance professionals to map a company-specific checklist drawn from roughly 1,700 regulatory requirements onto the relevant passages of lengthy, repeatedly revised draft reports and to judge compliance. We present SARA (Sustainability Reporting Assistant), a human-in-the-loop recommender system delivered as a Microsoft Word add-in that recommends, for each requirement, the passages addressing it and predicts a compliance verdict while keeping the auditor in full control. SARA casts auditing as content-based recommendation over a fixed regulatory taxonomy and makes per-requirement large language model (LLM) matching cheaper, faster, and more accurate through topic-prediction filtering: on expert-annotated reports, it reduces matching cost about sixfold and runtime by 42% versus feeding the full report to the LLM. It is in production use across PwC Germany's sustainability-assurance practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一款由人工监督的可持续发展报告审计助手，可为每项监管要求推荐相关报告段落并预测合规结论；通过主题预测筛选，显著降低大语言模型匹配的成本与耗时。
AI.motivation: 可持续发展报告审计需要将企业适用的清单要求（约一千七百项）与篇幅长、反复修订的报告内容逐项对应，并判断是否合规。人工处理负担重，而直接让大语言模型阅读整份报告进行匹配又成本高、速度慢，因此需要兼顾效率与审计人员控制权的辅助工具。
AI.method: 研究提出可持续报告审计助手，以固定监管分类体系为基础，将审计建模为基于内容的推荐任务。系统针对每项要求推荐报告中可能回应该要求的段落，并预测合规结论；在调用大语言模型进行逐项匹配前，先通过主题预测筛选相关内容。系统以人工参与方式运行，最终判断权仍由审计人员掌握，并以文字处理软件插件形式提供。
AI.result: 在专家标注的报告上，与将完整报告输入大语言模型相比，主题预测筛选使匹配成本约降低至六分之一，运行时间缩短百分之四十二。该系统已在普华永道德国的可持续发展鉴证业务中投入生产使用。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，将主题筛选与大语言模型结合，并保留审计人员的最终控制，可提升可持续发展报告合规审计的效率与实用性。其生产部署也显示，这类人工监督的推荐系统具有实际应用价值。

title: Semantic-aware Decoding for Diverse Text-to-SQL under Schema Ambiguity
summary: Real-world text-to-SQL systems often face schema ambiguity, where a question can map to multiple plausible schema elements. To support downstream disambiguation, SQL generation systems should include diverse interpretations among their top-k predictions. However, large language models (LLMs) typically favor a single interpretation, producing highly skewed outputs. We propose Semantic-aware Logit Adjustment (SLA), a training-free decoding method that promotes diverse SQL generation by adjusting token logits based on semantic similarity between schema elements. Unlike prior approaches that rely on reasoning-intensive prompting or task-specific fine-tuning, SLA is efficient, model-agnostic, and easy to deploy. Experiments show that SLA consistently improves interpretation coverage over standard decoding and remains competitive with existing diversity-oriented methods at substantially lower inference cost.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种无需训练的语义感知对数几率调整方法，通过提高候选结构化查询语句解释的多样性，缓解模型预测过度集中于单一解释的问题。
AI.motivation: 现实中的自然语言转结构化查询任务常存在模式歧义：同一问题可能对应多个合理的数据库模式元素。为便于后续消歧，系统的前若干个预测应覆盖不同解释；但大型语言模型通常偏向单一解释，导致候选结果多样性不足。既有方法还可能依赖复杂提示推理或针对任务的微调。
AI.method: 提出语义感知对数几率调整，一种无需训练的解码方法。该方法依据数据库模式元素之间的语义相似度调整生成时的词元对数几率，以促进模型生成语义上不同的结构化查询解释。方法不依赖特定模型，且无需额外训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，与标准解码相比，该方法能稳定提高不同解释的覆盖率；相较现有多样性增强方法，其推理成本显著更低，同时保持有竞争力的效果。摘要未提供具体数据或基准名称。
AI.conclusion: 通过在解码阶段利用模式元素的语义关系调整生成倾向，可以低成本地提升候选结构化查询语句的解释多样性，为下游歧义消解提供更丰富的候选结果。

title: PRIMEAPE: A Multilingual Benchmark for Fine-Grained Meta-Evaluation of Judge Models
summary: Large language models increasingly serve as judges of other models, shaping benchmark rankings and model development. Yet, a judge whose rationale consistently supports its verdict may still disagree with human preferences. To study this, we introduce PRIMEAPE, a multilingual benchmark for evaluating judge verdicts and rationales. PRIMEAPE provides 2,205 response pairs covering 243 instructions in English, French, Spanish, Urdu, Hindi, Norwegian Bokmål, and Yoruba, with 11k human annotations of preferences and rationales across relevance, naturalness, truthfulness, safety, and overall quality. Our evaluation of twelve open- and closed-weight judges reveals that aggregate performance conceals differences across languages and criteria, while requesting rationales does not consistently improve agreement with human preferences. Judges also favor the first position, longer responses, and responses from related models, with effects that vary across criteria and languages. Crucially, judges can justify verdicts that disagree with human preferences while maintaining consistency between their verdicts and rationales. These findings show that consistency with a judge's own verdict does not establish alignment with human judgment. PRIMEAPE enables assessment of both, providing a foundation for more reliable multilingual judges. We release our benchmark and all annotation materials under the CC BY-NC 4.0 license at github.com/Toloka/primeape.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个多语言评测基准，用于同时检验模型评审者的判决与理由是否符合人类偏好，并揭示其存在多种偏差。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型评审者会影响模型排名与研发，但判决理由与自身结论一致，并不代表结论符合人类偏好。现有评估因而需要同时考察判决质量、理由质量及其与人类判断的关系，并覆盖多种语言和评价标准。
AI.method: 研究构建了一个多语言基准，包含二千二百零五组回答对，涉及二百四十三条指令，覆盖英语、法语、西班牙语、乌尔都语、印地语、挪威语书面语和约鲁巴语。基准收录约一万一千条人工偏好与理由标注，评估相关性、自然度、真实性、安全性和整体质量，并测试十二种开放权重与闭源模型评审者。
AI.result: 总体评测成绩掩盖了不同语言和评价标准之间的表现差异；要求评审者提供理由，并不能稳定提升其与人类偏好的吻合度。评审者还表现出位置偏好、较长回答偏好，以及对相关模型回答的偏好，且这些偏差因语言和评价标准而异。评审者可能给出与人类偏好相悖的判决，同时保持判决与理由的一致。
AI.conclusion: 评审者内部的判决—理由一致性不足以证明其判断符合人类偏好。该基准及其标注材料为评估和改进更可靠的多语言模型评审者提供了基础。

title: CART: Clustering-based Analysis of Recurring narratives for Taxonomy construction
summary: We present CART, a computational pipeline for extracting political narratives from parliamentary discourse and organizing them into a data-driven taxonomy without relying on predefined narrative categories. It encodes parliamentary discourse using semantic representations, filters relevant and reliable content through unsupervised confidence estimation, extracts narrative statements using LLMs, and uses narrative clustering and cluster analysis to construct a narrative taxonomy. Applied to Greek Parliament proceedings surrounding the 2023 Tempi train crash, it identifies ten recurring narrative families concerning responsibility attribution, institutional failure, railway safety, accountability, privatization, and the political interpretation of the tragedy. Our results demonstrate how combining unsupervised learning with LLM narrative extraction enables large parliamentary corpora to be transformed into interpretable, data-driven taxonomies of political narratives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套自动化分析流程，从议会辩论中提取政治叙事，并在不预设类别的情况下归纳形成叙事分类体系；研究以希腊议会对坦皮火车事故的讨论为例，识别出十类反复出现的叙事。
AI.motivation: 大型议会语料包含丰富的政治叙事，但人工梳理成本高，预先设定分类又可能限制发现。研究旨在以数据驱动方式，从原始辩论中系统提取并组织叙事。
AI.method: 该流程先将议会发言编码为语义表示，再通过无监督置信度估计筛选相关且可靠的内容；随后利用大语言模型提取叙事陈述，并通过叙事聚类及聚类分析构建分类体系。
AI.result: 应用于希腊议会围绕二〇二三年坦皮火车事故的会议记录后，研究识别出十类叙事，涉及责任归属、制度失灵、铁路安全、问责、私有化以及对悲剧的政治解读。
AI.conclusion: 结合无监督学习与大语言模型进行叙事提取，能够将大规模议会语料转化为可解释、由数据归纳而来的政治叙事分类体系，为分析政治话语提供了一种系统化路径。

title: DKnown-Jev-2: Article-Level Answer-Evidence Classification and Efficient Inference with a Pre-trained Language Model
summary: Evidence selection in normative knowledge question answering requires determining whether a candidate article contains content that directly supports an answer under the applicable conditions of the question. We present DKnown-Jev-2, an article-level answer evidence classifier designed for evidence integration across multiple paragraphs. The model jointly encodes question conditions, article metadata, and paragraph content, and uses a pointer-style classification head to predict Answer Evidence (AE) and Non-answer Evidence (NE) in a single forward pass. Ona manually annotated test set of 972 evaluation instances, DKnown-Jev-2 achieves 91.77% accuracy and 91.28% macro-F1, outperforming Jev by 2.16 and 2.37 percentage points, respectively, while reducing both evidence misses and non-evidence false positives. The test set contains 317 multi-paragraph instances, with a maximum body length of 9,322 characters. Shared article encoding and non-autoregressive classification support low-latency inference. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method for article-level evidence selection in normative knowledge question answering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向规范知识问答的文章级证据分类模型，可在一次推理中判断文章属于答案证据还是非答案证据，并在人工标注测试集上优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 规范知识问答中的证据筛选，需要判断候选文章是否在问题适用条件下直接支持答案。由于相关证据可能分布于多个段落，逐段判断或忽略问题条件都可能造成证据漏选与误选，因此需要能够整合问题、文章信息和段落内容的文章级方法。
AI.method: 模型联合编码问题条件、文章元数据及段落内容，并采用指针式分类头，在单次前向计算中预测文章是答案证据还是非答案证据。共享文章编码与非自回归分类旨在降低推理延迟，并支持多段落文章的证据整合。
AI.result: 在包含972个评测实例的人工标注测试集上，模型准确率为91.77%，宏平均F1为91.28%；相较基线方法，分别提高2.16和2.37个百分点，同时减少了证据漏判与非证据误判。测试集中有317个多段落实例，文章正文最长达9,322个字符。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，该方法能够有效进行规范知识问答中的文章级证据筛选，并在准确性、证据整合能力和推理效率方面具有应用价值。

title: Look Back, Draft Ahead: Corrective Prefix Attention for Parallel Speculative Decoding
summary: Parallel speculative decoders propose an entire token block at once, yet one early inconsistency can cause the target to reject its remaining suffix. We introduce Corrective Prefix Attention (CPA), which combines prefix-aware selection with autoregressive supervision to improve these parallel drafts. CPA lets each candidate attend to earlier choices within the block. Fixed candidate shortlists allow all pairwise interactions to be computed before selection, reducing the sequential walk to table lookups, accumulation and lightweight scoring rather than repeated neural evaluations. An auxiliary autoregressive loss trains the shared backbone on clean prefixes without adding an inference pass. Across eight math, code and dialogue benchmarks with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B targets on Ascend NPUs, CPA commits 13--15\% more tokens per verification round than DSpark and 25--26\% more than DFlash. Its mean speedups reach $3.35\times$ and $3.37\times$ under greedy decoding and $2.86\times$ under sampling for both targets. Ablations support both components, while capacity sweeps demonstrate that greater acceptance alone does not guarantee faster decoding. These results motivate correcting parallel proposals with causal information while keeping sequential computation inexpensive.

AI.tldr: 论文提出纠正式前缀注意力，通过让并行候选利用块内前序选择，并以自回归辅助训练提升草稿质量；在多项基准上提高每轮接受令牌数和解码速度。
AI.motivation: 并行推测解码一次提出一整块令牌，但若前部候选与目标模型不一致，后续令牌可能一并被拒绝，降低验证效率。论文希望把因果前缀信息融入并行草稿，同时避免引入昂贵的逐步神经网络计算。
AI.method: 纠正式前缀注意力包含两项设计：一是候选令牌可关注同一块中更早的选择；利用固定候选短名单，预先计算候选之间的两两交互，之后通过查表、累积和轻量评分完成选择，减少逐步计算。二是加入自回归辅助损失，使共享主干网络在干净前缀上接受训练，且推理时无需额外前向计算。
AI.result: 在八项数学、代码和对话基准，以及两种规模的目标模型和昇腾神经网络处理器上，该方法相较两种对比方法，每轮分别多提交百分之十三至十五、百分之二十五至二十六的令牌。贪心解码的平均加速比分别达到三点三五倍和三点三七倍；采样解码均为二点八六倍。消融实验支持两项设计的作用；容量实验则显示，接受率提高本身并不必然带来更快解码。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过因果前缀信息纠正并行提案、同时控制顺序计算开销，可以提升推测解码的有效性与速度。评估解码方案时，除接受率外，也应关注实际计算成本和端到端速度。

title: Serialization and the Character-System: Measuring Narrative Concentration in French Fiction (1800--1940)
comment: Computational Humanities Research Conference (Manchester, january 7-9) 24 pages, 9 figures, 6 tables
summary: Every novel divides a finite quantity of narrative attention among its characters, and whether the shape of that division, between a narrative organized around a single figure and one spread across a crowd, has a history is far less settled than the abundance of critical commentary on protagonists might suggest. We operationalize Woloch's notion of the character-system, the distribution of narrative attention across a novel's cast structured by the tension between "the one" and "the many", as the inequality (Gini coefficient) of the PageRank distribution over a character network. We trace this measure of structural concentration across 12,011 French novels published between 1800 and 1940, drawn from the Hors d'usage corpus of Gallica fiction. Over the long nineteenth century the trajectory is U-shaped, with concentration declining to a trough in the 1850s-1860s and rising again through the turn of the century. The change is small, comparable to the difference between a novel built on two co-equal protagonists and one built on a single protagonist, but it is robust to the character cutoff, corpus density, cast size, and author effects. Detective and adventure fiction are less concentrated than the average novel of their period. Literary history reads the roman-feuilleton either as the novel of a superior hero or as a form of proliferating episodes, and on this structural measure our results support the second reading. Across the age of the feuilleton (1840-1914), authors whose careers were structured by newspaper serialization distribute centrality more evenly than a literary control, net of period, genre, and canon. Because such claims are only as trustworthy as the networks they rest on, we also evaluate the extraction pipeline against manually annotated novels, at the levels of cast and character identity.

AI.tldr: 研究以人物关系网络中中心性分布的不平等程度衡量小说叙事注意力的集中度，并发现法国十九世纪小说的集中度先降后升；报刊连载作家的作品则更均衡地分配叙事中心性。
AI.motivation: 批评研究常讨论小说主人公，却较少明确说明叙事注意力在单一人物与群像之间的分配方式是否随历史变化。本文将沃洛克提出的“人物系统”概念转化为可量化指标，以考察小说叙事结构的长期演变。
AI.method: 研究分析一万二千零一十一部一八〇〇至一九四〇年间出版的法国小说。研究者构建人物关系网络，以人物页面排序中心性的基尼系数衡量注意力分配的不平等程度，并检验人物识别流程及结果对人物筛选阈值、语料密度、人物数量和作者差异等因素的稳健性；同时比较类型小说、报刊连载作家及文学对照组。
AI.result: 十九世纪的叙事集中度呈Ｕ形变化：从世纪初开始下降，在一八五〇至一八六〇年代达到低谷，随后至世纪之交回升。变化幅度不大，大致相当于双主角均衡叙事与单一主角叙事之间的差异，但在多项稳健性检验中仍然成立。侦探小说和冒险小说的集中度低于同期平均水平。就报刊连载小说而言，结果更支持其由众多事件和人物铺展的解释，而非围绕卓越英雄组织的解释；连载作家的作品也比对照组更均衡地分配人物中心性。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，小说叙事注意力的分配方式具有可测量的历史变化，且报刊连载与较分散的人物结构相关。通过人工标注小说检验人物集合和身份识别，本文也强调：关于文学结构的计算性结论，必须建立在可靠的人物网络抽取之上。

title: Deneb-Vritra: Descriptions, Edges and Names Examined by Blocking Via Restoring Token Representations and Attention
summary: Laya is a 421M-parameter encoder that answers a question about a text in one pass: each answer option, written as a name plus a description, gets a marker token, and one score is read from the network at each marker. We first confirm that such models can follow an option's name when it contradicts the description; the question is where in the network this happens. We locate it. On 951 synthetic questions we move each name onto another option's description and count how often the model picks the option with the right name (the name shortcut): 53% for the released checkpoint, 59% for our fine-tune v1, 11% for a fine-tune with name randomisation. On a 320-item sample, blocking attention from each marker to its own name tokens in layers 14 to 17 of 28 cuts v1's shortcut from 67% to 16% (19% on two schemas held out from component selection) while accuracy with the original names stays at 90%; blocking marker edges to the question, other options or text has no effect. No single head matters (largest effect 9 points), and restoring clean marker states undoes the swap from layer 16. Attention mass tracks the window by layer but not by head. Repeated on 5 checkpoints (released, fine-tuned, name-randomised, and a pair trained without two schemas), the knockout finds similar layers; in the name-randomised ones, blocking the description edges instead brings the shortcut back to 56-58%, so the read persists and is outvoted. Marker states decode the name from layer 0; a one-direction probe erasure changed nothing but was weaker than a random edit. Copying layers 0-13 or 14-27 of a name-randomised sibling into a fine-tune recovers 66% and 65% (v1); 21% and 45% (pair A) of its shortcut reduction. 9 of the 12 predictions we could score, written before running, failed. Head sweeps cover 5 of 5 checkpoints; data are synthetic and LLM-labelled; one architecture.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，模型会利用选项名称而非描述作答；这一捷径主要依赖网络中段标记位置对名称词元的注意连接。切断该连接可大幅削弱捷径而基本保留正常准确率，但证据受合成数据、单一架构等限制。
AI.motivation: 模型可能在选项名称与描述相互矛盾时仍追随名称，形成不可靠的名称捷径。论文旨在确定这种行为是否存在，以及它具体由网络中的哪些信息通路和层级实现，从而区分名称信息被读取与其最终影响预测这两个问题。
AI.method: 研究使用一款四点二一亿参数的编码器，在每个选项处设置标记，并从标记位置读取选项分数。作者构造合成问题，将名称移到其他选项的描述前，以测量模型是否选择名称正确的选项；再逐层阻断标记位置对名称词元、问题文本及其他内容的注意连接，比较捷径率和原始名称条件下的准确率。研究还进行干净状态恢复、注意力分析、探针擦除、层交换实验，并在五个检查点及未参与组件选择的题型上复测。
AI.result: 在九百五十一道合成题上，发布版模型的名称捷径率为百分之五十三，微调版为百分之五十九，而名称随机化微调版为百分之十一。对微调版而言，在二十八层中的第十四至十七层阻断标记位置指向自身名称的连接，使捷径率从百分之六十七降至百分之十六；两个留出的题型上为百分之十九，同时原始名称条件下准确率仍为百分之九十。阻断指向问题、其他选项或一般文本的连接没有类似效果；单个注意力头的作用较小。名称随机化模型中，阻断标记位置指向描述的连接反而会使名称捷径恢复至百分之五十六至五十八，说明名称信息仍被读取，只是其影响受到其他信息压制。层交换实验显示，不同层区段可部分恢复捷径削弱效果；预先写下的十二项预测中有九项未能得到支持。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持一种分层机制：模型从早期层起即可表征选项名称，但名称捷径对输出的因果影响主要集中在中间层、标记位置至名称词元的注意通路。名称随机化并未消除名称信息的读取，而是改变其与描述信息竞争输出的结果。该定位在多个检查点中具有一定一致性，但研究使用合成且由大语言模型标注的数据，且仅考察一种架构，因此结论能否推广到真实任务和其他模型仍待验证。

title: ToolSmith: An Automatic Tool-Generation Framework for Multimodal Search Agents
summary: Recent multimodal search agents use reasoning, vision, and live web search across many turns to answer questions beyond parametric knowledge by orchestrating a small library of hand-crafted search and visual tools. However, the library is laborious to create and maintain, and frozen when new query types, evidence formats, and failure modes are encountered in the wild. Human practitioners, by contrast, cope with insufficient tools by fashioning new ones from familiar parts and reusing them across tasks. Inspired by this, we propose ToolSmith, an automatic tool-generation framework that grows and reuses modules on top of a lean base tool library. We evaluate ToolSmith on three in-domain multimodal search benchmarks and ten out-of-domain benchmarks under a VLM-as-a-Judge protocol. ToolSmith consistently improves over the base library across deployed agents of varying scales, with larger backbones reaping greater gains, demonstrating the scalability of the approach. Our code and data are available at https://threesr.github.io/toolsmith/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“工具匠”框架，使多模态搜索智能体能够自动创建并复用工具模块，从而提升不同任务上的搜索表现。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态搜索智能体依赖人工设计和维护的工具库；遇到新型查询、证据格式或实际运行中的失败情况时，工具库难以灵活适应。相比之下，人类会利用熟悉的工具部件组合出新工具，并跨任务复用。本文旨在让智能体具备类似的工具扩展能力。
AI.method: 提出“工具匠”自动工具生成框架：以精简的基础工具库为起点，自动构建新的工具模块，并在不同任务中复用这些模块。研究在三项领域内多模态搜索基准和十项领域外基准上评估该框架，并采用视觉语言模型评审协议衡量表现。
AI.result: 在不同规模的已部署智能体上，“工具匠”均稳定优于仅使用基础工具库的方案；规模更大的基础模型获得的提升更明显，显示出该方法具有良好的扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 自动生成并复用工具模块，有望缓解手工工具库难以维护、适应性不足的问题，并提升多模态搜索智能体应对新任务的能力。摘要未提供具体性能数值，因此无法比较提升幅度。

title: From Point Clouds to Engineering Models: Benchmarking Agentic 3D Reconstruction in the Built Environment
summary: Coding agents can translate 3D measurements into CAD geometry, but reconstructing engineering models for the built environment demands semantic interpretation and consistent construction constraints beyond surface fitting. We formulate scene-level Scan-to-BIM (Building Information Modeling) as an agentic 3D coding task and introduce S2Bench, comprising public and proprietary scans of 128 real-world scenes across five domains, paired with expert-curated reference models spanning diverse spatial scales. A shared framework lets agents measure scans in Python, build class-labeled components in a live CAD/BIM kernel, and iteratively refine their code. We also propose parallel asynchronous collaboration, where a lead delegates versioned tasks, continues modeling while workers execute, and integrates revision-bound proposals. Evaluating five agents and a collaborative team across 1,028 reconstructions shows that scan-to-model residuals directly guide geometric repair, whereas inferring semantic classes and construction relations requires joint geometric, visual, and engineering reasoning that agents struggle to ground and verify. Consequently, the leading agent fits scan geometry closely ($96\%$ coverage within $5\,\text{cm}$) yet reaches only $63\%$ mIoU, and no agent passes all engineering checks on more than $38\%$ of scenes. Coverage and engineering conformance drop with scene scale, whereas running a smaller model as a team improves all three axes with greater coverage gains on larger scenes. The project page is available at https://tumcms.github.io/S2Bench.github.io/

AI.tldr: 论文提出面向建筑环境三维扫描到建筑信息模型重建的智能体基准与协作框架。实验表明，智能体较擅长贴合扫描几何，却难以可靠推断语义类别和工程约束；并行协作能提升整体表现，尤其有利于大场景。
AI.motivation: 将三维测量转换为计算机辅助设计几何并不足以重建建筑工程模型。此类任务还要求理解构件语义、推断构件之间的关系，并遵守一致的施工约束。论文旨在系统评估智能体处理这些场景级重建要求的能力。
AI.method: 提出场景级扫描到建筑信息模型任务的智能体编码框架及评测基准，包含五个领域的128个真实场景，配有专家整理的参考模型。智能体可用程序测量扫描数据，在实时计算机辅助设计与建筑信息模型内核中创建带类别标签的构件，并反复修改代码。论文还设计异步并行协作机制：负责人分派带版本信息的任务，同时继续建模，再整合与特定修订版本绑定的工作者方案。
AI.result: 论文评估了五种智能体及一个协作团队，共完成1,028次重建。最佳单体智能体有96%的扫描点位于模型5厘米范围内，但平均交并比仅为63%；没有智能体能在超过38%的场景中通过全部工程检查。场景规模增大时，几何覆盖率和工程符合度均下降。较小模型组成团队后，三项评估指标均有改善，且大场景的覆盖率提升更明显。
AI.conclusion: 扫描与模型之间的几何残差能够直接指导几何修补，但语义类别和施工关系的推断需要综合几何、视觉与工程知识，目前智能体难以充分依据证据完成推断并验证结果。异步协作有助于提升重建表现，但要实现可靠的建筑信息模型生成，仍需加强语义理解、工程约束推理及验证能力。

title: Specialized Large Language Models for Markovian Reasoning: Structural Cache Compression, Transition Pretraining, and Dual-Loop Transformers
summary: Standard autoregressive large language models attend to the growing history of generated tokens, making the key-value (KV) cache a central memory and throughput bottleneck in long-chain reasoning and multi-branch sampling. Yet an important class of reasoning problems is naturally first-order Markovian: the next step depends on a sufficient representation of the current state, rather than on the raw sequence of all earlier steps. We develop a unified design paradigm for Markovian-reasoning specialized large language models. At the cache level, the Markovian state interface transforms history-dependent KV storage into constant-size state transfer with respect to the number of reasoning steps. At the learning level, we reformulate long-chain prediction as independently trainable one-step transition objectives, with explicit state bottlenecks, distillation, invariance, and drift-consistency losses. At the architectural level, we introduce a dual-loop Transformer: an outer loop advances the reasoning state, while an inner recurrent-depth loop allocates adaptive computation to each transition through shared weights and explicit memory tokens or recurrent matrix states. We connect this architecture to a three-region cache, step-relative positions, truncated backpropagation, branch-aware checkpoints, and a transition-centric evaluation protocol. The organizing principle is simple: the optimal reasoning system need not remember everything; it must carry forward exactly what the future needs. This principle opens a path toward specialized reasoning engines whose memory footprint is decoupled from reasoning-chain length.

AI.tldr: 论文提出面向马尔可夫式推理的大语言模型设计框架，使模型以固定大小的状态传递代替随推理链增长的历史缓存，并为每一步分配可调计算量。
AI.motivation: 自回归模型通常需要缓存不断增长的历史键值信息，在长链推理和多分支采样中造成显著的内存与吞吐瓶颈。但许多推理任务具有马尔可夫性质：后续步骤只需依赖当前状态的充分表示，无须访问全部历史。因此，论文探索如何让模型仅保留未来推理所需的信息。
AI.method: 论文从三个层面构建设计范式：在缓存层，以固定大小的马尔可夫状态接口取代随推理步数增长的历史缓存；在学习层，将长链预测拆解为可独立训练的一步状态转移目标，并加入显式状态瓶颈、知识蒸馏、不变性和漂移一致性损失；在架构层，提出双循环变换器，外循环推进推理状态，内循环通过共享权重及显式记忆令牌或循环矩阵状态，为每次状态转移分配自适应计算。框架还涉及三区域缓存、相对步位置编码、截断反向传播、分支感知检查点及以状态转移为中心的评估方案。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据或量化性能结果。其主要成果是提出一套统一的模型设计与训练框架，目标是使缓存占用不再随推理链长度增长，同时支持对每一步推理进行灵活计算。
AI.conclusion: 对于具有马尔可夫结构的推理任务，模型未必需要记住全部历史；关键在于准确保留未来所需的充分状态表示。该思路为构建内存开销与推理链长度脱钩的专用推理模型提供了方向，但其实际效果仍需通过实验验证。

title: When Tools Fail, Agents Fabricate: Silent Failure and Verification-First Oversight in Tool-Using LLM Agents
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development. 12 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables
summary: Tool-using LLM agents must recover when a tool call fails, by retrying, switching tools, or revising their plan. We study how agents fail when tools fail, using RetryRealistic, a sandboxed yet realistic testbed for controlled fault injection in which agents operate on a real OS filesystem with genuine permission enforcement, SQLite databases, a deterministic local HTTP server, and a constrained shell, across 8 tools, 9 fault types with controlled persistence, and 30 multi-step tasks. Evaluating four agents over 2,100 faulted runs against ground truth, we find that recovery is unreliable (19-68% correct) and frequently silent: 6-26% of runs end in a confident fabrication, a wrong answer asserted as fact. The failure mode is governed more by the fault type than by the model: faults that return partial data drive fabrication (up to 38%), while hard denials drive honest failure. The mechanism is what we call silent ingestion: the agent accepts faulted data as valid on first contact without retrying or flagging the problem, then builds a fabricated answer on top of it. We show that fabrication is reducible: a verification-first Monitor, grounding checks in structured tool outputs and issuing corrective directives rather than hard blocks, raises correct recovery from 45.6% to 56.3% and cuts fabrication from 17.3% to 10.8%. Removing chain-of-thought increases fabrication (+8.3pp), so deliberation guards against silent ingestion. We release RetryRealistic, the fault-injection toolkit, and all annotated traces at https://github.com/Kingsford-Group/RetryRealistic

AI.tldr: 论文构建真实且可控的工具故障测试环境，发现智能体常把故障数据当作有效信息，进而编造答案；基于结构化工具输出进行核验，可提升恢复表现并减少编造。
AI.motivation: 使用工具的大语言模型智能体遇到调用失败时，需要重试、切换工具或调整计划，但其故障恢复能力及失效机制尚不清楚。现有评估难以在真实工具环境中系统控制故障，因此论文旨在测量恢复可靠性，并分析错误答案如何产生。
AI.method: 作者开发了一个沙盒测试平台，在具备真实权限控制的操作系统文件系统、数据库、确定性本地网络服务器和受限命令行环境中，对八种工具、九类可控持续性的故障及三十项多步骤任务进行测试。研究评估四种智能体的两千一百次故障运行，并依据标准答案标注结果；此外，设计了优先核验的监测器，通过检查结构化工具输出并发出纠正指令来引导智能体恢复。
AI.result: 智能体的正确恢复率为百分之十九至百分之六十八，百分之六至百分之二十六的运行以自信但错误的事实陈述告终。故障类型比模型本身更能决定失败方式：返回部分数据的故障容易诱发编造，比例最高达百分之三十八；明确拒绝访问则更常导致诚实的失败。论文将关键机制称为“静默摄入”：智能体首次接触故障数据时便将其视为有效信息，既不重试也不标记异常，随后据此构造虚假答案。优先核验监测器将正确恢复率从百分之四十五点六提高至百分之五十六点三，并将编造率从百分之十七点三降至百分之十点八。移除思维链后，编造率上升八点三个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 工具故障下的智能体失效不仅是调用失败，更可能源于未识别部分或异常数据，并将其静默纳入推理。通过核验工具输出、提供针对性纠正指引以及保留审慎推理，有望提升故障恢复可靠性并减少编造。论文同时发布了测试平台、故障注入工具和标注轨迹。

title: DiscernBench: Evaluating Cooperative Discernment of LLM Agents in Institutional Settings
comment: 33 pages, 11 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Interpreting Agent Behavior (IAB)
summary: The deployment of large language models in operational settings demands evaluation of judgment under institutional constraint. We introduce DiscernBench, a benchmark for evaluating cooperative discernment: the ability of an agent to determine whether to comply with, refuse, or escalate a request in an institutional setting. DiscernBench comprises scenarios derived from real-world incident reports across domains such as aviation, law enforcement, and emergency management. We evaluate eight LLMs across three decision-making configurations and analyze both final decisions and the intermediate judgments produced during multi-agent deliberation. Under disagreement, Final Responders exhibit model- and role-dependent aggregation patterns in which a lone specialist recommendation can disproportionately influence the collective decision, a phenomenon we term Minority-Signal Override. Role-specialized multi-agent deliberation raises average over-escalation from 3.79% under direct single-agent judgment to 28.27%, with the direction and magnitude of minority-signal influence varying substantially across models and specialist roles. These results reveal distinct collective decision behaviors that are not captured by final-answer accuracy alone. Trustworthy multi-agent systems therefore require evaluating not only individual specialist reasoning, but also how conflicting judgments are transformed into collective decisions. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Disha1001/DiscernBench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用于评估机构约束下协作判断能力的基准，发现多智能体讨论会显著增加过度升级，且少数意见可能不成比例地左右集体决策。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型进入实际机构场景后，不仅要判断请求内容，还需遵守制度约束，决定服从、拒绝或升级处理。仅看最终答案是否正确，无法揭示多智能体系统如何处理角色分工与意见冲突，因此需要专门评估协作判断及其决策过程。
AI.method: 研究提出“审慎判断基准”，以航空、执法和应急管理等领域的真实事件报告为基础构建场景。研究评测了八种大型语言模型在三种决策配置下的表现，并分析最终决策及多智能体讨论中的中间判断，重点考察意见分歧时少数意见对集体结论的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现，最终决策者的意见聚合方式因模型和角色而异；在意见不一致时，单个专家角色的建议可能对集体决定产生不成比例的影响，研究将此现象称为“少数信号覆盖”。采用角色专门化的多智能体讨论后，平均过度升级率从单智能体直接判断时的百分之三点七九升至百分之二十八点二七；少数意见影响的方向和幅度则随模型及专家角色显著变化。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体系统展现出的集体决策行为，不能仅凭最终答案准确率加以评估。要构建可信的多智能体系统，既要检查各专家的推理质量，也要评估系统如何将相互冲突的判断转化为集体决策。

title: EMIP: Embodied Multi-Party Interaction Platform
summary: Experimental platforms that enable multiple participants to engage in spoken dialogue and perform physical actions concurrently in a shared environment are important for studying cooperation between humans and embodied AI agents. In this paper, we propose EMIP (Embodied Multi-Party Interaction Platform), a virtual environment platform built on Minecraft. Through an Internet-based client-server architecture, EMIP connects multiple humans and multiple AI agents to the same virtual environment and supports full-duplex speech communication and simultaneous physical interaction. It provides interfaces based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for environmental observation, physical action execution, and audio input and output, enabling researchers to develop their own agent control methods using large language models (LLMs). Additional features include centralized control of an agent group through a single EMIP agent client, collaborative object transportation by multiple agents, and experimental support functions such as recording and retrieving observation histories. By integrating these features into a reusable platform, EMIP aims to support research on human-human, human-agent, and agent-agent cooperation under different participant configurations and agent control methods. Usage examples illustrate concurrent speech and physical action, task coordination, and overlapping speech. The source code for the platform is publicly available on GitHub (https://github.com/AI-Humans-Lab/EMIP-Embodied-Multi-Party-Interaction-Platform).

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个基于虚拟环境的具身多方交互平台，支持多人和多个智能体同时进行语音对话与身体动作交互，用于研究不同参与者组合下的协作。
AI.motivation: 研究人类与具身人工智能的协作，需要一个能让多名参与者在共享环境中同步交谈并执行动作的实验平台。现有平台若缺乏多方实时语音、并行动作或灵活智能体控制等能力，便难以支持这类研究。
AI.method: 作者构建了基于《我的世界》的具身多方交互平台，采用互联网客户端—服务器架构，将多名人类与多个智能体接入同一虚拟环境。平台提供环境观察、动作执行及音频输入输出接口，便于研究者使用大语言模型开发智能体控制方法；还支持单一客户端集中控制一组智能体、多人协作搬运物体，以及记录和检索观察历史。
AI.result: 平台具备全双工语音交流与同步身体交互能力。论文通过使用示例展示了并行语音与动作、任务协调和语音重叠等情形，并公开了平台源代码。摘要未报告量化性能评估或对照实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 该平台将多方语音交互、具身动作及实验辅助功能整合为可复用的研究基础设施，可用于开展人际、人机及智能体间协作研究，并支持不同参与者配置和智能体控制方法。

title: When Does Optical Context Compression Pay Off? A Decode-Aware Cost Analysis of Reasoning VLMs
summary: Rendering long text as images lets a vision-language model (VLM) read a document with fewer input tokens, and evaluations often count mainly these prefill tokens. We show that for reasoning models this accounting is incomplete. Across five models and two long-context benchmarks, reading the rendered document makes the model think longer: decode length grows by 1.5-3.5x on the four general-purpose VLMs tested, and under typical output pricing this decode tax makes image input more expensive than text for two of the five models on QuALITY. Unrecoverable information loss is not sufficient to explain the tax at moderate compression: Qwen's OCR of the same images recovers 98.7% of words, and feeding Kimi-K3 its own transcription as text restores text-mode reasoning length and accuracy. Whether compression pays off reduces to an exchange rate, (1-1/c)/(r-1), that must exceed the workload's price-weighted ratio of output to input tokens; this accounting decomposition shows why Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash can benefit and Qwen and GLM cannot. None of the training-free signals we test predicts the tax before generation. As a practical heuristic, an image-first policy that sends only inputs with a per-input compression ratio of at least 1.6 to images and falls back to text once image-mode reasoning costs as much as the input's prefill saving cuts the bill by 6-14% on Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at an accuracy cost of 0.3-1.2 points; on QuALITY, asking for a reasoning budget on both paths is a stronger lever.

AI.tldr: 将长文本转成图像虽能减少输入令牌，但可能显著增加推理输出；是否省钱取决于输入节省能否抵消输出成本。
AI.motivation: 现有评测常以输入阶段的令牌数衡量长文档图像化的效率，却较少计算推理模型生成答案时增加的输出令牌。论文因此考察图像输入是否会延长推理，以及这种额外开销是否会抵消输入压缩带来的成本优势。
AI.method: 研究在五种模型和两个长上下文基准上比较文本输入与图像输入，测量输入压缩、推理长度、准确率及费用；并用图像识别转录和将转录文本重新输入等实验，检验信息损失是否足以解释推理开销。作者还提出成本交换率分析，并评估无需训练的预测信号与按输入压缩率及生成费用动态切换输入形式的策略。
AI.result: 四种通用视觉语言模型在读取图像时，生成长度增加至文本模式的约一点五至三点五倍。中等压缩下，信息损失不足以单独解释这一现象：千问对图像的识别可恢复百分之九十八点七的词语，而让奇米-K3读取自身转录成的文本，可恢复文本模式的推理长度和准确率。在质量基准上，按常见输出定价计算，五种模型中有两种使用图像输入反而更贵。奇米-K3和深度求索-V4.1-闪较可能受益，千问和智谱模型则较难受益。测试的训练免信号均无法在生成前预测额外推理开销。实用策略是仅在单条输入的压缩率至少为一点六时采用图像，并在图像模式推理费用达到输入令牌节省额时切回文本；该策略在两种较适合图像输入的模型上降低百分之六至十四费用，准确率下降零点三至一点二个百分点。质量基准上，为两种输入路径都设置推理预算是更有效的控制手段。
AI.conclusion: 长文本图像化不能只依据输入令牌压缩判断是否划算，还必须计入图像输入引发的额外推理输出及其价格。是否采用图像取决于压缩收益与输出成本之间的交换关系，并随模型、任务和定价变化；目前缺少可靠的生成前预测信号，因此按压缩率和实际推理费用动态选择输入形式更为务实。

title: Same Executions, Different Gaps: Judgment Rules in Web-Agent Evaluation
summary: Success-rate gains guide the development of web agents. Yet knowing which agent ranks first does not tell us how much confidence to place in its reported advantage. We study the comparison itself: how success is defined, what evidence supports the judgments, and how the difference between agents is estimated. On fixed web-agent executions, changing a judge from predicting likely completion to requiring recorded support can remove most of a reported lead without changing the ranking. This effect persists when unresolved completion is distinguished from supported failure. Controlled source additions explain how missing relations between task requirements, objects and observations can conceal a difference or create an apparent advantage. We also find that making both agents' score estimates more accurate can make their difference less accurate, because their original errors partly canceled. To estimate a chosen outcome difference, we combine judge predictions with reference labels for sampled task pairs. Across four released execution systems, regression fitted on the same 50 labeled pairs reduces estimation error relative to direct paired sampling. The results give agent researchers a practical basis for assessing claimed improvements: make the comparison target explicit, retain the evidence needed to check it, and use paired labels to estimate the difference directly.

AI.tldr: 论文指出，网页智能体的成功率领先幅度会受到成功定义、判定证据和差值估计方法的显著影响；在四套已发布执行系统上，用五十组带参考标签的任务对拟合回归，比直接成对抽样更准确地估计差值。
AI.motivation: 仅知道哪个网页智能体排名更高，并不足以判断其优势有多可靠。成功标准、判定所依据的证据，以及智能体间差异的估计方式，都可能改变报告的领先幅度，甚至掩盖或制造表面优势。
AI.method: 研究者在固定的网页智能体执行记录上比较不同判定标准和证据要求，并通过受控地补充来源信息，考察任务要求、对象与观察结果之间缺失关联的影响。他们还分析各智能体分数估计误差对差值估计的作用，并将判定器预测与抽样任务对的参考标签结合，通过回归直接估计选定结果的差异。
AI.result: 把判定标准从预测任务是否可能完成，改为要求有记录证据支持，可能大幅缩小已报告的领先幅度，但不改变排名；区分未解决的完成情况与有证据支持的失败后，这一影响仍然存在。补充缺失关系信息能够解释差异为何被掩盖或产生表面优势。此外，即使两个智能体各自的分数估计更准确，差值也可能更不准确，因为原先的误差存在部分抵消。在四套执行系统上，使用同一批五十组带标签任务对拟合回归，较直接成对抽样降低了差值估计误差。
AI.conclusion: 评估网页智能体改进时，应明确比较的目标，保留足以核查判断的证据，并使用带参考标签的成对样本直接估计智能体间差值。单看排名或各自分数的准确性，不能充分判断领先幅度是否可信。

title: Interrogation Protocols for AI Control
comment: 26 pages (8 main + references and appendix), 21 figures, 4 tables. Under review. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/interrogation-protocols-A11B/
summary: As the intelligence of an AI agent increases relative to a trusted monitor, so does the risk that the monitor will fail to understand the agent's actions or to evaluate them confidently. We introduce interrogation protocols to a high-stakes AI control setting, and allow the monitor to ask the untrusted agent questions about confusing actions. For interrogation to improve safety, a weaker model must be able to distinguish misleading explanations produced by an attack policy from genuine ones produced by an honest policy. We find that on a held-out subset of BashArena, an interrogation protocol improves safety at a 1% audit budget from 72.6% for an actions-only baseline, which does not use interrogations, to 79.5% (+7.0 pp [+0.9, +20.1], 95% paired bootstrap interval), but most of this uplift can be captured by having a trusted model state a specific concern. More broadly, our work suggests that interrogating agents can improve safety, allowing monitors to catch more attacks at a larger capability gap.

AI.tldr: 研究表明，让监控器针对可疑行为询问不可信智能体，可能提升高风险人工智能系统的安全性；但大部分收益也可由可信模型直接指出具体疑点获得。
AI.motivation: 随着智能体能力相对可信监控器增强，监控器更可能无法理解其行为或有把握地评估行为是否安全。研究因此探讨：能否通过询问智能体来澄清可疑行为，并帮助监控器发现攻击。
AI.method: 研究在高风险人工智能控制场景中引入询问协议，允许监控器针对难以判断的行为向不可信智能体提问。该方法能否提升安全性，取决于较弱的监控器能否区分攻击策略生成的误导性解释与诚实策略生成的真实解释。研究在巴什竞技场的留出子集上评估这一方案，并与仅依据行为进行判断、不进行询问的基线比较。
AI.result: 在百分之一的审计预算下，询问协议的安全率为百分之七十九点五，行为单独判断的基线为百分之七十二点六，提升七个百分点；百分之九十五的配对自助法区间为零点九至二十点一个百分点。不过，大部分提升也可通过让可信模型明确指出具体疑点来实现。
AI.conclusion: 询问智能体有望帮助监控器发现更多攻击，并在智能体与监控器能力差距较大时提升安全性。但询问带来的额外收益尚不明确，因为直接提供具体疑点即可获得其中大部分提升；此外，询问效果依赖监控器识别诚实解释与误导性解释的能力。

title: SAMA: Training-Free Consensus Ridge Tracking for Camera-Based Heart Rate on Five Public Datasets
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) is usually benchmarked by one heart rate per video, a figure that hides the short windows in which a tele-consultation would actually read the pulse. We present SAMA, a training-free estimator that (i) forms a quality-weighted consensus of POS and CHROM chrominance spectra, (ii) discounts frequencies occupied by pulse-free references derived from the same frames (frame motion, skin-mask geometry and background brightness), (iii) follows the heart rate through time with a Viterbi ridge under a random-walk prior, and (iv) returns a track-filtered, amplitude-normalised waveform with a per-window confidence. No parameter is learned and no dataset-specific tuning is used. On 218 recordings from 111 participants in five public datasets (UBFC-rPPG, PURE, SUMS, M3PD and a two-participant subset of MMPD), all processed with the same fixed face box and scored with a re-implementation of the rPPG-Toolbox protocol, SAMA has the lowest mean absolute error (MAE) averaged over datasets at every protocol level: 4.40 against 5.13,bpm for POS per video, 4.80 against 5.43 on 30,s windows and 5.05 against 6.59 on 10,s windows. Pooled over participants, the bootstrap interval of its paired difference from POS excludes zero on 30,s and 10,s windows (Wilcoxon p=0.11 and 0.004) but not per video, and it does not beat POS on SUMS per video or on the MMPD subset. Withholding the 20\% least confident windows lowers the pooled 10,s error from 4.06 to 2.33,bpm. We also show that the per-video protocol has a floor of 1.2--1.6,bpm on datasets where heart rate drifts, and that skin tone cannot be recovered from uncalibrated video, which motivates the instrumented, skin-tone-stratified collection we propose for the Indian population. The method does not surpass the best published neural networks on UBFC-rPPG; we report where it stands against them without re-running them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的远程光电容积脉搏波估计方法，在多个数据集和短时窗口评估中总体优于脉搏正交投影基线，但优势因评估尺度和数据集而异。
AI.motivation: 常见评估方式为每段视频只给出一个心率，掩盖了远程诊疗等场景真正关心的短时脉搏估计表现。研究还指出，心率随时间变化会给逐视频评估带来误差下限，而未校准视频无法可靠推断肤色，因此需要更贴近实际应用的窗口级评估及经过仪器测量、按肤色分层的数据采集。
AI.method: 提出一种无需训练或针对数据集调参的估计器：对两种色度信号的频谱进行质量加权融合；利用同一视频中不含脉搏信息的运动、皮肤区域几何和背景亮度参考，降低对应频率的权重；通过随机游走先验下的维特比脊线追踪心率变化；最终输出经过轨迹筛选、幅度归一化的波形及逐窗口置信度。
AI.result: 在五个公开数据集、共218段记录和111名参与者上，按数据集平均的平均绝对误差，在逐视频、30秒窗口和10秒窗口评估中分别为4.40、4.80和5.05次/分钟，均低于基线的5.13、5.43和6.59次/分钟。按参与者汇总后，与基线的配对差异在30秒和10秒窗口的自助法区间均不含零；但相应威尔科克森检验结果分别为0.11和0.004，逐视频差异不显著。该方法在部分数据集上未胜过基线。排除置信度最低的20%窗口后，汇总的10秒窗口误差由4.06降至2.33次/分钟。方法仍未超过一个数据集上已发表的最佳神经网络结果。
AI.conclusion: 该方法以无需训练的设计，在多数据集的短时心率估计中展现出总体优势，置信度也可用于筛除较不可靠的窗口。不过，统计证据、跨数据集表现及逐视频结果并不一致，且方法并非所有数据集上的最佳方案。研究强调应重视短窗口评估，并建议开展带仪器测量且按肤色分层的人群数据采集。

title: torchtsetlin: Fast, Interpretable Tsetlin Machines for PyTorch
summary: The Tsetlin machine learns propositional rules with teams of Tsetlin automata that are driven by reward and penalty rather than gradients, so its models are interpretable by construction and cheap to evaluate. Its software, however, consists of C and CUDA kernels behind scikit-learn-style wrappers that sit outside the deep learning ecosystem. torchtsetlin implements the Tsetlin machine family as ordinary PyTorch modules: vanilla and weighted, coalesced, regression, convolutional over sequences, images and volumes, and dense per-pixel segmentation. The automata are a tensor buffer, so a model moves with .to(device), is saved with state_dict() and learns from a mini-batch with one update(x,y) call. Its core technique is a batched formulation of Type I and Type II feedback, in which automaton transitions become event counts realised as binomial draws, with one commit per mini-batch. On ten benchmarks taken from the existing libraries, it matches their accuracy, and on all but the two smallest it trains 2.4-10.9X faster than PyTsetlinMachineCUDA and 10.3-81.2X faster than tmu on the same GPU. The package is pure Python, MIT-licensed and on PyPI; every number in this paper is reproduced by one script. Code: https://github.com/vlbthambawita/torchtsetlin; package: https://pypi.org/project/torchtsetlin/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套基于张量框架实现的坦塞林机工具包，将多种坦塞林机模型整合为标准模块，并通过小批量并行更新显著提升训练速度，同时保持与既有实现相当的准确率。
AI.motivation: 坦塞林机通过奖励与惩罚驱动自动机学习逻辑规则，不依赖梯度，模型具有可解释性且推理开销低。然而，既有软件主要依赖Ｃ语言与图形处理器内核，并置于深度学习生态之外，难以融入常见的模型训练、设备迁移与保存流程。因此，本文旨在提供兼容主流张量框架、便于使用且高效的实现。
AI.method: 作者开发了一个纯 Python 工具包，将基础型、加权型、合并型、回归型，以及面向序列、图像、体数据和逐像素分割的卷积型坦塞林机实现为标准框架模块。自动机状态以张量缓冲区存储，支持设备迁移、状态保存和小批量学习。核心方法是批量化实现第一类与第二类反馈：将自动机状态转移转化为事件计数，通过二项分布抽样生成，并在每个小批量结束时统一提交更新。
AI.result: 在十项取自现有软件库的基准测试中，新工具包取得了与既有实现相当的准确率。在除两项规模最小的测试外，其训练速度相较于两种对照实现分别提升约２．４至１０．９倍、１０．３至８１．２倍，测试均在同一图形处理器上进行。论文还提供单一脚本以复现所有报告结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，批量化自动机更新能够在保持模型性能的同时显著加快坦塞林机训练，并使其更易融入深度学习工作流。工具包采用宽松许可并公开发布，有望降低坦塞林机的使用与复现实验门槛。

title: AutoPILOT: A Visual Agent Harness for Real-Time Gameplay
summary: Multimodal foundation models can play video games well when the game waits for them, but often fail when it keeps running.
