We derive per-field confidence estimates from the token log-probabilities the model already produces, via a token-to-span alignment procedure that maps logprobs onto each extracted value within the structured JSON output. Evaluated on two benchmarks (CORD v2 receipts, Kleister NDA legal contracts) with three VLM families, the minimum token probability per field achieves Area Under the ROC Curve (AUROC) 0.74-0.91 for error detection, far exceeding verbalized confidence (0.53-0.56). The uncertain fields form a natural training curriculum: fine-tuning via Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) improves accuracy from 78.5% to 87.5% on CORD (67 examples) and from 70.7% to 75.1% on multi-page NDA contracts (259 examples), while substantially improving error detection on Kleister NDA (AUROC 0.70 to 0.85, Area Under the Accuracy-Rejection Curve (AUARC) 0.78 to 0.92). The loop requires no annotation beyond the training-split ground truth, demonstrating that confidence-guided curriculum selection transfers to complex multi-page documents when combined with native multi-image training. A frontier model (Claude Sonnet 4) used as a pseudo-label judge achieves ~92% reward agreement with ground truth on both benchmarks, suggesting this loop can operate without human annotation.

AI.tldr: 研究利用模型已有的词元概率估计文档各字段的置信度，并据此挑选不确定样本进行训练；实验显示，这种方法既能更好地发现错误，也能提升字段抽取准确率。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型能够从扫描的金融与法律文档中抽取结构化字段，却通常无法指出哪些字段可能有误。模型口头给出的置信度不够可靠，因此需要一种无需额外置信度标注、能利用模型现有信息评估字段风险的方法。
AI.method: 研究通过词元与字段值的对齐过程，将模型输出词元的对数概率映射到结构化结果中的各个字段，并以字段内最低词元概率作为错误风险指标。随后将低置信度字段用于构造训练课程，采用组相对策略优化微调模型；训练利用训练集真值，也探索以强模型充当伪标签评判者，以减少人工标注需求。
AI.result: 在收据基准和多页法律合同基准上，使用三个视觉语言模型进行评估时，最低词元概率识别错误的受试者工作特征曲线下面积为0.74至0.91，明显高于口头置信度的0.53至0.56。置信度引导微调使收据准确率从78.5%升至87.5%，合同准确率从70.7%升至75.1%；合同错误检测的曲线下面积从0.70升至0.85，准确率—拒绝曲线下面积从0.78升至0.92。强模型作为伪标签评判者时，与真值的奖励判断一致率约为92%。
AI.conclusion: 模型自身的词元概率可以转化为有效的字段级置信度，并用于定位错误、筛选训练样本和提升抽取性能。该方法仅需训练集真值，结合原生多图训练后也适用于复杂的多页文档；使用强模型进行伪标签评判还显示出减少人工标注的潜力。

title: iFeST: An Iterative Motion Correction Framework for Fetal Brain Diffusion MRI via Frequency-Spatial-Temporal Modeling
summary: Fetal brain diffusion magnetic resonance imaging (dMRI) is a pivotal non-invasive tool for assessing the development of brain connectivity and microstructure. However, the prolonged acquisition times and complex sampling requirements render dMRI highly susceptible to unpredictable fetal motion. Existing motion correction methods typically process each dMRI volume independently and focus on inter-slice motion. Such strategies fail to utilize the coherent information between dMRI volumes along different diffusion directions and lack the ability to restore the intra-slice corruption. To address these limitations, we proposed iFeST, an iterative framework that combines frequency (k-space), spatial, and temporal (inter-slice) modeling for fetal brain dMRI motion correction. At each iteration, iFeST integrates information across diffusion directions into fiber orientation distributions (FODs). These distributions encode local fiber orientations within each voxel and serve as microstructural priors for intra-slice restoration and inter-slice alignment in the next iteration. To train the framework, we developed a fetal brain dMRI motion simulator that synthesizes compound motion artifacts from FODs. Evaluation on simulated datasets demonstrated that iFeST outperformed four inter-slice networks in motion estimation and three intra-slice networks in image restoration. Further validation on a real-world dataset confirmed significantly better volume reconstruction and FOD estimation than conventional pipelines. Overall, iFeST provides a learning-based framework for fetal dMRI motion correction, restoring motion-corrupted data and improving microstructural reconstruction for downstream diagnostic applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种迭代式胎儿脑扩散磁共振成像运动校正框架，联合利用频域、空间及层间信息，并借助纤维取向分布恢复受运动影响的数据。
AI.motivation: 胎儿脑扩散磁共振成像采集时间长、采样复杂，容易受到不可预测的胎儿运动干扰。现有方法通常逐个处理影像体积，主要校正切片间运动，既未充分利用不同扩散方向间的关联信息，也难以恢复切片内部的图像损坏。
AI.method: 提出迭代框架，在频域、空间域和切片间进行联合建模。每轮迭代整合不同扩散方向的信息，估计各体素内的纤维取向分布，并将其作为微结构先验，用于后续切片内部恢复与切片间配准。此外，构建胎儿脑扩散磁共振运动模拟器，根据纤维取向分布合成复合运动伪影，以训练该框架。
AI.result: 在模拟数据上，该方法的运动估计效果优于四种切片间校正网络，图像恢复效果优于三种切片内校正网络。在真实数据上，其影像体积重建和纤维取向分布估计也显著优于传统处理流程。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过迭代利用跨扩散方向的微结构信息，兼顾切片内恢复和切片间配准，可提升胎儿脑扩散磁共振数据的运动校正与微结构重建质量，为后续诊断应用提供更可靠的数据。

title: WASP: Continual Weight Adaptation for Streaming LLM Personalization
summary: Personalized large language models (LLMs) should continually adapt to users' evolving preferences. Yet extracting preference changes from noisy interaction histories while supporting inexpensive updates remains challenging. We introduce WASP (Weight Adaptation for Streaming Personalization), a recurrent framework that captures fine-grained preferences directly from raw user interactions and generates personalized LoRA adapters without expensive per-user optimization. Specifically, WASP achieves this by training a shared hypernetwork that maintains a compact user representation and outputs adapter weights in a single forward pass. As new interactions arrive, WASP updates this representation without reprocessing full interaction history, enabling continual adaptation with per-update costs independent of history length. Experiments on personalization benchmarks and chronological interaction streams show that WASP sustains high-quality personalization over long horizons under fixed compute and storage budgets. Together, these results support efficient streaming personalization and facilitate privacy-preserving on-device deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向持续个性化的循环框架，可从用户交互中增量提取偏好，并以较低计算与存储开销生成个性化适配器。
AI.motivation: 用户偏好会随时间变化，个性化大语言模型需要持续适应。但交互记录往往含有噪声，准确识别偏好变化并为每位用户反复进行昂贵优化，仍具挑战。若每次更新都需重新处理完整历史，也难以满足长期运行与设备端部署的需求。
AI.method: 该框架训练一个共享超网络，为每位用户维护紧凑表示，并通过一次前向计算生成个性化低秩适配器。新交互到来时，系统增量更新用户表示，无需重新处理全部历史，因此单次更新的计算开销不随历史长度增长。
AI.result: 在个性化基准和按时间顺序排列的交互流实验中，该方法在固定计算与存储预算下，能够在较长时间范围内维持较高质量的个性化效果。摘要未提供具体指标或与各基线的定量比较。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，通过共享超网络和紧凑的递归用户表示，可以更高效地实现流式个性化，并支持注重隐私的设备端部署。其主要价值在于降低持续更新成本，同时适应用户不断变化的偏好。

title: AutoSECO: Automated Skill Evolution for Cross-Problem Combinatorial Optimization with General-Purpose LLM Agents
summary: General-purpose large language model (LLM) agents can develop complete solvers for combinatorial optimization problems. Their specialization, however, often relies on workflows engineered for individual problems, limiting the reuse of development expertise. We propose AutoSECO, an automated skill evolution method that learns reusable solver-development guidance from experience. The challenge is that external evaluation measures the completed solver, while the skill guides decisions during development. AutoSECO connects this feedback to guidance deficiencies by tracing performance shortfalls through solver code and recorded development decisions. Revisions are expressed as general instructions and retained only if a fresh solver developed under the revised skill achieves a lower mean evaluation gap. Evolved solely on the traveling salesperson problem (TSP), the skill guides fresh agents in developing solvers for capacitated vehicle routing, job-shop scheduling, and three-dimensional bin packing without further skill evolution. On TSP, the final mean benchmark gap is 0.52\%, compared with 0.98\% for the skill-evolution baseline SkillOpt. Across all four problems, the evolved skill achieves better aggregate results than no skill guidance, the initial skill, and SkillOpt. The same frozen skill also supports solver development under alternative model--harness configurations. These findings suggest that solver-development experience can be retained as reusable expertise for general-purpose LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自动化技能演化方法，将求解器开发经验提炼为可复用指导；仅在旅行商问题上演化得到的技能，也能帮助智能体解决多种未参与演化的组合优化问题。
AI.motivation: 通用大语言模型智能体能够开发组合优化求解器，但现有方法往往针对单个问题设计专门工作流，开发经验难以迁移复用。另一个关键难点是，外部评估只衡量最终求解器的表现，而技能指导的是开发过程中的决策，两者之间存在反馈落差。
AI.method: 作者提出自动化技能演化方法。该方法通过追踪求解器代码和开发过程记录，将最终性能不足与技能指导缺陷联系起来；再把改进内容写成通用指令，并要求新智能体在修订后的技能指导下重新开发求解器。只有当新求解器的平均评估差距降低时，修订后的技能才会被保留。
AI.result: 技能仅在旅行商问题上演化，之后未经进一步演化，便用于引导智能体开发容量约束车辆路径、作业车间调度和三维装箱问题的求解器。在旅行商问题上，最终基准平均差距为百分之零点五二，优于技能演化基线方法的百分之零点九八。在四类问题的总体结果上，演化后的技能优于无技能指导、初始技能和基线方法；同一冻结技能也适用于不同的模型与运行框架配置。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，求解器开发过程中的经验可以被提炼为可迁移、可复用的指导知识。通过把最终性能反馈追溯到开发决策，并以新求解器表现验证技能修订，智能体有望将针对单一问题积累的经验迁移到其他组合优化任务。

title: ReVAgent: Multi-Agent Reasoning-Intensive Video Generation
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Ruize Han is the corresponding author
summary: A central challenge in generating instructional videos for reasoning-intensive topics is to show how and why the state changes at each step. Even when an animation renders successfully, the depicted object relationships and state transitions can conflict with the explanation, making the reasoning difficult to follow. We present ReVAgent, a multi-agent framework that solves a problem, generates keyframes for its explanation, and synthesizes an instructional video. The agents share the execution record of a solution program, reuse intermediate results and constructions in the scenes, and check rendered keyframes to guide revisions to the solution or the scenes. We also introduce a multidimensional rubric for assessing whether generated videos present the problem clearly, organize the steps coherently, and use visuals to explain the reasoning. We calibrate a multimodal judge using human ratings and apply it to instructional videos for mathematics and algorithms. In the evaluated samples, ReVAgent presents multi-step reasoning coherently and uses diagrams to show how key operations lead to subsequent states.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多智能体框架，可将问题求解过程、关键画面与讲解视频连接起来，并通过多维评价检验视频的清晰度、步骤连贯性和视觉解释效果。
AI.motivation: 推理密集型教学视频的难点不只是成功生成动画，更要让画面中的对象关系和状态变化与讲解推理一致。若两者冲突，学习者便难以理解每一步为何发生、如何导向下一状态。
AI.method: 提出多智能体框架“瑞维智能体”：先求解问题并生成解题程序的执行记录，再据此制作关键画面和教学视频。各智能体共享执行记录，在场景中复用中间结果与构造，并检查渲染后的关键画面，以指导对解答或场景的修改。此外，研究提出涵盖问题呈现、步骤组织和视觉解释的多维评价标准，并利用人工评分校准多模态评审模型。
AI.result: 在数学和算法教学视频样本的评估中，该框架能够连贯呈现多步推理，并通过图示展示关键操作如何推动状态变化。摘要未提供具体量化指标或基线比较结果。
AI.conclusion: 将程序执行记录、场景构造与画面检查整合进视频生成流程，有助于提高推理型教学视频中讲解与视觉状态变化的一致性。研究还提供了面向教学效果的多维评价方法，但其效果仍需结合更大规模数据和量化对比进一步验证。

title: Adopting AI Technologies without Traps: A Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework
summary: AI technologies and AI agents play increasingly important roles in human society, including in education, economics, and research. Adopting AI technologies can bring immediate, and sometimes tremendous, rewards such as through productivity boost, but they can also bring negative effects including but not limited to losses of job and training opportunities, and cognitive capability declines. Thus, it is important to investigate the optimal ways of adopting AI technologies without different traps. In this paper, we develop a general multi-agent Markov decision process (MDP) based reinforcement learning (RL or MARL) modeling framework for determining and analyzing optimal adoption of AI technologies. This framework can model the long-term dynamic effects of AI adoption, and lead to finding the optimal AI adoption strategies. In our modeling framework, the negative effects of AI adoption are modeled by undesirable state transitions or negative rewards in the MDPs. The proposed multi-agent RL MDPs incorporate both human agents and AI agents. The key idea of our models is that incorporating AI technologies may not only increase the immediate rewards for AI agents but also alter the states of the involved human and AI agents. In particular, we apply this framework to analyzing AI offloading leading to skill erosion, to analyzing optimal human resource structures for a firm adopting AI, and to analyzing the economic equilibria in the trading/employment among human and AI agents. Since the multi-agent MDP based RL technique is from control, machine learning and AI, this research is essentially using an AI technique to determine the optimal ways of adopting or co-existing with AI without traps.

AI.tldr: 论文提出多智能体强化学习分析框架，用于评估人工智能技术采用的长期影响并寻找较优策略，重点考察技能弱化、企业人力结构及人类与人工智能的经济互动。
AI.motivation: 人工智能能够提升生产力并带来即时收益，但也可能造成就业与培训机会减少、认知能力下降等长期负面影响。论文旨在研究如何采用人工智能，避免只追求短期回报而陷入长期损害。
AI.method: 构建基于多智能体马尔可夫决策过程的强化学习框架，将人类与人工智能都建模为智能体，并通过状态变化或负奖励表示采用人工智能可能产生的不利影响。框架用于描述人工智能对即时收益以及人类和人工智能智能体状态的长期动态作用，并据此分析较优采用策略。论文将其应用于人工智能任务卸载导致的技能弱化、企业采用人工智能时的人力资源结构，以及人类与人工智能之间的交易和就业经济均衡。
AI.result: 摘要说明该框架可用于刻画人工智能采用的长期动态影响，并分析相应的较优策略与均衡；但未提供具体实验数据、数值结果或不同策略的量化比较。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出以多智能体决策与强化学习方法分析人工智能采用及共存问题，强调应同时考虑即时收益和对人类能力、就业结构及经济关系的长期影响。其贡献主要是提供通用建模框架及多个应用方向，具体结论仍需结合论文中的模型设定和实证结果判断。

title: VeriWorld: A Verifiable Visual SWE-Bench for Spatial Reasoning in 3D Environments
comment: 32 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets Track. Code at https://github.com/VITA-Group/VeriWorld and dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/yanyanzheng96/VeriWorld
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for spatial tasks such as navigation and manipulation, where they must infer geometry and object relationships from visual input in order to act correctly. Existing benchmarks usually test perception and reasoning in isolation, making it hard to tell whether failures come from visual understanding, downstream reasoning, or the bridge between them. We introduce VeriWorld, a benchmark for spatial reasoning in interactive 3D environments with executable actions and deterministic verification. For task families where all three channels are well-defined, we evaluate matched visual, structured, and combined input conditions on the same instance, environment, and verifier; families without a clean visual/structured/combined split are reported separately. This design supports controlled comparisons of perception, reasoning, and their interaction. Using this setup, we uncover two diagnostic findings. First, models often perform much better when task-relevant information, such as object identity, current state, or target location, is given explicitly than when it must be read from the rendered scene, revealing a recurring visual-to-structure gap. Second, action-space and harness design can change outcomes even under the same task and information condition, showing that interaction protocol is itself a confounding variable. VeriWorld is open-sourced to support reproducible and fine-grained evaluation of spatial reasoning in VLMs.

AI.tldr: VeriWorld 是一个面向交互式三维环境的空间推理基准，通过可执行动作、确定性验证和受控输入对比，区分视觉理解、推理及二者衔接中的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基准常将视觉感知与后续推理分开测试，难以判断模型失败究竟源于场景理解、推理能力，还是从视觉信息到结构化表示的转换。交互协议和动作空间也可能影响结果，因此需要更可控、可诊断且可复现的评测。
AI.method: 构建 VeriWorld，在交互式三维环境中设置空间任务，并以可执行动作和确定性验证判断结果。对于能够明确区分输入形式的任务，针对同一实例、环境和验证器，比较视觉输入、结构化输入及两者结合的条件；无法进行这种一致拆分的任务则单独报告。评测设计用于分别考察感知、推理及其交互，并检验动作空间与交互框架的影响。
AI.result: 实验揭示两项诊断性发现：一是当物体身份、当前状态或目标位置等关键信息被明确提供时，模型表现通常显著优于需要从渲染场景中自行提取信息的情况，显示出反复出现的视觉到结构化信息鸿沟；二是即使任务和信息条件相同，动作空间与评测框架的设计也会改变结果，说明交互协议是重要的混杂因素。
AI.conclusion: VeriWorld 提供了一种更细粒度、可控且可复现的空间推理评测方式，有助于区分视觉理解、推理及交互设计对模型表现的影响。该基准已开放源代码，可支持后续研究和公平比较。

title: CLIP-FMoE: Scalable CLIP via Fused Mixture-of-Experts with Enforced Specialization
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have emerged as a promising approach for scaling deep learning models while maintaining computational efficiency. However, existing MoE adaptations for Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) models suffer from significant computational overhead during sequential training and degradation of zero-shot capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose CLIP-FMoE, a novel approach that integrates MoE architecture into CLIP fine-tuning. Our method uses Isolated Constrained Contrastive Learning, a pipeline that trains specialized experts on cluster-based data partitions to accelerate expert specialization. Additionally, we introduce a Fusion Gate mechanism to mitigate catastrophic forgetting of pre-trained knowledge. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves consistent improvements on downstream tasks while preserving zero-shot capabilities. Furthermore, our method demonstrates robust performance across varying context lengths, making it particularly suitable for diverse real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CLIP-FMoE，将混合专家架构用于 CLIP 微调，在提升下游任务表现的同时尽量保留零样本能力，并增强对不同上下文长度的适应性。
AI.motivation: 现有面向 CLIP 的混合专家方法在顺序训练时计算开销较大，且可能损害模型原有的零样本能力。研究旨在提升专家专门化效率，同时减少预训练知识遗忘。
AI.method: 提出 CLIP-FMoE，采用隔离约束对比学习流程，依据聚类结果划分数据并训练专门化专家，以加速专家学习；同时引入融合门控机制，融合专家信息并缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.result: 摘要称，在多个基准测试中，该方法持续改善下游任务表现，并保留零样本能力；在不同上下文长度下也表现稳健。摘要未提供具体数据或基线对比数值。
AI.conclusion: CLIP-FMoE 通过数据分区训练专家与融合门控，试图兼顾模型适应性、计算效率和预训练能力保持，适用于多样化的实际场景。

title: Learning Heterogeneous Reasoning in Large Language Models: From Mode Compatibility to Local Bottlenecks
summary: Post-training large language models routinely pools reasoning trajectories from diverse teachers or algorithms, yet it remains unclear whether standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can learn such heterogeneous strategies without explicit mode conditioning. We study the learnability and local bottlenecks of heterogeneous reasoning through a formal mixture formulation and controlled experiments. We first formalize the representational compatibility of the optimal autoregressive model with latent reasoning mixtures: the target next-token distribution weights modes by their prefix posteriors and concentrates on a single mode once alternative modes assign negligible likelihood to the prefix. In a verifiable symbolic graph-search environment with paired breadth-first and depth-first search trajectories, no consistent disadvantage is observed for unlabeled mixed SFT relative to homogeneous or labeled baselines under matched token budgets while preserving both modes. Scaling across 0.6B--14B models and data budgets largely eliminates global mode confusion, shifting the primary bottleneck to local state-tracking transitions. Because a local mistake affects the final outcome only when subsequent reasoning is sensitive to that step, we find that only a small fraction of local errors are outcome-determining \emph{Critical Reasoning Nodes (CRNs)}, and that single-step repairs at these nodes rescue failing trajectories across symbolic search and natural language benchmarks whenever the model has sufficient downstream competence to complete the remaining derivation. Our environment is open-sourced at https://github.com/Bowen1911/Symbolic_graph_env.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在推理模式无需显式标记的情况下，监督微调通常能够学习混合的推理轨迹；主要瓶颈不是整体模式混淆，而是少数会影响最终结果的局部状态跟踪错误。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的后训练常汇集来自不同教师或算法的推理轨迹，但这些策略彼此异质时，普通监督微调能否在没有模式标记的情况下学会并保留它们，仍不明确。研究旨在分析这种学习能力及其具体瓶颈。
AI.method: 研究首先建立潜在推理模式混合的形式化模型，说明最优自回归模型如何依据当前前缀对各模式赋予概率，并在其他模式难以解释该前缀时集中于单一模式。随后，在可验证的符号图搜索环境中，对广度优先搜索与深度优先搜索轨迹进行配对实验，并比较未标记混合训练、单一模式训练和带模式标签训练；实验还考察不同模型规模与数据预算，并分析局部错误及其对最终结果的影响。
AI.result: 在相同词元预算下，未标记的混合训练相较于单一模式或带标签基线，没有呈现稳定劣势，且能保留两种搜索模式。模型规模从六亿至一百四十亿参数、数据预算增加后，整体模式混淆大多消退，主要瓶颈转为局部状态跟踪。研究进一步发现，只有少数局部错误会实质性决定最终结果，这些节点被称为“关键推理节点”；在模型具备足够后续推导能力时，修复单个关键节点即可挽救符号搜索和自然语言基准中的失败轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 异质推理轨迹并不必然要求显式模式条件，标准监督微调在受控设置下可以学习并保留多种策略。提升推理可靠性的重点应从普遍性的模式区分转向定位并修复少数关键局部错误；这种修复能否奏效，也取决于模型是否具备完成后续推导的能力。

title: A statistical measure of trust in generative AI
summary: Trustworthiness is a crucial issue for generative AI, as modern models can produce convincing and confident responses even when their outputs are incomplete, unsupported, or wrong. The frequent absence of ground-truth knowledge or labels complicates verification of generative AI outputs. To address this issue, we propose a trustworthiness framework grounded in model-internal confidence calibrated against an external expert reference. We estimate per-token trustworthiness of a student generative model as the statistical typicality of each generated token relative to an expert model's distribution, where the expert is used as a distributional reference rather than as a source of factual verification labels. To this end, we introduce an AI ontology calibrator that leverages the student model's internal latent features and token-level output statistics to compute expert-reference acceptance scores. Combined with traditional token-level confidence, entropy, and perplexity statistics, calibrator scores yield a compact set of $15$ response-level indicators for correctness classification. Evaluated across BF program generation, mathematical problem solving, and medical question answering, combined calibrator and traditional indicators provide complementary reliability signal which could be used to build detectors of untrustworthy outputs and hallucinations. Remarkably, our experiments show that these detectors are transferable across domains, although transferability is not always symmetric.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种以专家模型分布为参照的生成内容可信度评估框架，并发现其与传统置信度指标结合后，能为跨领域识别错误或幻觉输出提供互补信号。
AI.motivation: 生成式人工智能可能以流畅且肯定的方式给出不完整、缺乏依据或错误的回答，而现实中常缺少可用于核验的真实答案或标注。论文因此希望在不依赖事实核验标签的情况下，评估模型输出的可信程度。
AI.method: 以学生生成模型为评估对象，将其生成的每个词元相对于专家模型输出分布的统计典型性作为可信度依据；专家模型只充当分布参照，而不提供事实正确性标签。研究提出人工智能本体校准器，利用学生模型的内部潜在特征和词元级输出统计计算专家参照接受分数，并将这些分数与传统的词元置信度、熵和困惑度等统计量结合，构成十五项回答级指标，用于正确性分类。
AI.result: 在程序生成、数学问题求解和医学问答任务上的实验表明，校准器分数与传统指标能够提供互补的可靠性信号，可用于构建不可信输出及幻觉检测器。检测器可以跨领域迁移，但迁移效果并不总是对称。
AI.conclusion: 该框架展示了利用模型内部信号并以专家模型分布进行校准的可行性，为缺少真实标签时评估生成内容可信度提供了替代路径。其指标组合具备跨领域应用潜力，但领域间迁移的不对称性意味着仍需针对具体迁移方向进行验证。

title: MMMem: Self-Improving Agents with Task-Aware Multimodal Experience Consolidation
summary: AI agents accumulate conversations, images, and documents through long-term interactions with users. Answering later questions often requires connecting evidence across these records, yet the resulting understanding is rarely retained, allowing mistakes to recur on related questions. Existing multimodal memory methods largely focus on storing and retrieving records, with limited mechanisms for learning from completed tasks and consolidating task-specific experience. We therefore propose MMMem, a task-aware multimodal memory framework that extracts and consolidates experience from completed tasks through four complementary strategies. First, source-linked multi-view memory organizes original text, images, and rendered pages alongside generated scene images that combine clues across records for retrieval. Second, source-generated tasks support knowledge alignment at two levels: warm-up consolidates source knowledge into task-relevant experiences in external memory, while self-training adapts the model's parametric knowledge to task demands. Third, the same vision-language model distills completed tasks into experiences that record the task context, conclusion, and support links. Finally, task-aware retrieval recalls source views and relevant experiences for answering and verification, while source-supported reuse guides long-term retention. Across three memory benchmarks and two vision-language readers, MMMem outperforms eight baselines. With Qwen3.5-9B, MMMem achieves relative gains of 36.9%, 17.6%, and 15.2% over the best-performing baselines on LoCoMo, Mem-Gallery, and LooGLE v2, respectively. Ablations show consistent gains from training and memory warm-up, while case studies illustrate how individual components work in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向任务的多模态记忆框架，通过整理来源材料、提炼已完成任务的经验并在后续问答中检索复用，提升智能体跨记录回答问题的能力。
AI.motivation: 智能体与用户长期互动后会积累大量对话、图像和文档，回答后续问题往往需要跨记录整合证据。然而，现有多模态记忆方法主要关注材料存储与检索，较少从已完成任务中学习并沉淀经验，导致相关问题上的错误可能反复出现。
AI.method: 框架包含四项互补策略：一是构建带来源链接的多视角记忆，保存原始文本、图像和页面，并生成融合多条记录线索的场景图像；二是利用来源材料生成任务，通过预热将来源知识整理为外部任务经验，并通过自训练使模型参数知识适应任务需求；三是由同一视觉语言模型将已完成任务提炼为经验，记录任务背景、结论及其证据来源；四是在回答与核验时按任务检索相关来源视图和经验，并通过有来源支持的复用促进长期保留。
AI.result: 在三个记忆基准和两种视觉语言模型上，该框架优于八种基线方法。使用九十亿参数的模型时，相比各基准上表现最佳的基线，在三个基准上的相对提升分别为百分之三十六点九、百分之十七点六和百分之十五点二。消融实验显示，训练和记忆预热均能稳定带来收益；案例分析展示了各组件的实际作用。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，多模态记忆不应止于存储和检索，还应将任务完成过程转化为可追溯、可复用的经验，并结合模型训练与外部记忆巩固。该框架在多项基准上取得明显提升，说明任务感知的经验学习有助于改善长期交互中的跨记录问答与证据核验。

title: MH-RAG-DIVE: Dynamic and Cost-Efficient Multi-Hop RAG Evaluation via Tree-Cached Dialogue Simulation
comment: This preprint was accepted for presentation at the 19th International Conference on Agents and Artificial Intelligence (ICAART27)
summary: Quality assessment is essential for determining whether changes to a Retrieval-Augmented Generation system improve or maintain its performance. However, existing evaluation approaches often rely on single-turn or single-hop interactions and therefore do not capture the complexity of multi-hop, multi-turn conversations. We introduce MH-RAG-DIVE, a dynamic interactive user simulation framework designed to evaluate RAG systems in more complex multi-hop and multi-turn settings. The framework extends RAG-DIVE with a Context Discoverer, which identifies documents that can be combined to generate multi-hop questions within an ongoing conversation. To address the high computational cost of dynamic user simulation, we further introduce a Conversation Cacher, which reuses turns from previous evaluation runs while preserving the dynamic nature of the evaluation. We evaluate the framework across six distinct RAG configurations and compare its results with the original RAG-DIVE evaluation and the static, human-created CLAPNQ dataset. Our experiments show consistent performance trends across the evaluation approaches, while the more complex multi-hop and multi-turn setting exposes additional challenges for RAG systems. Furthermore, the Conversation Cacher substantially reduces token consumption, demonstrating its potential to make dynamic evaluation more cost-efficient. Finally, we apply MH-RAG-DIVE to an industrial RAG system with domain-specific data, demonstrating its applicability to real-world evaluation scenarios. Overall, our results show that the proposed approach provides a more complex and cost-efficient framework for evaluating RAG systems. All code and experimental data are publicly available in our GitHub repository (https://github.com/Daniel-Innsbruck/MH-RAG-DIVE).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于评估检索增强生成系统的动态对话模拟框架，支持多跳、多轮交互，并通过复用历史对话降低评估成本。
AI.motivation: 现有评估通常基于单轮或单跳交互，难以反映真实对话中跨文档推理与持续追问的复杂性；动态模拟虽更贴近实际，但计算和令牌开销较高。
AI.method: 在既有动态用户模拟框架上扩展多跳评估能力：新增上下文发现器，从对话进程中识别可组合生成多跳问题的文档；新增对话缓存器，复用先前评估中的对话轮次，以降低开销，同时保留动态评估特性。研究在六种检索增强生成配置上进行评估，并与原有评估方式及静态人工构建的数据集进行比较，还将框架应用于使用领域专属数据的工业系统。
AI.result: 不同评估方式呈现出一致的性能趋势，但多跳、多轮评估揭示了系统面临的额外挑战。对话缓存器显著减少了令牌消耗，显示出降低动态评估成本的潜力；工业系统案例也展示了该框架在真实场景中的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一种更复杂且更具成本效益的检索增强生成系统评估方案，可补充传统单轮、单跳评估，更全面地检验系统在连续对话和多跳任务中的表现。

title: PseuDRAGON: Knowledge-Guided Local LLMs for Financial-Data Pseudonymization in Closed Networks
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Accepted as a full paper in the AI for Intelligent Financial Technologies (AIFT) track of the 42nd ACM/SIGAPP Symposium on Applied Computing (SAC 2027). Gwangui Hong and Seonho An contributed equally
summary: Staff pseudonymizing financial data in closed networks must interpret abbreviated column names, identify personal information, and choose processing methods. Local language models can assist, but may give different labels for the same input. PseuDRAGON keeps confirmed judgments and corrections outside a fixed model and reuses them through exact-name lookup and learned rules. For expert review, the workflow searches institutional policy, national privacy law, then international sources. Across 92 columns from one institution, rules increase reuse under the same approval checks from 75 to 83 labels without reuse errors when all training judgments are available. With 25% of the training judgments, withholding non-PII rules for unseen names eliminated the extra PII misses in replay at the cost of lower reuse. Revising or withdrawing approvals rebuilds derived rules, and tests on synthetic records verify that selected methods produce the specified outputs. In three paired runs, the history-first baseline cut automated identification time by 83.0% on average versus no reuse.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向封闭网络金融数据去标识化的辅助流程，将经确认的判断与修正规则独立于固定语言模型保存并复用，以提升一致性和处理效率。
AI.motivation: 工作人员需要从缩写列名中判断字段含义、识别个人信息并选择处理方法。即使使用本地语言模型，同一输入也可能得到不同标签；同时，封闭网络环境对数据和流程控制有较高要求，因此需要可追溯、可修订且不依赖模型记忆的判断复用机制。
AI.method: 系统先对列名进行精确匹配，再应用从已确认判断中学习的规则。需要专家审查时，依次检索机构政策、国家隐私法律和国际资料。审批被修改或撤回后，系统重建派生规则；此外，通过合成记录测试所选处理方法是否产生预期输出。
AI.result: 在某机构的九十二个列名上，获得全部训练判断时，规则复用使同一审批检查下可复用的标签数从七十五个增至八十三个，未出现复用错误。仅有四分之一训练判断时，对未见列名不复用非个人信息规则，可在回放测试中消除新增的个人信息漏判，但会降低复用率。三组配对试验显示，相较于不复用判断的基线，优先利用历史记录使自动识别时间平均减少百分之八十三。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过保存经审批的判断、限制规则适用范围并支持审批变更，为金融数据去标识化提供了更一致且高效的辅助流程。结果显示，在训练信息不完整时，谨慎限制非个人信息规则有助于降低漏判风险；但证据目前来自单一机构的九十二个列名及有限试验，仍需在更多机构和真实场景中验证。

title: mini-psych-agent: Evaluating Human-Like Behavior in LLM Agents through Interactive Psychological Environments
summary: A Large Language Model (LLM), its harness, and the test-time compute budget jointly determine its behavior. Consequently, the same underlying model, embedded in different agentic workflows or allocated different amounts of test-time compute, can exhibit markedly different performance. Psychologists face an analogous challenge when evaluating human performance: the same person may behave differently under different incentives and levels of deliberation. Psychological tasks therefore provide an ideal testbed for studying such behavioral variation. However, when adapted to LLMs, these tasks are typically text-transcribed, replaying fixed, language-rendered experiments as static prompts. This format is ill-suited to agent evaluation, where actions can alter future observations and task states. Conversely, although dynamic environments are prevalent in the evaluation of LLM agents, they rarely ask whether the resulting behavior is human-like. Here, we bridge this gap by transforming psychological tasks into dynamic environments in which agents can interact and by using a learned human-policy model to evaluate how compatible the resulting behavioral trajectories are with human behavior. Across these environments, we find that this compatibility varies with an LLM's agentic configuration and the psychological task, and that memory raises it mainly by making choices more predictable rather than more human-like. These findings motivate a more holistic evaluation of LLM agents in psychology-inspired environments, accounting for both the backbone model and its agentic scaffold.

AI.tldr: 研究将心理学任务改造成可交互的动态环境，并用人类策略模型衡量智能体行为与人类行为的相容程度；结果显示，记忆机制主要让选择更可预测，并不必然使其更像人类。
AI.motivation: 现有心理学任务在适配大语言模型时，常被转写成固定文本提示，无法反映智能体行动对后续观察和任务状态的影响。另一方面，许多动态智能体评测虽允许交互，却很少检验行为是否符合人类特征。研究旨在弥合这两类评测之间的差距。
AI.method: 将心理学任务构建为智能体可交互的动态环境，并训练人类策略模型，以评估智能体行为轨迹与人类行为的相容性；同时考察基础模型、智能体配置、推理时计算资源和记忆机制等因素的影响。
AI.result: 行为与人类的相容程度会随智能体配置和心理学任务而变化。加入记忆后，选择通常更容易预测，但这并不意味着行为更具人类相似性。
AI.conclusion: 评估大语言模型智能体时，不应只关注基础模型本身，也应考虑其智能体框架及计算配置，并在能够反映交互行为的心理学启发环境中进行更全面的评估。

title: Trustworthy Speech-Based Autism Screening under Class Imbalance with Uncertainty-Aware HuBERT Ensembles
comment: Accepted version. To appear in IEEE Xplore
summary: Early screening of Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is critical for timely clinical intervention, although establishing reliable speech based screening systems remains problematic due to limited clinical data, class imbalance, and the need for reliable uncertainty estimation. We propose an uncertainty-aware ASD screening framework based on self-supervised HuBERT representations, combining Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) crossvalidation, balanced k-bagging, and Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout. Multiple HuBERT models are fine-tuned on balanced subsets, with predictions combined through probability-based ensemble averaging and aggregated at the subject level. Experiments on the Child Pathological Speech Database (CPSD) show strong performance, achieving 86.30% balanced accuracy and 93.74% ROC-AUC at the utterance level, and 95.04% and 96.30%, respectively, at the subject level. Furthermore, predictive entropy effectively reflects classification reliability: incorrectly classified segments show higher entropy than correctly classified ones (0.4605 $\pm$ 0.2314 vs. 0.1717 $\pm$ 0.1830), with a significant correlation with errors (r = 0.3981, p = 7.38 x 10 -170 ) and an error-detection ROC-AUC of 0.8359. These results demonstrate the potential of the proposed framework as a robust and uncertainty-aware computer-aided tool for ASD screening.

AI.tldr: 研究提出结合自监督语音表征、平衡集成与不确定性估计的自闭症谱系障碍语音筛查方法，在受试者层面取得较高分类性能，并能识别较不可靠的预测。
AI.motivation: 自闭症谱系障碍的早期筛查有助于及时干预，但基于语音的筛查系统面临临床数据有限、类别不平衡以及预测可靠性难以评估等问题。研究旨在提升筛查性能，并让系统能够反映预测的不确定程度。
AI.method: 框架使用自监督语音模型提取表征，并采用留一受试者交叉验证评估泛化能力。研究者在平衡子集上微调多个模型，通过平衡集成与概率平均融合预测，再将语句级结果汇总至受试者层面；同时利用蒙特卡洛随机失活估计预测不确定性，并以预测熵衡量可靠性。
AI.result: 在儿童病理语音数据库上，语句级平衡准确率为百分之八十六点三零，受试者级为百分之九十五点零四；对应的受试者工作特征曲线下面积分别为百分之九十三点七四和百分之九十六点三零。错误分类语句的预测熵显著高于正确分类语句，且熵与分类错误正相关；基于熵检测错误的曲线下面积为百分之八十三点五九。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，该框架有望成为兼顾分类效果与预测可靠性评估的自闭症谱系障碍语音辅助筛查工具。不过，摘要未提供外部数据验证或临床部署结果，因此其实际应用价值仍需在更广泛的样本和场景中进一步检验。

title: Cost-Sensitive Reversibility of Non-Deterministic Actions
summary:
Determining action reversibility requires checking whether the effects of an action can be undone. Recent work has extended reversibility to fully observable non-deterministic (FOND) planning. It distinguishes weak reversibility, where reversal may succeed, from strong-cyclic reversibility, where reversal is guaranteed under fairness. These notions are qualitative: they say whether reversal is possible, but not how costly it is.
  We introduce cost-sensitive reversibility for non-deterministic actions. Given positive action costs, we define weak and strong reversal budgets, $k$-bounded reversibility, and a distinction between finite strong reversal and strong-cyclic reversal with unbounded worst-case cost. We relate the resulting notions in a reversibility lattice, prove cost-aware policy-merging results, and show how to compute restricted weak and strong universal uniform reversal budgets using cost-optimal classical planning and worst-case-optimal FOND search, respectively. We also give an admissible lower-bound test for rejecting $k$-bounded reversibility. These notions support finer-grained safety decisions: a small finite strong budget bounds recovery cost, whereas a small weak budget certifies only a cheap possible recovery path. Actions without an acceptable strong bound may therefore warrant human approval, as in tool-using agent systems.

AI.tldr: 论文将动作可逆性从“能否恢复”扩展为“恢复需要多少代价”，并提出多种代价敏感的可逆性概念及其计算方法，以支持更细致的安全决策。
AI.motivation: 已有非确定性规划研究区分弱可逆性与强循环可逆性：前者表示存在可能成功的恢复方式，后者表示在公平性条件下最终能够恢复。但这些概念只描述恢复是否可能，没有衡量恢复代价，因而难以判断动作失败后的风险是否可接受。对于会调用工具的智能体，恢复代价尤其关系到是否应允许自动执行，或要求人工审批。
AI.method: 在动作代价为正的设定下，论文定义弱恢复预算、强恢复预算和有界可逆性，并区分最坏代价有限的强可逆性与最坏代价可能无界的强循环可逆性。作者构建这些概念之间的可逆性格关系，证明考虑代价后的策略合并结果；还分别利用代价最优经典规划和最坏情况最优的非确定性规划搜索，计算受限的弱、强通用一致恢复预算，并提出可用于排除有界可逆性的可采纳下界检验。
AI.result: 论文给出了代价敏感可逆性概念及其相互关系，并证明了相应的策略合并性质。对于受限问题，所提出的方法能够计算弱与强通用一致恢复预算；下界检验则可在搜索过程中识别不可能满足给定预算的情形。由此，有限的强恢复预算能够为恢复代价提供上界，而弱恢复预算只保证存在一条代价较低的可能恢复路径，并不保证恢复必然成功。
AI.conclusion: 代价敏感可逆性使安全评估不再停留于“能否撤销动作”，而能进一步衡量恢复的代价与保障程度。若动作缺乏可接受的强恢复代价上界，其后果可能难以可靠控制，因此在工具型智能体系统中，可将此类动作交由人工审批。

title: DMC-5: Dual-Model Collaboration with Cache-aware Context Compression for Long-horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon agents repeatedly feed an ever-growing interaction trajectory to a specialized agent model. Prefix caching reuses computation over repeated history, but cannot prevent context growth or remove information irrelevant to the current decision. This is especially costly when the specialized agent lacks the cached-input discounts available to general-purpose models, making trajectory compression a natural alternative. However, existing compression methods on selective context risk losing global information, recursively rewriting summary leads to semantic drift, while repeatedly recompressing the full history shifts the growing cost to the compressor. Therefore, we introduce DMC-5 (Dual-Model Collaboration with CaChe-aware Context Compression), an asymmetric framework that assigns full-history integration to a general compression model and action generation to a specialized agent model. DMC-5 maintains the raw trajectory as an Append-only Canonical View, preserving global access while allowing the compressor to reuse a stable historical prefix instead of recursively rewriting or recomputing prior context. The agent operates only on a compact Decision View with recent raw interactions, reducing repeated input while retaining the information needed for the next action. DMC-5 further incorporates YAMATO (integritY-Aware Memory Abstractions for Tool Operations) to preserve execution-critical information during lossy compression. Experiments on AppWorld, OfficeBench, and 8-objective QA show that DMC-5 reduces agent model input by 38.5-57.0% and end-to-end cost by 14.5-28.0% with 78.0-85.0% compressor cache-hit rates, while improving task performance by 1.0-5.8% over the uncompressed baseline.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种双模型协作的上下文压缩框架：保留完整交互轨迹供压缩模型整合，并让专用智能体仅处理精简的决策上下文，从而降低输入与执行成本，同时提升任务表现。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体会反复输入不断增长的交互历史，导致计算成本上升；前缀缓存虽能复用重复计算，却无法缩短上下文或剔除无关信息。现有压缩方法可能遗漏全局信息、反复改写摘要造成语义漂移，或因重复处理完整历史而将不断增长的成本转嫁给压缩器。对于缺少缓存输入折扣的专用智能体，压缩尤其有价值。
AI.method: 提出双模型协作框架，将完整历史整合交由通用压缩模型，将动作生成交由专用智能体。系统以只追加的规范视图保存原始轨迹，避免递归改写历史，并使压缩器能够复用稳定的历史前缀；同时构建紧凑的决策视图，供智能体使用近期原始交互和当前决策所需信息。此外，框架采用面向工具操作的完整性保护记忆抽象，在有损压缩时保留执行关键内容。
AI.result: 在应用世界、办公任务基准和八项目标问答任务上的实验表明，该方法将智能体模型输入量减少百分之三十八点五至百分之五十七，端到端成本降低百分之十四点五至百分之二十八，压缩器缓存命中率达到百分之七十八至百分之八十五；相较未压缩基线，任务表现提升百分之一至百分之五点八。
AI.conclusion: 通过分离完整历史管理与动作决策，并结合稳定前缀复用和执行信息保护，该框架缓解了长时程智能体上下文持续膨胀及传统压缩的局限。实验结果显示，它能够在降低成本和输入规模的同时维持并改善任务表现。

title: TamperCert: A Benchmark for Detecting Text Tampering in Degree Certificates
summary: Degree certificates play a critical role in high-stakes decisions such as university admission, immigration, and hiring. The issuing institution vouches for the holder, so a forged certificate may let its bearer pass these checks. Degree certificate forgery is increasingly prevalent. Yet, many assume that it is easy to spot. Reported cases show otherwise: in 2024, the business school of the University of Hong Kong found that about 30 master's students had enrolled with forged academic credentials. Few studies have looked at how to detect forged degree certificates, partly because public benchmarks are scarce. We present TamperCert, a benchmark built from 400 real degree certificates issued by 38 universities. Each certificate was subjected to 11 publicly available tampering methods to alter the holder's name and further processed with four additional post-processing techniques, resulting in over 20,000 forged images. We evaluate 13 detectors, a commercial multimodal large language model (MLLM), and detectors trained on TamperCert.Our findings reveal that no detector is reliable for every tampering method. Consequently, a determined forger may still evade detection. Moreover, the commercial MLLM misses most forgeries made by general-purpose generative models, and post-processing, such as resizing an image or photographing it with a camera, severely degrades detection.

AI.tldr: 论文构建了大规模学位证书伪造检测基准，并发现现有检测方法容易被不同伪造手法及图像后处理绕过。
AI.motivation: 学位证书会影响升学、移民和招聘等重要决策，伪造证书可能使持有人通过资格审查。尽管相关伪造案件不断出现，针对检测方法的研究仍然有限，主要原因是缺少公开基准。
AI.method: 研究团队以来自三十八所大学的四百份真实学位证书为基础，使用十一种公开篡改方法修改持有人姓名，并采用四种后处理技术生成两万余张伪造图像。研究评测了十三种检测器、一种商业多模态大语言模型，以及在该基准数据上训练的检测器。
AI.result: 没有一种检测器能够可靠识别所有篡改方式，蓄意伪造者仍可能规避检测。商业多模态大语言模型漏检了大多数由通用生成模型制作的伪造图像；调整图像尺寸或用相机拍摄等后处理也会显著降低检测效果。
AI.conclusion: 学位证书伪造检测仍面临显著的稳健性挑战。检测系统需要覆盖多种伪造方式，并增强对图像后处理的抵抗能力；该基准为比较和改进相关方法提供了测试基础。

title: HWRE-Bench: Can LLM Agents Understand Hardware They Did Not Design?
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Work in progress
summary: Hardware benchmarks for LLM agents all run the design flow forward, from a specification to RTL, a layout or a bug fix. We ask the reverse question: given an implemented artifact, such as a layout, a gate-level netlist or a protected simulation model, can an agent work out what it does well enough to act on that knowledge? We introduce HWRE-Bench, a benchmark for agentic hardware reverse engineering built on one observation. Each step of the forward flow discards information (names, hierarchy, word-level structure, generator parameters, the programming model), and a reverse-engineering task asks the agent to recover what was lost and to prove it with an executable deliverable that the artifact alone cannot supply. Since layout extraction is now mechanical and a correct netlist is already a cycle-exact model, every task carries a mandatory copy-the-netlist control that must score zero. HWRE-Bench spans five tracks (Extract, Abstract, Audit, Interoperate, Modify), four information-loss levels and white- versus black-box access, all on original designs. We report a pilot of 148 rollouts from two agents on four seed tasks under 16 conditions, with stage-annotated trajectories. Agents built their own layout extractors and audited a sanitized layout as reliably as a netlist, at about 27% more turns. Keyless, equivalence-preserving obfuscation changed neither pass rates nor defect-repair scores. Whether agents read the structure at all depended on task framing rather than on necessity, so pass rate alone does not show understanding. Provider safety filters stopped 16% of one agent's runs on the audit tasks. These results argue for deliverables beyond equivalence and for reporting run validity explicitly.

AI.tldr: 论文提出硬件逆向工程智能体评测基准，强调仅通过功能等价或复制网表不能证明理解；初步实验显示，任务设计会影响智能体是否真正分析结构，评测还应报告运行有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有硬件基准主要评估从规格到寄存器传输级描述、版图或缺陷修复的正向设计能力。论文转而研究逆向问题：智能体能否从版图、门级网表或受保护的仿真模型中恢复其功能与结构，并据此完成实际任务。正向流程会逐步丢失名称、层级、字级结构、生成器参数和编程模型等信息，因此逆向任务应要求恢复这些信息，并以可执行交付物加以证明。
AI.method: 作者构建硬件逆向工程基准，覆盖提取、抽象、审计、互操作和修改五类任务，并按信息丢失程度划分四个层级，同时设置白盒与黑盒访问条件，使用原创设计。每项任务均设有必须通过的“直接复制网表”对照，且其得分应为零，以排除仅凭已有网表模型完成任务的情况。论文还报告了阶段标注的智能体执行轨迹，并在四个种子任务、十六种条件下开展了两种智能体共一百四十八次试运行。
AI.result: 试运行中，智能体自行构建了版图提取器，并能像处理网表一样可靠地审计经过净化的版图，但耗费的轮次约多百分之二十七。保持等价性的无密钥混淆没有改变通过率或缺陷修复得分。智能体是否实际读取设计结构，取决于任务表述，而非任务完成是否确有此必要，说明单看通过率不足以证明理解。此外，一种智能体有百分之十六的审计任务运行被服务提供方的安全过滤器阻断。
AI.conclusion: 硬件逆向工程评测应要求超越功能等价的可执行交付物，以验证智能体是否恢复并利用了实现中丢失的信息；同时应明确报告运行有效性，区分真正失败与安全过滤等外部中断。论文的试运行结果初步揭示了任务表述、结构分析行为和评测指标之间的关系，但其规模有限，仍需更广泛的任务与智能体实验加以验证。

title: Automated Call for Action: RAG-Based Environmental Law Enforcement Screening System
summary: Environmental law inspectors face a structural issue in identifying potential violations from data: they often do not have the capacity to deal with large volume of data present in the emission events. This paper examines to what extent an LLM-based system can support evidence assembly and permit-based screening of such events, using the coke plants of a steel producer and a regional environmental service as a case. A simple puff-trajectory model aligns air quality measurements, weather and citizen complaints with each emission event. A retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline then retrieves facility-specific permit conditions and generates event reports and a period report with an investigation recommendation. Across 74 events from March 2025, plant-aware re-ranking reduced reports citing the other plant's conditions from 58.1% (hybrid retrieval) to 0% by rule-based plant labels, while maintaining high RAGAS and LLM-judge metrics. GPT-5-mini performed comparably to GPT-5.1, whereas GPT-5-nano scored lower on legal grounding and legal faithfulness. In an evidence ablation, removing air quality (AQ) data changed judge scores and period recommendations most; citation overlap changed only slightly under any removal, and removing complaint details had no measurable effect. This suggests a need for rules and guidelines that link complaints to incidents and permit conditions, so that community reports can count as evidence. The results support screening of events that may need further investigation. Design implications for involving environmental service experts are derived.

AI.tldr: 研究利用轨迹模型与检索增强生成系统，整合排放事件相关证据并对照工厂许可条件筛查事件；厂区标签显著减少引用错误许可条款，系统可辅助识别值得进一步调查的事件。
AI.motivation: 环境执法人员难以处理排放事件产生的大量数据，因而难以及时识别潜在违规。研究关注大型语言模型能否协助汇集证据、依据许可条件筛查事件，并探索如何让环境服务专家参与这一流程。
AI.method: 研究以一家钢铁企业的焦化厂及区域环境服务机构为案例，分析2025年3月的74起事件。首先采用简化的烟团轨迹模型，将空气质量监测、天气和居民投诉与各起排放事件关联；随后通过检索增强生成流程检索对应工厂的许可条件，生成单次事件报告及含调查建议的期间报告，并评估不同模型、证据删减和厂区感知重排序的影响。
AI.result: 采用基于规则的厂区标签后，报告引用另一家工厂许可条件的比例从混合检索时的58.1%降至0%，同时仍保持较高的检索增强生成评估指标和模型评审得分。小型模型版本的表现与较大型版本相近，而最小型版本在法律依据扎实性和法律忠实度方面较弱。删去空气质量数据对评审得分及期间调查建议的影响最大；删去投诉细节没有可测得的影响，各类证据删减对引用重合度的影响均较小。
AI.conclusion: 该系统适合用于排放事件的初步筛查和证据整理，帮助执法人员确定哪些事件可能需要进一步调查，但不能替代正式调查与专业判断。研究也指出，需要制定规则和指南，明确如何将居民投诉与具体事件及许可条件关联，才能使社区报告更有效地作为执法证据。

title: Revisiting LLMs as Context Engineers
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are used in more and more new tasks, context engineering becomes a fundamental method to efficiently steer LLMs by constructing instruction prompts or metadata without intensive training. A growing number of LLM context engineering (LCE) approaches automate the task by casting the LLM itself as the engineer that draws generalizable instructions or experiences from offline trials as context. Although these methods resemble how humans learn from experiences, it remains unclear \textbf{when and how} LLMs can engineer effective context from data. To answer the question, we first establish a benchmark composed of datasets with different reasoning patterns. We compared different LCE methods with different LLM families in 8B size, showing that there is no single winner for all tasks, even compared with simple baselines like chain-of-thought. Even when scaling model capabilities via more parameters or generation iterations, LCEs do not consistently boost existing performance. Across all datasets and models, the performance gains of LCEs are negatively correlated ($r=-0.5, p\le 0.05$) with the diversity of the failure modes of reasoning trajectories. Investigating how LCEs work, we find that (1) the improvement in instruction adherence can explain some success of LCEs; (2) one major bottleneck is whether LLMs can extract effective experiences out of natively diverse failures. Through this study, we uncover the limited capabilities of LCEs in abstracting principled contexts from diverse failure modes and understand how LCEs work, providing guidelines for future work.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，利用大语言模型从离线试验中自动提炼指令或经验，并不能稳定提升任务表现；其效果与推理失败模式的多样性密切相关。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型应用于更多任务，通过构造指令提示或元数据来引导模型，已成为一种无需大量训练的实用方法。尽管已有方法让模型从离线经验中自动提炼上下文，但模型何时、如何能够提炼出有效上下文仍不清楚。
AI.method: 研究构建了涵盖不同推理模式的数据集基准，并在八十亿参数规模下比较多种上下文工程方法与不同模型系列，同时考察思维链等简单基线。研究还分析模型规模、生成迭代次数、指令遵循能力，以及推理轨迹中失败模式的多样性与方法效果之间的关系。
AI.result: 没有一种上下文工程方法能在所有任务上占优；扩大模型规模或增加生成迭代，也不能稳定提升已有表现。跨数据集与模型的分析显示，上下文工程带来的性能增益与推理失败模式的多样性呈显著负相关（相关系数为负零点五，显著性概率不高于百分之五）。指令遵循能力的改善可以解释部分成功，而从多样化失败中提取有效经验是主要瓶颈之一。
AI.conclusion: 当前大语言模型从多样化失败中抽象出有原则、可泛化上下文的能力有限。评估和设计上下文工程方法时，应关注任务推理模式及失败类型的多样性，并进一步提升模型提炼有效经验的能力。

title: Reproducible by Seed? Not on GPUs: Batch-Dependent Non-Determinism in Text-to-Image Models
summary: In text to image AI models, fixing the prompt and the random seed is widely assumed to fix the image. We show that it does not on GPUs. We evaluate six text-to-image models (diffusion and autoregressive) under four numerical precisions and quantizations on three GPU types (RTX A6000, RTX 6000 Ada, and H100 NVL), across up to 100 prompts per set for all six models. For each configuration we compare, with the prompt and seed fixed, the image generated alone with the image generated inside a batch, and we also compare across GPUs. Every replay control reported here is bit-exact, so the variation is not random noise: the execution setting, mainly the batch composition and the GPU, decides the output. The effect is large and model dependent. Structural similarity between the single-image and the batched output falls to 0.580 for an autoregressive model in bf16 and to 0.551 with int8. For a second autoregressive model in bf16 it falls to 0.261 with sampled decoding and to 0.229 with greedy decoding, and for an fp8 diffusion model to 0.68. A diffusion model in bf16 stays close to the batch-1 output (0.96-0.98) but changes every image. In most cases the batched image is a different but equally valid image; in some, such as prompts with digits and counters, it is visibly worse. Cross-GPU differences are of the same order as the batch effect: for one autoregressive model in bf16 compared across two GPU architectures (RTX 6000 Ada versus RTX A6000), no image is bit-identical and the cross-GPU LPIPS (0.355 to 0.383) matches the batch effect within one GPU (0.347 to 0.381). The consequences are direct: seeds do not make results reproducible, benchmarks and image-quality comparisons that mix batch sizes or hardware can be biased, and safety audits and A/B tests on generated images need the serving setup reported.

AI.tldr: 固定提示词和随机种子，并不能保证图像生成结果固定；批次组成和图形处理器等执行条件也会显著影响输出。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在检验文本生成图像模型中“固定提示词与随机种子即可复现图像”的常见假设，并评估批次大小、批次组成及硬件差异对复现性、评测公平性和安全审计的影响。
AI.method: 作者测试了六种文本生成图像模型，涵盖扩散模型与自回归模型，并考察四种数值精度或量化设置及三类图形处理器。对每种配置，在提示词和随机种子不变时比较单张生成与批次生成的图像，也比较不同图形处理器上的结果；同时通过逐位完全一致的重放控制，排除随机噪声作为差异来源。
AI.result: 图像差异显著且因模型而异。部分模型的结构相似度大幅下降：例如，自回归模型在不同精度设置下低至0.580和0.551，另一模型低至0.261和0.229；一种扩散模型为0.68。另一个以较低精度运行的扩散模型虽与单张生成结果相似度较高（0.96—0.98），但每张图像仍发生变化。跨图形处理器的差异与同一图形处理器上的批次效应相当。多数变化仍生成合理图像，但涉及数字或计数器的提示词有时会得到明显更差的结果。
AI.conclusion: 随机种子不足以保证跨批次或跨硬件复现图像。混用批次大小或硬件进行基准测试和图像质量比较可能造成偏差；安全审计与对照测试也应报告实际服务配置，包括批次设置和硬件条件。

title: Splitting Belief Bases Conditionally based on Constraints for c-Representations and their Solutions
summary: Splitting notions for conditional belief bases aim at localizing reasoning and computation tasks to subbases containing only the relevant parts of the belief base. Among the different reasoning mechanisms, c-representations, a special kind of Spohn's ranking models, have been shown to provide high-quality inferences. c-Representations can be conveniently specified via a constraint satisfaction problem. In this article, we introduce the notion of conditional constraint splittings, extending constraint splittings by also allowing the subbases to share conditionals. Taking inspiration from conditional syntax splittings, we identify the subclasses of safe and fully localized conditional constraint splittings, allowing us to locally and independently solve the constraint system on the subbases. We also generalize solution splittings for c-representations to safe conditional c-solution splittings and provide an in-depth analysis of their relationship to conditional constraint splittings. Additionally, we elaborate on the relationship of these new splitting notions to safe and generalized safe conditional syntax splittings and also to safe covers, which have been proposed for localized computation of c-representations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出允许不同子知识库共享条件规则的条件约束分解，并分析其与局部求解、条件语法分解及覆盖方法之间的关系。
AI.motivation: 条件信念库的分解旨在将推理和计算限制在包含相关信息的子库中，从而提高效率。基于约束的信念表示能够刻画高质量的推理结果，但既有约束分解对各子库共享条件规则的情形支持不足，因此需要更灵活的分解框架。
AI.method: 论文提出条件约束分解，允许不同子库共享条件规则；进一步定义安全分解与完全局部分解，使约束系统能够在各子库上局部且独立地求解。论文还将解分解推广为安全条件解分解，并系统分析其与条件约束分解的关系，以及这些新概念与安全、广义安全条件语法分解和安全覆盖的联系。
AI.result: 论文建立了多种条件分解概念之间的关系框架，并指出安全与完全局部分解可支持子库上的局部独立求解。摘要未报告实验数据或定量性能结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过允许子库共享条件规则，论文扩展了约束分解的适用范围，并为局部计算基于排名模型的信念表示提供了更细致的理论工具。其主要贡献是刻画不同分解与覆盖概念之间的联系，为选择适合局部求解的分解方式奠定基础。

title: Learning What to Change: State-Verified Reinforcement Learning for Educational Agents
summary: Persistent tutoring agents do more than answer questions: they manage course files, practice records, and learner profiles that govern future lessons. In such stateful settings, knowing what to teach does not guarantee knowing what to change. We identify a pervasive failure mode, content-state decoupling, where agents deliver pedagogically sound responses while silently corrupting workspace state through unwarranted updates, missed prerequisites, or unintended side effects. Text-level judges overlook these state errors, whereas isolated tool-call checks break down because whether a write action is valid depends jointly on the learner request, prior state, and execution order. We propose State-Verified Reinforcement Learning, which supervises online policy optimization directly through verifiable workspace transitions. Within isolated sandboxes that snapshot state around every tool call, a deterministic verifier audits tool effects, workflow ordering, and native auto-sync side effects, pairing graded partial credit with a hard gate that zeroes episode reward upon any critical violation. Whenever no critical violation occurs, an evidence-grounded judge scores actual saved artifacts rather than agent claims. We pair 1,000 verifiable training instances with an independently authored, human-reviewed evaluation benchmark of 60 tasks spanning 11 educational categories and 16 native tools. After online GRPO training, Qwen3.8-27B raises category-weighted strict success on our benchmark from 51.47% to 80.74% (+29.27 points), cutting content-pass-only execution failures from 45.6% to 13.7% and required state-check failures from 63 to 1 across 180 trials. The resulting policy outperforms seven reference baselines by over 20 points while reducing output tokens by 17-39% across seven of eight external benchmarks without regressing on general reasoning or tool use.

AI.tldr: 论文提出状态验证强化学习，通过核验工具调用前后的真实工作区状态来训练辅导智能体，使其既能给出合适教学内容，也能正确、安全地更新学习资料与记录。
AI.motivation: 持续运行的辅导智能体不仅回答问题，还会修改课程文件、练习记录和学习者档案。现有评估往往只判断回复内容，难以发现智能体虽答得合理、却错误修改状态的“内容—状态脱节”问题；单独检查工具调用也不够，因为操作是否正确取决于用户请求、先前状态和执行顺序。
AI.method: 作者提出状态验证强化学习。在隔离沙箱中，对每次工具调用前后的工作区状态进行快照，由确定性验证器检查工具效果、工作流程顺序及系统自动同步产生的副作用。训练奖励采用分级部分得分，并对关键违规设置硬性门槛：一旦发生关键错误，整轮奖励归零；未发生关键违规时，再由基于证据的评审器检查实际保存的产物。训练数据包含一千个可验证实例，并使用在线群组相对策略优化进行训练。
AI.result: 在由人工审阅、独立编写的评测集上，该方法覆盖十一类教育任务和十六种原生工具。训练后，严格成功率从百分之五十一点四七升至百分之八十点七四，提高二十九点二七个百分点；仅内容合格但执行失败的比例从百分之四十五点六降至百分之十三点七；一百八十次试验中的必要状态检查失败数从六十三次降至一次。该方法比七种基线高出二十多个百分点，并在八个外部基准中的七个减少百分之十七至三十九的输出词元，且未损害通用推理或工具使用表现。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明，对真实状态转移进行可验证监督，能够弥补仅评估文本或孤立工具调用的不足，显著提升智能体在有状态教育工作流中的可靠性与执行准确性。其核心贡献是把实际工作区变化及关键违规直接纳入强化学习目标；不过，结论主要由特定教育任务、工具环境和规模有限的评测集支持，推广到其他领域仍需验证。

title: JaxNaviSim: A GPU-Accelerated, Data-Driven Simulator and Learning Benchmark for Maritime Navigation
summary: Coordinating vessels through the shared waterways of busy ports grows more challenging as vessel traffic increases. Port authorities need realistic simulations to assess how arrival schedules, anchorage assignments, and routes affect vessel throughput and navigation safety. Existing AIS-based trajectory models predict a vessel's track from its past trajectory in an open-loop fashion. They do not simulate step-by-step responses to other ships or test whether a vessel collides or reaches its goal. To address this problem, we introduce JaxNaviSim, a data-driven simulator and learning benchmark coupling Automatic Identification System (AIS) data with fast, controllable traffic simulation, in which learned models steer vessels through recorded traffic. First, we release a dataset of ~141 million AIS records from over 30K vessels across eight high-density regions of the Singapore Strait, among the world's busiest waterways, with ~6.7 million vessel-hours. Unlike several existing AIS datasets which mostly cover open seas, ours captures close-quarters vessel traffic in the narrow strait. Second, we define a navigation task for each recorded vessel trajectory. A model steers that vessel every 10 s from its recorded state to its anchoring point or region exit, while surrounding ships follow their recorded tracks or are steered by the model. We implement a JAX simulator that runs these tasks in large batches on a GPU. We also incorporate multiple vessel dynamics models and sea surface currents. Finally, we benchmark imitation learning (IL), offline and online RL, and include Predictive Action Refinement (PAR) as a safety baseline that cuts collision rates to 1-3%. The comparison shows that low tracking error does not ensure arrival, and learned policies can reach most destinations yet collide in 20-45% of episodes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出面向繁忙港口航行研究的数据驱动模拟器与基准，利用新加坡海峡高密度船舶数据评估船舶在动态交通中的导航、安全与到达能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于船舶自动识别系统轨迹的模型通常只依据历史轨迹进行开环预测，无法逐步模拟船舶对周围交通的响应，也难以检验碰撞风险或是否到达目的地。港口管理需要更真实、可控的仿真工具，以评估航期、锚地分配和航线规划对通行效率与安全的影响。
AI.method: 研究发布约1.41亿条船舶自动识别系统记录，涵盖新加坡海峡八个高密度区域、三万余艘船舶及约670万船舶小时。研究将每条记录轨迹构造成导航任务：模型每隔10秒控制船舶，从记录状态驶向锚泊点或区域出口；周边船舶可沿原轨迹行驶，也可由模型控制。研究以可在图形处理器上批量运行的加速模拟器执行任务，并纳入多种船舶动力学模型和海表流；同时比较模仿学习、离线与在线强化学习，并采用预测动作修正方法作为安全基线。
AI.result: 预测动作修正基线可将碰撞率降至百分之一至百分之三。实验还发现，轨迹跟踪误差较低并不意味着船舶能够到达目的地；学习策略虽能到达大多数目的地，但仍有百分之二十至百分之四十五的任务发生碰撞。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了更贴近繁忙狭窄水道场景的数据、逐步交互式导航模拟器及学习评测基准。结果表明，单纯优化轨迹拟合或到达能力不足以保障航行安全，未来方法应同时评估并提升任务完成率与避碰能力。

title: Learning Multimodal Representations from Partially Paired, Small-Scale Data
summary: Modeling multimodal data from partially paired samples is critical for advancing domains like biomedicine, where vast unimodal datasets and foundation models exist but paired data remains scarce. Existing fusion methods rely on large-scale paired datasets, limiting their use in scenarios with incomplete pairing. We introduce CAMEO, an adversarial learning-based modality fusion framework that integrates modalities from small, partially paired datasets. Combining any pre-trained unimodal encoder with a cross-modal latent alignment mechanism, CAMEO learns shared representations requiring only minimal paired samples. Evaluated on computational pathology tasks such as niche classification and cell type composition prediction, CAMEO achieves superior data efficiency, outperforming contrastive approaches like CLIP in low paired-data regimes, and highlighting the benefits of adversarial alignment when paired annotations are scarce. To facilitate further research, we additionally release a fully annotated HuggingFace dataset comprising three organs and paired image and gene expression modalities. By extending fusion methods to address limited pairing and small-scale datasets, we provide a framework that advances multimodal learning and broadens its applicability to real-world biomedical problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出卡梅奥，一种面向配对样本稀缺场景的多模态融合框架，可利用少量配对数据对齐预训练的单模态表示，并在病理任务中展现较高的数据效率。
AI.motivation: 生物医学领域拥有大量单模态数据和预训练模型，但图像与基因表达等跨模态配对数据稀缺。依赖大规模配对数据的现有融合方法因此难以适用于真实场景，亟需能够利用少量、部分配对样本进行模态整合的方法。
AI.method: 提出基于对抗学习的卡梅奥框架，将任意预训练单模态编码器与跨模态潜在空间对齐机制结合起来，在部分配对数据上学习共享表示。该方法旨在以少量配对样本实现有效融合，并在计算病理学任务中进行评估，包括组织生态位分类和细胞类型组成预测。
AI.result: 在组织生态位分类和细胞类型组成预测任务中，卡梅奥在配对数据较少时表现出较高的数据效率，优于对比式方法。摘要指出，这体现了配对标注稀缺时对抗式对齐的优势。此外，研究发布了涵盖三个器官、包含配对图像与基因表达数据的完整标注数据集。
AI.conclusion: 卡梅奥为小规模、部分配对的多模态数据提供了一种可行的融合方案，降低了对大规模配对数据的依赖，有望拓展多模态学习在真实生物医学问题中的应用。

title: ActField: Learning Action Effects as Continuous-Time Latent Dynamics
summary: Learning how actions change visual states is essential for prediction and decision-making in embodied tasks. Existing action-conditioned JEPA world models typically predict future representations at discrete observation intervals, leaving the temporal evolution of action effects implicit. We introduce ActField, a continuous-time JEPA world model that explicitly models latent state evolution through an action-conditioned vector field integrated over physical time. ActField separates action-independent evolution from action-induced changes, with the latter modulated by the latent context. A reference-conditioned representation and multi-step dynamics loss further support accurate long-horizon prediction. Together, these components provide a structured and temporally continuous formulation for predicting action-conditioned visual dynamics. Experiments across LIBERO, DROID, and BEHAVIOR demonstrate improved visual prediction fidelity and more accurate action-induced motion prediction over existing world models. Further evaluations on simulated and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate the utility of ActField in improving downstream policy planning through VLM-guided action selection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种连续时间、动作条件化的世界模型，能够显式预测动作引起的视觉状态变化，并提升长时预测及机器人操作规划效果。
AI.motivation: 现有动作条件化联合嵌入预测架构世界模型通常只预测离散观测时刻的未来表征，动作影响状态的时间演化过程因而没有被明确建模。这限制了模型对连续运动和长时动作后果的预测能力，也影响其在具身决策中的应用。
AI.method: 提出连续时间世界模型，将潜在状态演化表示为由动作条件化的向量场，并沿物理时间积分。模型将与动作无关的状态演化和动作导致的变化分开建模，后者由潜在情境调制；此外，采用参考条件表征和多步动力学损失，以增强长时预测能力。
AI.result: 在多个机器人操作基准上，模型的视觉预测保真度和动作引起的运动预测准确性优于已有世界模型。模拟与真实操作任务的进一步评估显示，该模型可配合视觉语言模型引导的动作选择，改善下游策略规划。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为动作条件化视觉动态提供了结构化、连续时间的建模方案。实验表明，显式刻画动作效应随时间的演化，有助于提高预测质量，并增强世界模型对具身规划任务的实用性。

title: WeMM-Ecom: Advancing Multimodal Content Understanding for WeChat E-Commerce
summary: We present WeMM-Ecom, a family of multimodal large language models that deliver frontier e-commerce capabilities while achieving state-of-the-art general-purpose performance at their respective scales. The family spans five sizes, from a 0.8B dense model to a 35B mixture-of-experts model with 3B active parameters. Our training pipeline begins with two-stage continued pre-training that progressively raises the proportion of e-commerce data within a diverse multimodal data mixture, followed by hybrid-thinking post-training that combines on-policy distillation and reinforcement learning to support both non-thinking and thinking modes. For evaluation, we construct a comprehensive suite of 28 e-commerce benchmarks (23 in-house and five open-source) covering eight business scenarios and complement it with 64 public general-purpose benchmarks. On the e-commerce suite, WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B surpasses substantially larger open-source flagship models, including Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, HY4, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. On the general-purpose suite, every WeMM-Ecom model surpasses its similarly sized Qwen3.5 counterpart, with the lightweight variants (e.g., WeMM-Ecom-2B) showing clear advantages over leading lightweight models such as Qwen3.5-2B, MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B, and LFM3-VL-2B. Beyond benchmarks, WeMM-Ecom now powers hundreds of production use cases in WeChat, including catalog management, multimodal product search, and livestream commerce, serving billion-scale requests per day. We publicly release all model weights and detail our data curation, training recipe, and benchmark construction to facilitate future work on domain-specialized multimodal models. We have released the model weights and code to facilitate future research at https://github.com/Tencent/WeMM-Ecom.

AI.tldr: 论文提出覆盖五种规模的多模态电商大语言模型系列，兼顾电商能力与通用能力，并已用于大规模生产场景。
AI.motivation: 电商业务需要模型处理商品目录、图文搜索和直播等多模态任务，同时具备可靠的通用能力。论文旨在构建适配电商场景的模型，并通过系统评测和公开资源推动领域研究。
AI.method: 模型系列涵盖从八亿参数稠密模型到三百五十亿参数、每次激活三十亿参数的混合专家模型。训练分为两阶段持续预训练，逐步提高多模态数据混合中电商数据的占比；随后采用结合在线策略蒸馏与强化学习的混合思考后训练，以支持思考和非思考两种模式。评测使用涵盖八类业务场景的二十八项电商基准，以及六十四项通用基准。
AI.result: 在电商基准上，最大规模模型的表现超过了参数规模显著更大的多种开源旗舰模型。在通用基准上，各规模模型均优于相近规模的对照模型；轻量版本也超过多种领先的轻量级多模态模型。该系列已支撑微信中的数百种生产应用，每日处理请求达十亿级。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过逐步强化电商数据训练并结合混合思考后训练，可以在不同模型规模下兼顾专业电商能力与通用性能。论文同时公开模型权重、代码及训练和评测细节，为后续领域专用多模态模型研究提供资源。

title: Beyond the Black Box: A Diagnosis-Driven Agent for Interpretable MIP Solver Tuning
summary:
Tuning a mixed-integer programming (MIP) solver is an instance-specific problem, where a poor configuration can increase solving time by orders of magnitude.
  Existing Bayesian optimization tuners treat solver tuning as a black-box optimization problem: each evaluation returns a single score, allowing the tuner to learn which configuration is faster, but not why.
  Inspired by the use of profilers in GPU-kernel optimization, we introduce APEC (Agent for Per-instance Explainable Configuration), a log-grounded tuning agent for MIP solvers.
  APEC has three layers: a deterministic layer that profiles each log, an interpretation layer that guides hypothesis-driven diagnosis, and a system layer that controls evaluation, enabling more reliable and interpretable solver tuning.
  On the full MIPLIB 2017 benchmark set, APEC achieves a 1.58X improvement over the default configuration with over 38% fewer parameter changes than the baselines, making the results easier to read.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种基于求解日志、兼顾可解释性与性能的混合整数规划求解器调优方法；在完整基准集上，相较默认配置提速一点五八倍，且参数改动比基线方法少百分之三十八以上。
AI.motivation: 混合整数规划求解器的最佳配置因具体实例而异，配置不当可能使求解时间增加数个数量级。现有贝叶斯优化方法通常只依据单一性能分数进行黑箱搜索，能判断哪种配置更快，却难以解释性能差异的原因，也可能造成难以理解的大量参数改动。
AI.method: 提出一种由求解日志驱动的逐实例可解释调优智能体，采用三层架构：确定性分析层对每次求解日志进行剖析；解释层据此开展假设驱动的诊断；系统层负责控制配置评估流程。该设计将日志中的求解行为信息用于指导调优，而非仅依赖最终性能分数。
AI.result: 在完整的混合整数规划基准测试集上，该方法相较默认配置实现一点五八倍的性能提升；与基线调优方法相比，参数改动数量减少百分之三十八以上，使调优结果更易解读。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，将求解日志分析与假设驱动诊断结合，可在提升求解性能的同时减少参数改动，并增强调优过程的可靠性与可解释性。

title: Uncovering Hidden Behaviours in Language Models via Limited-Parameter Finetuning
comment: Published at NeurIPS 2026. 53 pages, 19 figures, 6 tables
summary: Large language models can have behaviours which only arise in hard-to-anticipate contexts. These hidden behaviours pose a challenge to alignment audits, which seek to uncover problematic model behaviour but are limited by the scenarios the auditor can anticipate. To address this challenge, we explore limited-parameter finetuning (LPF) on examples of a target behaviour. While training 3-25% of LoRA parameters, LPF reveals whether the model has a hidden behaviour, even when standard behavioural evaluations cannot. LPF succeeds on a suite of model organisms with hidden behaviours (8-14B parameters), and also surfaces naturally occurring hidden behaviours in open-weight models (27-35B parameters). LPF can thus distinguish between models which appear behaviourally identical to an auditor, and does not require the context in which the hidden behaviour surfaces. LPF provides a novel affordance that may be useful for auditing frontier AI models. However, we do not evaluate LPF against baselines in a realistic auditing setting, so further work is needed to determine its practicality.

AI.tldr: 研究提出一种有限参数微调方法：即使常规行为评测无法发现模型的隐蔽行为，仅用少量参数在目标行为示例上微调，也可能将其显现出来。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型可能只在难以预料的情境中表现出特定行为，而安全审计受限于审计者能够预想到的场景。因此，常规评测可能无法识别行为表面相似、实际却存在差异的模型。
AI.method: 研究在目标行为示例上进行有限参数微调，只训练低秩适配器参数的一小部分（约百分之三至百分之二十五），观察微调是否能揭示模型原本不易察觉的行为；该方法不需要知道隐蔽行为出现的具体情境。
AI.result: 该方法在参数规模为八十亿至一百四十亿的隐蔽行为模拟模型集合上有效，也在参数规模为二百七十亿至三百五十亿的开放权重模型中发现了自然出现的隐蔽行为。它能够区分常规审计下看似行为相同的模型。
AI.conclusion: 有限参数微调为发现隐蔽模型行为提供了一种新的审计手段，或可用于前沿人工智能模型审计。但研究尚未在真实审计场景中与基线方法进行比较，因此其实际可行性和相对优势仍需进一步验证。

title: How Many Parameters Does Forecasting Need? A Survey and Code-Level Audit of Lightweight Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
summary: Long-term time series forecasting supports decisions in energy, transportation, weather and finance, where forecasts are produced continuously and often on constrained hardware. Recent work has moved in two directions. One scales Transformers and pre-trained foundation models to millions or hundreds of millions of parameters. The other shows that models with only hundreds to tens of thousands of parameters remain competitive on the standard benchmarks. Existing surveys organize forecasting models by backbone and treat efficiency as a side topic, so the reasons these small models work, and the way their sizes are reported, remain unexamined. This survey focuses on lightweight long-term forecasting. It provides a taxonomy of about thirty-five models in six families, with a common notation and an architecture diagram for each core model. It offers a structured-linear view in which the smallest models are linear maps restricted by frequency truncation or period folding, and it tests each restriction in closed form on eight benchmarks. It complements the literature review with an audit of sixteen official code repositories, which reproduces published parameter counts and reveals reporting gaps of up to 289 times. Finally, it gives practical guidance on model selection and reporting, and summarizes open problems.

AI.tldr: 本文综述轻量级长期时间序列预测模型，统一梳理约三十五种模型，分析其结构化线性原理，并审计参数量报告。
AI.motivation: 长期预测常用于能源、交通、天气和金融等持续运行场景，设备资源往往受限。尽管研究一方面不断扩大变换器和预训练基础模型，另一方面小参数模型也能在标准基准上保持竞争力，但现有综述较少解释小模型为何有效，也未充分审视模型规模的报告方式。
AI.method: 本文将约三十五种轻量模型归纳为六个家族，采用统一符号体系，并为核心模型绘制架构图。研究提出结构化线性视角，将最小模型解释为受到频率截断或周期折叠约束的线性映射，并在八个基准上以闭式形式检验这些约束。此外，作者审计了十六个官方代码仓库，以复现已发表的参数量统计。
AI.result: 研究通过八个基准分析了频率截断和周期折叠等结构约束，并复现了相关模型的参数量报告。审计发现，部分参数量报告存在明显差异，差距最高达二百八十九倍。摘要未提供各模型的具体预测性能或逐项审计结果。
AI.conclusion: 轻量模型的有效性可从其受结构约束的线性映射角度加以理解；评估这类模型时，除预测表现外，还应规范参数量的计算与报告。本文进一步提供模型选择和报告实践建议，并总结了尚待解决的问题。

title: Skill-Composer: Requirement-Driven Skill Selection from Multiple Marketplaces
summary: Agent skills have become the primary vehicle through which agents reuse specialized capabilities, yet public skill marketplaces provide skills with individual items: a query, whether matched through keyword or embedding similarity, returns a list of single skills ordered by relevance or by popularity. Such an interface cannot answer the question a developer actually faces: which set of skills should be installed to cover a task's complete requirement? The highest-ranked skills are often functionally redundant, while capabilities that are genuinely required remain uncovered. In this paper, we argue that skill acquisition should be reframed from ranking to set selection. We propose Skill-Composer, an agent-native framework that selects a non-redundant skill bundle for the user requirement, which aims to cover all available required capabilities and report any gaps. Specifically, it clarifies user requirements into atomic requirement points, retrieves and merges candidate skills across fragmented marketplaces, decomposes each candidate's capabilities, and progressively discards overlapping ones, so that each retained skill provides different capabilities. This moves the decision of which skills to acquire from the developer to the agent itself. We position this reframing and sketch its workflow.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Skill-Composer，将智能体技能获取从单项技能排序改为技能组合选择，以尽量完整覆盖任务需求、减少冗余并指出能力缺口。
AI.motivation: 现有技能市场通常按相关性或热度返回单项技能列表，无法直接回答开发者需要安装哪些技能才能满足任务的完整要求。排名靠前的技能可能功能重叠，而必要能力仍未覆盖，导致技能选择负担落在开发者身上。
AI.method: Skill-Composer 将用户需求拆解为原子需求点，从多个分散的技能市场检索并合并候选技能，再分解各技能所提供的能力，逐步剔除能力重叠的技能，形成能力互补的技能组合。框架旨在覆盖可用的必需能力，并报告未覆盖的需求。
AI.result: 摘要主要提出框架思路并勾勒工作流程，未报告实验设计、量化指标或实证结果。因此，无法据此判断其相较现有方法的实际效果。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张把技能获取从单项排序转变为面向需求覆盖的集合选择，让智能体承担技能组合决策。其核心价值在于减少冗余、揭示能力缺口；该框架的有效性仍需后续实现与实验验证。

title: Testing Quantized KV-Cache Maintenance: Encoding Layout and Historical Restoration
summary: Repeating rows then selecting originals retains layout-dependent drift despite equal encoding counts. We measure when existing checks fail to establish preservation contracts in fixed quantized KV-cache implementations. In four-bit HQQ axis zero at sixteen cycles, median paired relative-L2 increases over same-shape re-encoding are 7.22 percentage points for Qwen3-1.7B and 11.59 for SmolLM3-3B. Matched encoded states cover sixteen shared questions per model at one and sixteen cycles. Axis one matches the shape-preserving control; lazy reorders preserve the initial state. On one known input, fixed update counts retain the difference; preserving group members removes it. Our prefix-view extension passes current-prefix checks yet changes history and next logits in six model/codec settings at residual capacities four and 128. Public lookup reaches this boundary, including one of four precommitted project-new GPU inputs; fixed query swaps isolate a conditional old-history effect. Checkpoint/dense rollback is exact. An explicit delayed lookup client admits a supported 129-token path excluded by native AR on one known context. Failed task-harm expansion precludes population failure-rate or general answer-degradation claims. Native MLX-LM fixtures expose stale caller caches; synchronization restores the tested in-place contract with native computations preserved. In rejection tests, stale callers change logits but not greedy tokens.

AI.tldr: 论文发现，量化键值缓存中的布局变化和前缀视图扩展可能在通过常规检查后仍改变历史状态及后续计算；同步可修复已测得的缓存一致性问题，但实验不足以证明普遍的任务性能下降。
AI.motivation: 固定量化键值缓存常以编码次数相同、当前前缀检查通过或贪心输出不变，作为缓存未受影响的依据。论文质疑这些检查能否真正保证历史状态与后续计算得到保留，并考察缓存布局、前缀视图扩展及调用方缓存同步带来的影响。
AI.method: 作者在固定量化缓存实现中比较不同布局操作及对照条件，测量同形状重新编码下配对相对二范数的变化，并在两种模型、共同问题集和不同循环次数下评估。另在六种模型与编解码器组合及两种剩余容量下检查前缀视图扩展；通过公开查找、固定查询交换、检查点与稠密回滚，以及原生推理框架的缓存测试，区分历史变化、回滚正确性和调用方缓存同步问题。
AI.result: 四位量化器在轴零方向循环十六次后，相对同形状重新编码的配对相对二范数中位增幅，在两个模型上分别为七点二二和十一点五九个百分点；轴一方向与保形状对照相符，惰性重排保留初始状态。固定更新次数仍保留差异，而保留分组成员可消除差异。前缀视图扩展虽通过当前前缀检查，却在六种设置中改变历史状态和下一步 logits；公开查找也能触及该边界。检查点及稠密回滚精确。原生测试发现调用方缓存可能过期，同步后恢复已测得的原地更新契约且保留原生计算；拒绝测试中，过期缓存会改变 logits，但不改变贪心选出的词元。此外，一个已知上下文支持显式延迟查找客户端处理一百二十九词元路径，而原生自回归路径不支持。
AI.conclusion: 缓存正确性不能仅凭编码次数、当前前缀检查或贪心输出一致来判定；应明确维护布局与历史状态，并同步调用方缓存。实验揭示的是特定实现和测试条件下的状态及数值差异。由于扩展任务危害的检验未能成立，不能据此推断总体失败率或普遍的答案质量下降。

title: Can Cities Have Personalities? Introducing the SCD City Personality Assessment
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures. Supplementary research materials: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24466311
summary: Descriptions of cities are shaped by human experience and institutional narratives. We introduce the SCD City Personality Assessment (SCD-CPA), a method that instantiates document-grounded ChatGPT city personas and interrogates each with an identical 24-statement instrument inspired by the four-pair structure of the Myers-Briggs Type Indicator. Rather than asking a general-purpose model to characterize cities freely, we configure a separate document-grounded conversational agent for each city and use alternative evidence portraits to compare documentary inputs. The resulting four bipolar dimensions and four-letter summaries use independently defined urban concepts and scoring rules. Tokyo, New York, and Paris form the methodological evaluation (33 assessments across repeated sessions, three GPT-6 effort settings, and alternative portraits): Tokyo's original portrait yielded 85.4% exact within-setting item agreement, while evidence substitutions shifted some dimension strengths. A five-city application to Shanghai, Dubai, Mumbai, Lagos, and Sao Paulo (15 assessments) yielded 77.8% exact and 99.4% within-one-point cross-setting agreement, indicating consistency under the tested configurations. By treating each city conversational agent as a reproducible, evidence-conditioned experimental configuration, SCD-CPA makes documented city-character perceptions comparable and exposes their sensitivity to source selection. Although the documentary evidence is explicitly controlled, the model's internal interpretation of that evidence cannot be fully observed. We also examine the robustness of SCD-CPA across three AI reasoning-effort settings. The observed consistency suggests that the methodology is relatively insensitive to the tested configuration differences and provides a framework for evaluating its stability as future generations of AI models become available.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种以城市文献为依据、可重复实施的城市人格评估方法，并检验其在不同资料来源与模型推理设置下的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 城市形象既受人们的生活经验影响，也由机构叙事塑造。让通用模型自由描述城市，难以控制依据、比较结果或检验资料来源的影响。论文旨在建立一种证据可控、评估标准统一的框架，使不同城市的文献化形象能够进行比较，并揭示其对资料选择的敏感程度。
AI.method: 研究为每座城市配置一个基于指定文献的对话代理，并让各代理回答同一套二十四项陈述题。题目结构借鉴迈尔斯—布里格斯类型指标的四组对立维度，但维度概念与评分规则针对城市独立设计。研究通过替换城市资料画像、重复评估以及调整三种模型推理强度，考察结果的可重复性和稳定性；评估涵盖东京、纽约、巴黎，以及上海、迪拜、孟买、拉各斯和圣保罗。
AI.result: 方法评估中，东京原始资料画像在相同推理设置下的题项完全一致率为百分之八十五点四；更换证据资料会改变部分维度的强弱。五座城市的应用共进行十五次评估，跨设置的完全一致率为百分之七十七点八，评分相差不超过一点的一致率为百分之九十九点四。整体而言，在测试配置范围内，结果对推理强度差异较为稳定，但会受到资料来源影响。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将城市对话代理视为可复现、受证据约束的实验配置，为比较文献所呈现的城市性格提供了框架，也能检验结论对资料选择的敏感性。其局限是模型如何在内部解释和运用文献证据无法被完全观察；现有稳定性结论也仅适用于本研究测试的配置，仍需在未来模型及更多资料条件下持续评估。

title: Transport-Safe Evaluation of LLM Agents: Trajectory-Dependent Judge Error and Anytime-Valid Auditing
comment: Author's accepted version (without the publisher's template) of a paper accepted at ICAART 2027 (paper \#38). The final version will be published by SCITEPRESS; DOI to be added upon publication
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are often ranked by an LLM judge whose error rates are measured once and reused for every agent. The corrected success rates can then be biased when the judge's errors depend on the trajectory and agents differ in the trajectories they produce for successes or failures. We derive the exact asymptotic bias and give a chain of checks from identification to simultaneous ranks. On a four-agent semi-synthetic benchmark, a scalar correction with oracle calibration has maximum bias 0.245 and mean pointwise coverage 0.016, and never recovers the full ranking (0/250 replications). Augmented inverse-probability weighting (AIPW) with a uniform or a design-aware random audit keeps the maximum bias below 0.003, with mean pointwise coverage of 0.939 and 0.950. In a 48-cell stress test, effective target support rises only from 0.209 to 0.805 as calibration grows from 600 to 4,800 labels, while audited AIPW keeps a mean absolute error of 0.018-0.020. Without calibration support, or with judge dependence within an externally justified bound, we report valid bounds or sensitivity sets and carry them into rank sets. An e-process confidence sequence stays valid, for a stable target, under predictable adaptive auditing and arbitrary stopping.

AI.tldr: 论文指出，评审模型的误差会随智能体生成的轨迹而变化，统一校正可能严重扭曲成功率和排名；采用审计数据进行增广逆概率加权，可显著降低偏差并改善覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 评估大语言模型智能体时，常先测量评审模型的错误率，再将同一组错误率用于所有智能体。但若评审错误取决于任务轨迹，而不同智能体在成功与失败时产生的轨迹又不同，统一校正后的成功率就会产生偏差，进而导致错误排名。论文旨在刻画这种偏差，并建立从识别条件到同时排名推断的一套可靠检验流程。
AI.method: 推导统一标量校正所导致的精确渐近偏差，并提出基于审计标签的增广逆概率加权方法；审计设计可采用均匀抽样或利用设计信息的抽样。对于校准数据缺乏目标支持的情形，或评审误差存在外部依据所界定的依赖程度时，使用有效界限或敏感性集合，并将其传递至排名集合。此外，针对稳定目标，构造在可预测自适应审计和任意停止条件下仍有效的序贯置信序列。
AI.result: 在四智能体半合成基准中，即使使用理想校准，标量校正的最大偏差仍达0.245，平均逐点覆盖率仅为0.016，且250次重复中一次也未恢复完整排名。相比之下，增广逆概率加权将最大偏差控制在0.003以下，均匀审计和设计感知审计的平均逐点覆盖率分别为0.939和0.950。在包含48个单元的压力测试中，校准标签数从600增至4800时，有效目标支持度仅从0.209升至0.805；经审计的增广逆概率加权仍将平均绝对误差保持在0.018至0.020。
AI.conclusion: 评审模型的误差不能简单视为对所有智能体恒定，否则成功率校正和智能体排名可能严重失真。结合审计数据的增广逆概率加权更稳健；当数据支持不足或评审误差依赖无法排除时，应报告界限或敏感性集合，而非给出过度确定的点估计。序贯置信序列还为自适应审计与灵活停止提供了有效推断保障。

title: Intent-Conditioned Argument Mediation for Tool-Using LLM Agents: Blocking Trusted-but-Unauthorized Arguments
comment: Accepted at ICAART 2027; final version published by SCITEPRESS. Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24233094
summary: LLM agents turn a user's request and retrieved content into tool calls, and a call can reach the wrong recipient, endpoint, file or participant. Argument-level provenance blocks such values when they come from untrusted content, but accepts a trusted value that the user never requested. IntentFlow, a mediation layer between an unmodified planner and its tools, checks each authority-bearing argument against an intent contract and a provenance policy. On a synthetic benchmark of 200 attacks (oracle intent and injection labels, declared roles), attack success falls from 50.5% with provenance alone to 12.0% [8.2-17.2%]; every remaining success alters a content or payload field. IntentFlow wrongly blocks none of 200 paired benign tasks and 4 of 50 hard ones. On 50 trusted-but-unauthorized attacks, provenance-only mediation executes all 50 and IntentFlow none; a CaMeL-style check also blocks all 50 but rejects 16 of 50 benign tasks. On an offline AgentDojo-derived replay, IntentFlow blocks all 20 attacks at 75% benign success, as does a CaMeL-style check; a Progent-style allowlist blocks 19 and keeps all benign tasks. With one live planner and the same oracles, the mediator blocked all 17 corrupted calls proposed in 110 attacks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种位于大语言模型智能体规划器与工具之间的中介机制，将调用参数与用户意图契约及来源策略共同核验，以弥补仅追踪参数来源无法识别“可信但未经授权”参数的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 智能体可能把用户请求或检索内容转化为工具调用，而调用中的收件人、接口、文件或参与者等关键参数可能被恶意内容操纵。仅凭来源追踪虽能拦截不可信内容引入的参数，却可能放行来源可信、但用户从未授权的参数。因此，需要同时判断参数从何而来，以及该参数是否符合用户意图和权限范围。
AI.method: 提出一种不改动原有规划器的中介层，在规划器与工具之间检查每个具有权限影响的参数：依据意图契约判断其是否得到用户意图授权，并依据来源策略判断其来源是否可信。研究使用合成攻击基准、成对良性任务、可信但未授权攻击、由真实智能体任务改编的离线回放，以及在线规划器实验进行评估；部分实验使用预先给定的意图、注入标签和角色声明。
AI.result: 在含二百个攻击的合成基准中，仅用来源追踪时攻击成功率为百分之五十点五；加入该中介后降至百分之十二，置信区间为百分之八点二至十七点二。剩余攻击成功案例均改变了内容或载荷字段。它未误拦二百个配对良性任务，但在五十个困难良性任务中误拦四个。对五十个可信但未授权攻击，来源追踪方法全部放行，而该方法全部拦截；另一种基于信息流的检查也全部拦截攻击，但误拒十六个良性任务。在离线回放中，该方法拦截全部二十个攻击，良性任务成功率为百分之七十五；另一种检查结果相同，而基于允许列表的方法拦截十九个攻击且保留全部良性任务。在线规划器实验中，针对一百一十个攻击，该方法拦截了规划器提出的全部十七个被篡改调用。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将参数来源核验与用户意图及授权核验结合，能够补足单纯来源追踪对可信但未经授权参数的盲点，并在若干实验中减少对良性任务的误拦。不过，评估规模有限，且部分结果依赖预先给定的意图、注入标签和角色信息；剩余风险集中在内容或载荷字段。因此，这些结果支持该机制的潜力，但尚不足以证明其在广泛真实环境中的可靠性。

title: SchemaCaps: When a Compatible Tool Update Silently Widens an AI Agent's Authority
comment: Author's accepted version (without the publisher's layout). Accepted at ICAART 2027; final version published by SCITEPRESS. Artefact: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24233014
summary: The tools users approve for their AI agents keep changing their JSON input schemas. Of 8 surveyed MCP clients and scanners, none is observed or documented to re-approve a tool whose input schema widens (two not determinable).
